Vou verificar o arquivo lógico enviado e cruzar isso com o traceback para localizar a causa exata do import quebrado e a correção mínima segura.

O erro principal e real e este:

eeg_display_launcher.py esta fazendo um import absoluto:
from runtime_trace_api import trace_event

Mas runtime_trace_api.py nao esta no mesmo pacote de shell\viewer.
Ele esta dentro de developer_tools\project_reasoner\reasoner_runtime_collector, e o proprio arquivo logico mostra esse modulo sendo usado a partir desse diretório, junto de runtime_trace_writer.py e do runner do runtime collector.

Entao, ao abrir pelo wrapper shell\run_kanda_with_coverage.py, o Python nao encontra runtime_trace_api no sys.path atual e cai em:

ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'runtime_trace_api'

O arquivo enviado tambem confirma o desenho pretendido:
o runtime collector usa configure_runtime_trace, save_runtime_trace e imports absolutos internos como from runtime_trace_api import get_runtime_trace_writer, partindo do diretório do próprio collector.

A conclusao objetiva:
o problema nao esta no coverage wrapper em si
o problema esta no acoplamento entre o app principal e o runtime collector
o app esta tentando importar um modulo do collector sem expor corretamente esse pacote ao Python path

Ha ainda um segundo problema, menor:
o coverage JSON export falhou por causa de
No source for code: '...\shibokensupport\__init__.py'
isso costuma acontecer quando o coverage tenta exportar arquivo de dependencia empacotada sem fonte local. Isso nao derrubou a execucao principal; o crash fatal foi mesmo o ModuleNotFoundError. O seu log mostra isso claramente: o export de coverage falha, mas o traceback que encerra o processo vem depois, no import de runtime_trace_api.

Correcao minima e segura

Opcao mais limpa:
pare de importar runtime_trace_api diretamente de dentro de shell\viewer.

Em vez disso, crie um adaptador local no projeto principal, por exemplo:
shell\instrumentation\runtime_trace_bridge.py

Esse bridge tenta importar o collector de forma controlada e, se nao conseguir, vira no-op.

Exemplo:

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

try:
    from developer_tools.project_reasoner.reasoner_runtime_collector.runtime_trace_api import (
        trace_event,
        trace_error,
        configure_runtime_trace,
        save_runtime_trace,
    )
except Exception:
    def trace_event(*, event_type: str, source_file: str, source_symbol: str,
                    message: str = "", object_name: str = "",
                    object_type: str = "", extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
        return

    def trace_error(*, source_file: str, source_symbol: str,
                    message: str, extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> None:
        return

    def configure_runtime_trace(*, project_root: str, output_path: str, entry_script: str = ""):
        return None

    def save_runtime_trace():
        return None

Depois troque no shell\viewer\eeg_display_launcher.py:

from runtime_trace_api import trace_event

por:

from shell.instrumentation.runtime_trace_bridge import trace_event

Por que essa e a melhor correcao
ela remove dependencia oculta de sys.path
ela preserva arquitetura
ela permite o app rodar mesmo sem runtime collector configurado
ela evita espalhar imports do project_reasoner dentro dos modulos da GUI

Correcao rapida, se voce quiser apenas fazer funcionar agora

Troque este import:

from runtime_trace_api import trace_event

por este:

from developer_tools.project_reasoner.reasoner_runtime_collector.runtime_trace_api import trace_event

Isso provavelmente resolve o ModuleNotFoundError imediatamente, desde que o projeto esteja sendo executado com E:\eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis como working directory e raiz de import.

Mas ha um detalhe importante:
dentro de runtime_trace_api.py, o arquivo logico mostra que ele mesmo faz:

from runtime_trace_writer import RuntimeTraceWriter

ou seja, outro import absoluto fraco.

Entao, se voce fizer apenas o primeiro ajuste, o proximo erro pode ser:
No module named 'runtime_trace_writer'

Por isso, o correto arquiteturalmente e padronizar os imports internos do runtime collector para package-qualified ou relativos.

O que eu corrigiria no runtime collector

Em
developer_tools\project_reasoner\reasoner_runtime_collector\runtime_trace_api.py

trocar:

from runtime_trace_writer import RuntimeTraceWriter

por:

from .runtime_trace_writer import RuntimeTraceWriter

Em
runtime_trace_decorators.py

trocar:

from runtime_trace_api import get_runtime_trace_writer

por:

from .runtime_trace_api import get_runtime_trace_writer

E no runner do runtime collector, como o arquivo logico tambem sugere integracao com qt_hooks.qt_connection_monitor, prefira imports relativos ou package-qualified consistentes ali tambem.

Em resumo, a cadeia do bug e esta

    run_kanda_with_coverage.py chama shell.kanda_main

    kanda_main importa shell.viewer.eeg_visualizer_core

    isso importa shell.viewer.eeg_display_launcher

    esse modulo tenta from runtime_trace_api import trace_event

    o modulo nao existe no path global

    a execucao quebra

Patch minimo recomendado

No app:
eeg_display_launcher.py
usar import do bridge local ou import totalmente qualificado

No runtime collector:
converter imports absolutos internos para relativos:
.runtime_trace_api
.runtime_trace_writer

Validacao objetiva depois do patch

Rode, nessa ordem:

python -m py_compile "shell\viewer\eeg_display_launcher.py"
python -m py_compile "developer_tools\project_reasoner\reasoner_runtime_collector\runtime_trace_api.py"
python -m py_compile "developer_tools\project_reasoner\reasoner_runtime_collector\runtime_trace_decorators.py"
python shell\run_kanda_with_coverage.py

Se o app abrir, o import foi resolvido.
Se aparecer erro novo de import interno do collector, ele deve ser um dos absolutos restantes.

O que eu faria agora, sem desvio
primeiro corrigiria os imports para package-safe
depois rerodaria o wrapper
e so depois trataria o aviso do coverage sobre shibokensupport

O erro do shibokensupport e secundario.
O bloqueador verdadeiro da execucao e o import absoluto de runtime_trace_api.

# developer_tools/project_reasoner/reasoner_runtime_collector/runtime_trace_api.py

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from runtime_trace_writer import RuntimeTraceWriter


_TRACE_WRITER: RuntimeTraceWriter | None = None


def configure_runtime_trace(
    *,
    project_root: str,
    output_path: str,
    entry_script: str = "",
) -> RuntimeTraceWriter:
    global _TRACE_WRITER
    _TRACE_WRITER = RuntimeTraceWriter()
    _TRACE_WRITER.configure(
        project_root=project_root,
        output_path=output_path,
        entry_script=entry_script,
    )
    return _TRACE_WRITER


def get_runtime_trace_writer() -> RuntimeTraceWriter | None:
    return _TRACE_WRITER


def trace_event(
    *,
    event_type: str,
    source_file: str,
    source_symbol: str,
    message: str = "",
    object_name: str = "",
    object_type: str = "",
    extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return
    writer.trace_event(
        event_type=event_type,
        source_file=source_file,
        source_symbol=source_symbol,
        message=message,
        object_name=object_name,
        object_type=object_type,
        extra=extra,
    )


def trace_signal_connection(
    *,
    sender_type: str,
    sender_name: str,
    signal_name: str,
    receiver_type: str,
    receiver_name: str,
    slot_name: str,
    source_file: str = "",
    source_line: int | None = None,
    extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return
    writer.trace_signal_connection(
        sender_type=sender_type,
        sender_name=sender_name,
        signal_name=signal_name,
        receiver_type=receiver_type,
        receiver_name=receiver_name,
        slot_name=slot_name,
        source_file=source_file,
        source_line=source_line,
        extra=extra,
    )


def trace_state_snapshot(
    *,
    label: str,
    state: dict[str, Any],
) -> None:
    writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return
    writer.trace_state_snapshot(label=label, state=state)


def trace_error(
    *,
    source_file: str,
    source_symbol: str,
    message: str,
    extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return
    writer.trace_error(
        source_file=source_file,
        source_symbol=source_symbol,
        message=message,
        extra=extra,
    )


def trace_warning(
    *,
    source_file: str,
    source_symbol: str,
    message: str,
    extra: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return
    writer.trace_warning(
        source_file=source_file,
        source_symbol=source_symbol,
        message=message,
        extra=extra,
    )


def save_runtime_trace() -> Path | None:
    writer = get_runtime_trace_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return None
    return writer.save()

Achei o ponto fraco: esse arquivo confirma que o collector ainda usa import absoluto interno. Vou fechar a correção mínima e a cadeia provável do próximo erro para você não corrigir pela metade.

Perfeito. Esse arquivo confirma o diagnóstico.

O problema imediato está nesta linha:

from runtime_trace_writer import RuntimeTraceWriter

Esse é um import absoluto frágil.
Ele só funciona quando o diretório reasoner_runtime_collector foi manualmente inserido no sys.path, como o seu próprio arquivo lógico mostra nos testes (sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT_DIR))).

Mas no fluxo real do app, shell\run_kanda_with_coverage.py não está executando esse pacote dessa forma.
Então o eeg_display_launcher.py tenta puxar runtime_trace_api, e esse módulo por sua vez depende de um import absoluto interno. O resultado é exatamente o colapso de resolução de módulo que você viu.

A correção arquitetural certa é:

    tornar os imports internos do collector relativos

    parar de importar runtime_trace_api como módulo solto dentro da GUI

Correção 1: ajustar runtime_trace_api.py

Troque isto:

from runtime_trace_writer import RuntimeTraceWriter

por isto:

from .runtime_trace_writer import RuntimeTraceWriter

Correção 2: ajustar quem importa runtime_trace_api

No traceback, o erro fatal nasce em:

shell\viewer\eeg_display_launcher.py

Ali, você mostrou antes que há:

from  runtime_trace_api import trace_event

Isso também precisa ser corrigido.

Troque por import qualificado de pacote:

from developer_tools.project_reasoner.reasoner_runtime_collector.runtime_trace_api import trace_event

Esse é o patch mínimo para parar o erro atual.

Mas eu recomendo padronizar tudo no collector, porque provavelmente existem outros imports absolutos do mesmo tipo.

Você deve procurar por estes padrões dentro de
developer_tools\project_reasoner\reasoner_runtime_collector

e trocar todos os imports internos para relativos:

from runtime_trace_api import ...
from runtime_trace_writer import ...
from runtime_trace_models import ...
from runtime_trace_utils import ...

viram:

from .runtime_trace_api import ...
from .runtime_trace_writer import ...
from .runtime_trace_models import ...
from .runtime_trace_utils import ...

Por que isso é o correto

O próprio arquivo lógico mostra que os testes estavam forçando PROJECT_DIR no sys.path para permitir imports absolutos locais. Isso mascara o problema estrutural.

Em produção, o app está sendo executado como pacote a partir da raiz do projeto, então os módulos do collector precisam se comportar como pacote Python real, não como scripts soltos.

O próximo erro provável

Depois de corrigir runtime_trace_api.py e eeg_display_launcher.py, pode surgir outro ModuleNotFoundError em outro arquivo do collector que ainda esteja usando import absoluto.

Então faça uma varredura textual nesses arquivos do collector:
runtime_trace_decorators.py
runtime_trace_writer.py
runtime_trace_models.py
runtime_trace_utils.py
e qualquer outro do mesmo pacote.

Validação objetiva

Rode exatamente isto:

python -m py_compile "developer_tools\project_reasoner\reasoner_runtime_collector\runtime_trace_api.py"
python -m py_compile "shell\viewer\eeg_display_launcher.py"
python shell\run_kanda_with_coverage.py

Se ainda quebrar, o novo traceback quase certamente vai apontar o próximo import absoluto restante.

Sobre o erro do coverage

Isto aqui:

Coverage JSON export failed: No source for code: 'E:\eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis\shibokensupport\__init__.py'

não foi o motivo do crash principal.
É um problema separado de export do coverage, disparado porque o coverage tentou incluir código sem fonte local resolvível.
O seu processo só morreu depois, no import de runtime_trace_api.

Então a ordem certa é:

    consertar os imports do runtime collector

    rerodar o app

    só depois tratar o filtro do coverage para ignorar shibokensupport

Se quiser, no próximo passo eu posso te dar o patch exato para o eeg_display_launcher.py e também uma busca sistemática dos imports absolutos restantes no collector.

I dont want shell\viewer\eeg_display_launcher.py import runtime_trace_api  because eeg_display_launcher.py is a project file and runtime_trace_api is a test file 

Correto. Nesse caso, o problema arquitetural não é “como importar”, e sim que esse import não deveria existir.

Se shell\viewer\eeg_display_launcher.py e um arquivo do projeto
e runtime_trace_api.py e um arquivo de teste/instrumentacao
entao o projeto principal nao deve depender dele diretamente.

A decisao certa e:

remover toda dependencia de runtime_trace_api de dentro de shell\viewer\eeg_display_launcher.py

A regra arquitetural fica assim

Core app / project code
nao importa nada de
developer_tools
project_reasoner
runtime collector
test helpers
coverage helpers

Quem pode importar o projeto e o contrario:
scripts de teste
wrappers de coverage
runtime collectors
debug launchers
ferramentas em developer_tools

Ou seja:

certo
run_kanda_with_coverage.py -> project files

errado
project files -> runtime_trace_api

O que fazer agora

No shell\viewer\eeg_display_launcher.py, remova:

from runtime_trace_api import trace_event

e qualquer chamada como:

trace_event(...)

Se essas chamadas sao importantes para observabilidade, voce tem duas opcoes corretas.

Opcao A - remover totalmente do arquivo do projeto
Melhor se isso era apenas rastreamento de teste.

Opcao B - inverter a instrumentacao
O arquivo do projeto nao chama tracer nenhum.
O wrapper de teste e que faz monkey patch, decorator, wrapper, signal hook, ou subclass instrumentada.

Essa e a abordagem mais limpa.

Exemplo de direcao correta:

Projeto:

def display_pyside6_eeg_visualizer(...):
    # logica real do app
    ...

Teste ou runtime collector:

from shell.viewer.eeg_display_launcher import display_pyside6_eeg_visualizer

def traced_display_pyside6_eeg_visualizer(*args, **kwargs):
    trace_event(...)
    return display_pyside6_eeg_visualizer(*args, **kwargs)

Ou, melhor ainda, instrumentar em nivel mais externo no runner.

O erro real entao vira

O seu projeto foi contaminado por codigo de instrumentacao.
O conserto nao e ajustar import.
O conserto e remover o acoplamento reverso.

Patch minimo recomendado

Em shell\viewer\eeg_display_launcher.py

    remova o import

    remova chamadas de trace

    deixe o modulo 100 por cento independente de runtime collector

Se quiser preservar um gancho neutro para futura observabilidade sem acoplamento, use callback injetavel.

Exemplo:

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Callable


def display_pyside6_eeg_visualizer(
    ...,
    on_event: Callable[[str, dict], None] | None = None,
) -> None:
    if on_event is not None:
        on_event("display_launcher_started", {"module": __name__})

    # logica normal

Assim:
o projeto nao conhece runtime_trace_api
o teste pode passar um callback
o app continua limpo

Exemplo no runner de teste:

from developer_tools.project_reasoner.reasoner_runtime_collector.runtime_trace_api import trace_event
from shell.viewer.eeg_display_launcher import display_pyside6_eeg_visualizer


def _on_event(event_name: str, payload: dict) -> None:
    trace_event(
        event_type=event_name,
        source_file="shell/viewer/eeg_display_launcher.py",
        source_symbol="display_pyside6_eeg_visualizer",
        extra=payload,
    )


display_pyside6_eeg_visualizer(..., on_event=_on_event)

Mas so faca isso se realmente precisar dessa observabilidade nesse ponto.

Faca isto em ordem:

    remova runtime_trace_api de shell\viewer\eeg_display_launcher.py

    rerode o app

    se o runtime collector precisar observar esse fluxo, mova a instrumentacao para o wrapper de teste, nunca para o arquivo do projeto

    depois trate o problema separado do coverage export

      "source_symbol": "main",
      "message": "KANDA main entered",
      "tags": ["startup", "qt"],

}

Exact design for runtime_scenario_writer.py

Keep it minimal:

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


TRACE_VERSION = "1.0"
SCENARIO_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def _now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="milliseconds")


def _safe_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()


def _next_session_id() -> str:
    SCENARIO_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    existing_numbers: list[int] = []
    for path in SCENARIO_DIR.glob("*_trace.json"):
        prefix = path.stem.split("_", 1)[0].strip()
        if prefix.isdigit():
            existing_numbers.append(int(prefix))

    next_number = 1
    if existing_numbers:
        next_number = max(existing_numbers) + 1

    return "%04d" % next_number


class RuntimeScenarioWriter:
    """Lightweight scenario writer for real app sessions."""

    def __init__(self, scenario_name: str, app_entry: str) -> None:
        self.session_id = _next_session_id()
        self.scenario_name = _safe_text(scenario_name) or "unnamed_scenario"
        self.app_entry = _safe_text(app_entry)
        self.started_at = _now_iso()
        self.ended_at = ""
        self.events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self._closed = False

    def add_event(
        self,
        event_type: str,
        source_file: str,
        source_symbol: str,
        message: str = "",
        tags: list[str] | None = None,
        payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if self._closed:
            return

        self.events.append(
            {
                "seq": len(self.events) + 1,
                "timestamp": _now_iso(),
                "event_type": _safe_text(event_type),
                "source_file": _safe_text(source_file),
                "source_symbol": _safe_text(source_symbol),
                "message": _safe_text(message),
                "tags": list(tags or []),
                "payload": dict(payload or {}),
            }
        )

    def build_payload(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "trace_version": TRACE_VERSION,
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "scenario_name": self.scenario_name,
            "started_at": self.started_at,
            "ended_at": self.ended_at or _now_iso(),
            "app_entry": self.app_entry,
            "events": self.events,
        }

    def save(self) -> Path:
        self._closed = True
        output_name = f"{self.session_id}_{self.scenario_name}_trace.json"
        output_path = SCENARIO_DIR / output_name
        output_path.write_text(
            json.dumps(self.build_payload(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=True),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        return output_path

That matches the uploaded Step 29 direction closely while keeping the dependency boundary correct.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


TRACE_VERSION = "1.0"
SCENARIO_DIR = (
    Path(__file__).resolve().parent
)


def _now_iso() -> str:
    return datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="milliseconds")


def _safe_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()


def _next_session_id() -> str:
    SCENARIO_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    existing_numbers: list[int] = []
    for path in SCENARIO_DIR.glob("*_trace.json"):
        prefix = path.stem.split("_", 1)[0].strip()
        if prefix.isdigit():
            existing_numbers.append(int(prefix))

    next_number = 1
    if existing_numbers:
        next_number = max(existing_numbers) + 1

    return "%04d" % next_number


class RuntimeScenarioWriter:
    """
    Lightweight runtime scenario writer for real app sessions.
    """

    def __init__(self, scenario_name: str, app_entry: str) -> None:
        self.session_id = _next_session_id()
        self.scenario_name = _safe_text(scenario_name) or "unnamed_scenario"
        self.app_entry = _safe_text(app_entry)
        self.started_at = _now_iso()
        self.ended_at = ""
        self.events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        self._closed = False

    def add_event(
        self,
        event_type: str,
        source_file: str,
        source_symbol: str,
        message: str,
        tags: list[str] | None = None,
        payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        if self._closed:
            return

        seq = len(self.events) + 1
        self.events.append(
            {
                "seq": seq,
                "timestamp": _now_iso(),
                "event_type": _safe_text(event_type),
                "source_file": _safe_text(source_file),
                "source_symbol": _safe_text(source_symbol),
                "message": _safe_text(message),
                "tags": tags[:] if isinstance(tags, list) else [],
                "payload": dict(payload) if isinstance(payload, dict) else {},
            }
        )

    def finalize(self) -> Path:
        if self._closed:
            return self.output_path()

        self.ended_at = _now_iso()
        self._closed = True

        data = {
            "trace_version": TRACE_VERSION,
            "session_id": self.session_id,
            "scenario_name": self.scenario_name,
            "started_at": self.started_at,
            "ended_at": self.ended_at,
            "app_entry": self.app_entry,
            "events": self.events,
        }

        path = self.output_path()
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(
            json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        return path

    def output_path(self) -> Path:
        safe_name = self.scenario_name.lower().replace(" ", "_")
        return SCENARIO_DIR / f"{self.session_id}_{safe_name}_trace.json"

from __future__ import annotations

import atexit
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from developer_tools.project_reasoner.runtime_scenarios.runtime_scenario_writer import (
    RuntimeScenarioWriter,
)


_WRITER: RuntimeScenarioWriter | None = None
_FINALIZED = False


def _safe_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()


def start_runtime_scenario(
    scenario_name: str = "manual_app_session",
    app_entry: str = "shell/kanda_main.py",
) -> RuntimeScenarioWriter:
    global _WRITER

    if _WRITER is not None:
        return _WRITER

    _WRITER = RuntimeScenarioWriter(
        scenario_name=scenario_name,
        app_entry=app_entry,
    )

    _WRITER.add_event(
        event_type="startup",
        source_file=app_entry,
        source_symbol="start_runtime_scenario",
        message="Runtime scenario session started",
        tags=["startup", "session"],
        payload={},
    )

    atexit.register(finalize_runtime_scenario)
    return _WRITER


def log_runtime_event(
    event_type: str,
    source_file: str,
    source_symbol: str,
    message: str,
    tags: list[str] | None = None,
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    writer = start_runtime_scenario()
    writer.add_event(
        event_type=event_type,
        source_file=source_file,
        source_symbol=source_symbol,
        message=message,
        tags=tags,
        payload=payload,
    )


def finalize_runtime_scenario() -> str:
    global _FINALIZED

    if _FINALIZED:
        if _WRITER is None:
            return ""
        return str(_WRITER.output_path())

    _FINALIZED = True

    if _WRITER is None:
        return ""

    _WRITER.add_event(
        event_type="close_done",
        source_file="shell/kanda_main.py",
        source_symbol="finalize_runtime_scenario",
        message="Runtime scenario session finalized",
        tags=["close", "session"],
        payload={},
    )

    path = _WRITER.finalize()
    return str(path)

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


TRACE_GLOB = "*_trace.json"

CRITICAL_EVENT_TERMS = (
    "startup",
    "load",
    "save",
    "reset",
    "close",
    "topomap",
    "timeline",
    "tab_switch",
    "error",
)

LOAD_EVENT_TERMS = (
    "load",
    "open",
    "import",
)

SAVE_RESET_EVENT_TERMS = (
    "save",
    "reset",
    "close",
)

STARTUP_EVENT_TERMS = (
    "startup",
    "boot",
    "launch",
    "ui_ready",
)


def _safe_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()


def _safe_lower(value: Any) -> str:
    return _safe_text(value).lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except Exception:
        return 0


def _safe_dict(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return value
    return {}


def _safe_list(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return value
    return []


def _scenario_dir(project_root: Path) -> Path:
    return (
        project_root
        / "developer_tools"
        / "project_reasoner"
        / "runtime_scenarios"
    )


def _is_trace_file(path: Path) -> bool:
    name = path.name.lower()
    return name.endswith("_trace.json")


def _contains_any_term(values: list[str], terms: tuple[str, ...]) -> bool:
    joined = " ".join(_safe_lower(item) for item in values)
    return any(term in joined for term in terms)


def _normalize_event(event: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload = _safe_dict(event.get("payload"))

    tags_in = event.get("tags", [])
    tags: list[str] = []
    if isinstance(tags_in, list):
        for item in tags_in:
            text = _safe_text(item)
            if text:
                tags.append(text)

    normalized = {
        "seq": _safe_int(event.get("seq")),
        "timestamp": _safe_text(event.get("timestamp")),
        "event_type": _safe_text(event.get("event_type")),
        "source_file": _safe_text(event.get("source_file")),
        "source_symbol": _safe_text(event.get("source_symbol")),
        "message": _safe_text(event.get("message")),
        "tags": tags,
        "payload": payload,
    }
    return normalized


def _read_trace_file(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"))
    except Exception:
        return {}

    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return {}

    return data


def _score_scenario(
    *,
    event_count: int,
    unique_event_type_count: int,
    unique_file_count: int,
    error_count: int,
    is_critical_scenario: bool,
) -> float:
    score = 0.0
    score += min(float(event_count), 20.0) * 0.8
    score += min(float(unique_event_type_count), 10.0) * 1.5
    score += min(float(unique_file_count), 10.0) * 1.2
    score += float(error_count) * 3.0
    if is_critical_scenario:
        score += 5.0
    return round(score, 2)


def build_scenario_trace_index(project_root: str | Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    root = Path(project_root).resolve()
    scenario_dir = _scenario_dir(root)

    if not scenario_dir.exists():
        return {}

    output: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    for path in sorted(scenario_dir.glob(TRACE_GLOB)):
        if not _is_trace_file(path):
            continue

        trace = _read_trace_file(path)
        if not trace:
            continue

        session_id = _safe_text(trace.get("session_id"))
        if not session_id:
            prefix = path.stem.split("_", 1)[0].strip()
            session_id = prefix or path.stem

        scenario_name = _safe_text(trace.get("scenario_name")) or path.stem
        app_entry = _safe_text(trace.get("app_entry"))
        started_at = _safe_text(trace.get("started_at"))
        ended_at = _safe_text(trace.get("ended_at"))

        raw_events = _safe_list(trace.get("events"))
        events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        event_types: list[str] = []
        source_files: list[str] = []
        tags_seen: list[str] = []

        error_count = 0

        for item in raw_events:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue

            normalized = _normalize_event(item)
            events.append(normalized)

            event_type = normalized["event_type"]
            source_file = normalized["source_file"]

            if event_type:
                event_types.append(event_type)

            if source_file:
                source_files.append(source_file)

            for tag in normalized["tags"]:
                if tag:
                    tags_seen.append(tag)

            lowered_type = _safe_lower(event_type)
            lowered_msg = _safe_lower(normalized["message"])
            if "error" in lowered_type or "error" in lowered_msg:
                error_count += 1

        unique_event_types = sorted({_safe_text(item) for item in event_types if _safe_text(item)})
        unique_source_files = sorted({_safe_text(item) for item in source_files if _safe_text(item)})
        unique_tags = sorted({_safe_text(item) for item in tags_seen if _safe_text(item)})

        search_terms = unique_event_types + unique_tags
        is_startup_scenario = _contains_any_term(search_terms, STARTUP_EVENT_TERMS)
        is_load_scenario = _contains_any_term(search_terms, LOAD_EVENT_TERMS)
        is_save_reset_scenario = _contains_any_term(search_terms, SAVE_RESET_EVENT_TERMS)
        is_critical_scenario = _contains_any_term(search_terms, CRITICAL_EVENT_TERMS)

        event_count = len(events)
        unique_event_type_count = len(unique_event_types)
        unique_file_count = len(unique_source_files)

        scenario_score = _score_scenario(
            event_count=event_count,
            unique_event_type_count=unique_event_type_count,
            unique_file_count=unique_file_count,
            error_count=error_count,
            is_critical_scenario=is_critical_scenario,
        )

        output[session_id] = {
            "session_id": session_id,
            "scenario_name": scenario_name,
            "trace_file": str(path),
            "trace_version": _safe_text(trace.get("trace_version")),
            "app_entry": app_entry,
            "started_at": started_at,
            "ended_at": ended_at,
            "event_count": event_count,
            "event_types": unique_event_types,
            "unique_event_type_count": unique_event_type_count,
            "source_files": unique_source_files,
            "files_touched_count": unique_file_count,
            "tags": unique_tags,
            "error_count": error_count,
            "is_startup_scenario": is_startup_scenario,
            "is_load_scenario": is_load_scenario,
            "is_save_reset_scenario": is_save_reset_scenario,
            "is_critical_scenario": is_critical_scenario,
            "scenario_score": scenario_score,
            "events": events,
        }

    return dict(sorted(output.items()))


def build_scenario_trace_summary(
    scenario_trace_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    scenario_count = len(scenario_trace_index)
    event_count = 0
    scenario_names: list[str] = []
    event_types: list[str] = []
    source_files: list[str] = []
    critical_scenario_count = 0
    startup_scenario_count = 0
    load_scenario_count = 0
    save_reset_scenario_count = 0
    error_scenario_count = 0

    for payload in scenario_trace_index.values():
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            continue

        scenario_names.append(_safe_text(payload.get("scenario_name")))
        event_count += _safe_int(payload.get("event_count"))
        event_types.extend(_safe_list(payload.get("event_types")))
        source_files.extend(_safe_list(payload.get("source_files")))

        if bool(payload.get("is_critical_scenario")):
            critical_scenario_count += 1
        if bool(payload.get("is_startup_scenario")):
            startup_scenario_count += 1
        if bool(payload.get("is_load_scenario")):
            load_scenario_count += 1
        if bool(payload.get("is_save_reset_scenario")):
            save_reset_scenario_count += 1
        if _safe_int(payload.get("error_count")) > 0:
            error_scenario_count += 1

    unique_scenario_names = sorted({_safe_text(item) for item in scenario_names if _safe_text(item)})
    unique_event_types = sorted({_safe_text(item) for item in event_types if _safe_text(item)})
    unique_source_files = sorted({_safe_text(item) for item in source_files if _safe_text(item)})

    return {
        "scenario_count": scenario_count,
        "event_count": event_count,
        "unique_scenario_name_count": len(unique_scenario_names),
        "unique_scenario_names": unique_scenario_names,
        "unique_event_type_count": len(unique_event_types),
        "unique_event_types": unique_event_types,
        "files_touched_by_scenarios": len(unique_source_files),
        "source_files": unique_source_files,
        "critical_scenario_count": critical_scenario_count,
        "startup_scenario_count": startup_scenario_count,
        "load_scenario_count": load_scenario_count,
        "save_reset_scenario_count": save_reset_scenario_count,
        "error_scenario_count": error_scenario_count,
    }


def build_scenario_flow_hotspots(
    scenario_trace_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    limit: int = 25,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    records: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for session_id, payload in scenario_trace_index.items():
        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
            continue

        records.append(
            {
                "session_id": session_id,
                "scenario_name": _safe_text(payload.get("scenario_name")),
                "trace_file": _safe_text(payload.get("trace_file")),
                "event_count": _safe_int(payload.get("event_count")),
                "unique_event_type_count": _safe_int(payload.get("unique_event_type_count")),
                "files_touched_count": _safe_int(payload.get("files_touched_count")),
                "error_count": _safe_int(payload.get("error_count")),
                "scenario_score": float(payload.get("scenario_score", 0.0)),
                "is_critical_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_critical_scenario")),
                "is_startup_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_startup_scenario")),
                "is_load_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_load_scenario")),
                "is_save_reset_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_save_reset_scenario")),
                "event_types": _safe_list(payload.get("event_types")),
                "source_files": _safe_list(payload.get("source_files")),
            }
        )

    records.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -float(item.get("scenario_score", 0.0)),
            -_safe_int(item.get("error_count")),
            -_safe_int(item.get("files_touched_count")),
            -_safe_int(item.get("event_count")),
            _safe_text(item.get("session_id")),
        )
    )

    return records[: max(0, int(limit))]

def _build_warning_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("parse_warnings", [])
        for record in files_payload
        if record.get("parse_warnings")
    }


def _count_total_warnings(files_payload: list[dict]) -> int:
    total = 0
    for record in files_payload:
        total += len(record.get("parse_warnings", []))
    return total


def _build_coverage_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("coverage_metadata", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_git_metadata_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("git_metadata", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_symbol_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    out: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            out[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": fn.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "function",
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            cls_name = cls.get("name", "")
            out[cls_name] = {
                "file": path,
                "line": cls.get("lineno"),
                "kind": "class",
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                out[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line": method.get("lineno"),
                    "kind": "method",
                }

    return out


def _build_import_graph(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["module_name"]: record.get("imports", [])
        for record in files_payload
    }


def _build_call_edges(files_payload: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    edges: list[dict] = []

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            from_symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                if call.get("call_name"):
                    edges.append(
                        {
                            "from_file": path,
                            "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                            "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                            "line": call.get("lineno"),
                        }
                    )

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                from_symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                for call in method.get("calls", []):
                    if call.get("call_name"):
                        edges.append(
                            {
                                "from_file": path,
                                "from_symbol": from_symbol,
                                "to_call": call.get("call_name"),
                                "line": call.get("lineno"),
                            }
                        )

    return edges


def _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    summaries: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "function",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(fn, "function"),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            summaries[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "kind": "class",
                "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(cls, "class"),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                summaries[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "kind": "method",
                    "summary": summarize_symbol_semantics(method, "method"),
                }

    return summaries


def _build_snippet_index(files_payload: list[dict], max_lines: int) -> dict:
    _ = max_lines
    snippets: dict = {}

    for file_record in files_payload:
        path = file_record["path"]
        source = file_record.get("source", "")
        lines = source.splitlines()

        def get_block(lineno: int | None) -> str:
            if not lineno or not lines:
                return ""
            start = max(1, lineno - 8)
            end = min(len(lines), lineno + 20)
            return "\n".join(
                f"{idx:>5} | {lines[idx - 1]}"
                for idx in range(start, end + 1)
            )

        for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
            symbol = fn.get("qualname", fn.get("name", ""))
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": fn.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": fn.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(fn.get("lineno")),
            }

        for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
            symbol = cls.get("name", "")
            snippets[symbol] = {
                "file": path,
                "line_start": cls.get("lineno"),
                "line_end": cls.get("lineno"),
                "snippet": get_block(cls.get("lineno")),
            }

            for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                symbol = method.get("qualname", method.get("name", ""))
                snippets[symbol] = {
                    "file": path,
                    "line_start": method.get("lineno"),
                    "line_end": method.get("lineno"),
                    "snippet": get_block(method.get("lineno")),
                }

    return snippets


def _build_module_summary_index(files_payload: list[dict]) -> dict:
    return {
        record["path"]: record.get("module_responsibility_summary", {})
        for record in files_payload
    }


def run_collector(project_root: str, output_json: str) -> dict:
    root = Path(project_root).expanduser().resolve()
    output_path = Path(output_json).expanduser().resolve()
    config = CollectorConfig()

    files_payload: list[dict] = []
    entry_files: list[str] = []
    errors: list[dict] = []

    python_files = walk_python_files_filtered(root, config)

    for path in python_files:
        rel_path = normalize_path(path, root)
        git_metadata = collect_git_metadata_for_file(root, path)
        coverage_metadata = collect_coverage_for_file(root, path)
        parsed, error = parse_python_file(path)

        parse_warnings = []
        if parsed is not None:
            parse_warnings = normalize_file_warning_records(
                Path(rel_path),
                parsed.get("parse_warnings", []),
            )

        if error is not None:
            errors.append({"file": rel_path, "error": error})
            continue

        module_name = rel_path[:-3].replace("/", ".")
        comments = parsed["comments"]
        strings = parsed["strings"]
        docstring = parsed["module_docstring"]
        semantic = summarize_file_semantics(
            {
                "functions": parsed["functions"],
                "classes": parsed["classes"],
                "comments": comments,
                "strings": strings,
                "imports": parsed["imports"],
                "docstring": docstring,
            }
        )

        entry_markers = []
        joined_source = parsed["source"]
        if '__name__ == "__main__"' in joined_source or "QApplication(" in joined_source:
            entry_markers.append("entry_candidate")
            entry_files.append(rel_path)

        file_record = {
            "path": rel_path,
            "module_name": module_name,
            "imports": parsed["imports"],
            "classes": parsed["classes"],
            "functions": parsed["functions"],
            "docstring": docstring,
            "comments": comments,
            "strings": strings,
            "entry_markers": entry_markers,
            "ui_keyword_hits": [],
            "eeg_keyword_hits": [],
            "semantic_hints": semantic["evidence_terms"],
            "semantic_roles": semantic["roles"],
            "primary_role": semantic["primary_role"],
            "secondary_roles": semantic["secondary_roles"],
            "role_confidence": semantic["confidence"],
            "summary": (
                f"{semantic['primary_role']} file"
                if semantic["primary_role"]
                else "general python module"
            ),
            "source": parsed["source"],
            "git_metadata": git_metadata,
            "coverage_metadata": coverage_metadata,
            "parse_warnings": parse_warnings,
        }

        file_record["module_responsibility_summary"] = build_module_responsibility_summary(
            file_record
        )

        files_payload.append(file_record)

    symbol_index = _build_symbol_index(files_payload)
    import_graph = _build_import_graph(files_payload)
    call_edges = _build_call_edges(files_payload)

    qt_signal_map = extract_qt_signal_map(files_payload)
    attribute_state_map = build_attribute_state_map(files_payload)

    ui_action_index = build_ui_action_index(
        qt_signal_map,
        symbol_index,
        files_payload,
    )
    ui_action_summary = build_ui_action_summary(ui_action_index)
    ui_action_hotspots = build_ui_action_hotspots(
        ui_action_index,
        limit=25,
    )

    object_ownership = build_object_ownership_map(files_payload)
    execution_chains = build_execution_chains(files_payload, entry_files)

    subsystems = build_subsystem_summaries(files_payload)
    symbol_summaries = _build_symbol_summaries(files_payload)
    snippet_index = _build_snippet_index(files_payload, config.max_snippet_lines)
    duplicate_symbols = find_duplicate_symbols(files_payload)
    test_links = link_tests_to_sources(files_payload)
    bucket_index = build_bucket_index(files_payload)
    bucket_summary = build_bucket_summary(files_payload)

    module_centrality_index = build_module_centrality_index(
        import_graph,
        call_edges,
        symbol_index,
    )
    symbol_centrality_index = build_symbol_centrality_index(call_edges)
    project_hotspots = build_top_project_hotspots(
        module_centrality_index,
        symbol_centrality_index,
        limit=25,
    )

    file_priority_index = build_file_priority_index(
        files_payload,
        module_centrality_index,
    )
    priority_ranking = build_priority_ranking(file_priority_index, limit=50)

    boundary_index = build_boundary_index(
        files_payload,
        ui_action_index,
        module_centrality_index,

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


def _safe_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()


def _safe_int(value: Any) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except Exception:
        return 0


def _read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"))
    except Exception:
        return {}


def _scenario_dir(repo_root: Path) -> Path:
    return repo_root / "developer_tools" / "project_reasoner" / "runtime_scenarios"


def build_runtime_scenario_index(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    scenario_dir = _scenario_dir(repo_root)
    output: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    if not scenario_dir.exists():
        return output

    for path in sorted(scenario_dir.glob("*_trace.json")):
        data = _read_json(path)
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue

        session_id = _safe_text(data.get("session_id", "")) or path.stem
        scenario_name = _safe_text(data.get("scenario_name", ""))
        events = data.get("events", [])
        if not isinstance(events, list):
            events = []

        event_types: set[str] = set()
        source_files: set[str] = set()
        tags: set[str] = set()
        error_count = 0

        normalized_events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        for event in events:
            if not isinstance(event, dict):
                continue

            event_type = _safe_text(event.get("event_type", ""))
            source_file = _safe_text(event.get("source_file", ""))
            source_symbol = _safe_text(event.get("source_symbol", ""))
            message = _safe_text(event.get("message", ""))
            seq = _safe_int(event.get("seq", 0))
            payload = event.get("payload", {})
            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                payload = {}

            event_tags = event.get("tags", [])
            if not isinstance(event_tags, list):
                event_tags = []

            if event_type:
                event_types.add(event_type)
            if source_file:
                source_files.add(source_file)
            for tag in event_tags:
                tag_text = _safe_text(tag)
                if tag_text:
                    tags.add(tag_text)

            if event_type == "error":
                error_count += 1

            normalized_events.append(
                {
                    "seq": seq,
                    "timestamp": _safe_text(event.get("timestamp", "")),
                    "event_type": event_type,
                    "source_file": source_file,
                    "source_symbol": source_symbol,
                    "message": message,
                    "tags": [_safe_text(tag) for tag in event_tags if _safe_text(tag)],
                    "payload": payload,
                }
            )

        scenario_score = (
            (len(normalized_events) * 1.0)
            + (len(event_types) * 2.0)
            + (len(source_files) * 1.5)
            + (error_count * 5.0)
        )

        output[session_id] = {
            "session_id": session_id,
            "scenario_name": scenario_name,
            "trace_file": str(path.relative_to(repo_root)).replace("\\", "/"),
            "trace_version": _safe_text(data.get("trace_version", "")),
            "started_at": _safe_text(data.get("started_at", "")),
            "ended_at": _safe_text(data.get("ended_at", "")),
            "app_entry": _safe_text(data.get("app_entry", "")),
            "event_count": len(normalized_events),
            "event_types": sorted(event_types),
            "source_files": sorted(source_files),
            "tags": sorted(tags),
            "error_count": error_count,
            "scenario_score": round(scenario_score, 3),
            "events": normalized_events,
            "is_critical_scenario": bool(
                any(
                    event_type in {
                        "startup",
                        "load_eeg_begin",
                        "load_eeg_done",
                        "save_begin",
                        "save_done",
                        "reset_begin",
                        "reset_done",
                        "topomap_toggle",
                        "timeline_move",
                    }
                    for event_type in event_types
                )
            ),
        }

    return dict(sorted(output.items()))


def build_runtime_scenario_summary(
    runtime_scenario_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    event_types: set[str] = set()
    files_touched: set[str] = set()
    total_events = 0
    critical_count = 0

    for session_id, payload in runtime_scenario_index.items():
        scenario_event_types = payload.get("event_types", [])
        scenario_files = payload.get("source_files", [])
        if not isinstance(scenario_event_types, list):
            scenario_event_types = []
        if not isinstance(scenario_files, list):
            scenario_files = []

        for item in scenario_event_types:
            event_types.add(_safe_text(item))
        for item in scenario_files:
            files_touched.add(_safe_text(item))

        total_events += _safe_int(payload.get("event_count", 0))
        if bool(payload.get("is_critical_scenario", False)):
            critical_count += 1

        rows.append(
            {
                "session_id": session_id,
                "scenario_name": _safe_text(payload.get("scenario_name", "")),
                "event_count": _safe_int(payload.get("event_count", 0)),
                "event_type_count": len(scenario_event_types),
                "source_file_count": len(scenario_files),
                "error_count": _safe_int(payload.get("error_count", 0)),
                "scenario_score": float(payload.get("scenario_score", 0.0)),
                "is_critical_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_critical_scenario", False)),
            }
        )

    rows.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -float(item.get("scenario_score", 0.0)),
            item.get("session_id", ""),
        )
    )

    return {
        "scenario_count": len(rows),
        "event_count": total_events,
        "unique_event_type_count": len(event_types),
        "files_touched_by_scenarios": len(files_touched),
        "critical_scenario_count": critical_count,
        "scenarios": rows,
    }


def build_runtime_scenario_hotspots(
    runtime_scenario_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    limit: int = 25,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for session_id, payload in runtime_scenario_index.items():
        rows.append(
            {
                "session_id": session_id,
                "scenario_name": _safe_text(payload.get("scenario_name", "")),
                "trace_file": _safe_text(payload.get("trace_file", "")),
                "event_count": _safe_int(payload.get("event_count", 0)),
                "event_types": list(payload.get("event_types", [])),
                "source_file_count": len(payload.get("source_files", [])),
                "error_count": _safe_int(payload.get("error_count", 0)),
                "scenario_score": float(payload.get("scenario_score", 0.0)),
                "is_critical_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_critical_scenario", False)),
            }
        )

    rows.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -float(item.get("scenario_score", 0.0)),
            item.get("session_id", ""),
        )
    )

    return rows[:limit]

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


STARTUP_EVENT_TERMS = {
    "startup",
    "boot",
    "launch",
    "ui_ready",
}

LOAD_EVENT_TERMS = {
    "load",
    "open",
    "import",
}

SAVE_RESET_EVENT_TERMS = {
    "save",
    "reset",
    "close",
}

CRITICAL_EVENT_TERMS = {
    "startup",
    "load",
    "save",
    "reset",
    "close",
    "topomap",
    "timeline",
    "tab_switch",
    "error",
}


def _safe_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()


def _safe_lower(value: Any) -> str:
    return _safe_text(value).lower()


def _safe_int(value: Any) -> int:
    try:
        return int(value)
    except Exception:
        return 0


def _read_json(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore"))
    except Exception:
        return {}


def _scenario_dir(repo_root: Path) -> Path:
    return repo_root / "developer_tools" / "project_reasoner" / "runtime_scenarios"


def _event_matches_terms(event_type: str, tags: list[str], terms: set[str]) -> bool:
    haystack_parts = [_safe_lower(event_type)]
    haystack_parts.extend(_safe_lower(tag) for tag in tags)
    haystack = " ".join(part for part in haystack_parts if part)
    return any(term in haystack for term in terms)


def _is_startup_event(event_type: str, tags: list[str]) -> bool:
    return _event_matches_terms(event_type, tags, STARTUP_EVENT_TERMS)


def _is_load_event(event_type: str, tags: list[str]) -> bool:
    return _event_matches_terms(event_type, tags, LOAD_EVENT_TERMS)


def _is_save_reset_event(event_type: str, tags: list[str]) -> bool:
    return _event_matches_terms(event_type, tags, SAVE_RESET_EVENT_TERMS)


def _is_critical_event(event_type: str, tags: list[str]) -> bool:
    return _event_matches_terms(event_type, tags, CRITICAL_EVENT_TERMS)


def _is_error_event(event_type: str, message: str, tags: list[str]) -> bool:
    if _safe_lower(event_type) == "error":
        return True

    message_lower = _safe_lower(message)
    if "error" in message_lower or "exception" in message_lower or "traceback" in message_lower:
        return True

    return any(_safe_lower(tag) == "error" for tag in tags)


def _score_scenario(
    *,
    event_count: int,
    unique_event_type_count: int,
    unique_file_count: int,
    error_count: int,
    is_critical_scenario: bool,
) -> float:
    score = 0.0
    score += min(float(event_count), 20.0) * 0.8
    score += min(float(unique_event_type_count), 10.0) * 1.5
    score += min(float(unique_file_count), 10.0) * 1.2
    score += float(error_count) * 3.0
    if is_critical_scenario:
        score += 5.0
    return round(score, 3)


def build_runtime_scenario_index(repo_root: Path) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    scenario_dir = _scenario_dir(repo_root)
    output: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    if not scenario_dir.exists():
        return output

    for path in sorted(scenario_dir.glob("*_trace.json")):
        data = _read_json(path)
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            continue

        session_id = _safe_text(data.get("session_id", "")) or path.stem
        scenario_name = _safe_text(data.get("scenario_name", "")) or path.stem
        events = data.get("events", [])
        if not isinstance(events, list):
            events = []

        event_types: set[str] = set()
        source_files: set[str] = set()
        tags: set[str] = set()

        error_count = 0
        startup_event_count = 0
        load_event_count = 0
        save_reset_event_count = 0
        critical_event_count = 0

        normalized_events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

        for event in events:
            if not isinstance(event, dict):
                continue

            event_type = _safe_text(event.get("event_type", ""))
            source_file = _safe_text(event.get("source_file", ""))
            source_symbol = _safe_text(event.get("source_symbol", ""))
            message = _safe_text(event.get("message", ""))
            seq = _safe_int(event.get("seq", 0))
            timestamp = _safe_text(event.get("timestamp", ""))

            payload = event.get("payload", {})
            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
                payload = {}

            event_tags = event.get("tags", [])
            if not isinstance(event_tags, list):
                event_tags = []

            normalized_tags = [_safe_text(tag) for tag in event_tags if _safe_text(tag)]

            if event_type:
                event_types.add(event_type)
            if source_file:
                source_files.add(source_file)
            for tag_text in normalized_tags:
                tags.add(tag_text)

            if _is_error_event(event_type, message, normalized_tags):
                error_count += 1
            if _is_startup_event(event_type, normalized_tags):
                startup_event_count += 1
            if _is_load_event(event_type, normalized_tags):
                load_event_count += 1
            if _is_save_reset_event(event_type, normalized_tags):
                save_reset_event_count += 1
            if _is_critical_event(event_type, normalized_tags):
                critical_event_count += 1

            normalized_events.append(
                {
                    "seq": seq,
                    "timestamp": timestamp,
                    "event_type": event_type,
                    "source_file": source_file,
                    "source_symbol": source_symbol,
                    "message": message,
                    "tags": normalized_tags,
                    "payload": payload,
                }
            )

        unique_event_types = sorted(event_types)
        unique_source_files = sorted(source_files)
        unique_tags = sorted(tags)

        is_startup_scenario = startup_event_count > 0
        is_load_scenario = load_event_count > 0
        is_save_reset_scenario = save_reset_event_count > 0
        is_critical_scenario = critical_event_count > 0

        scenario_score = _score_scenario(
            event_count=len(normalized_events),
            unique_event_type_count=len(unique_event_types),
            unique_file_count=len(unique_source_files),
            error_count=error_count,
            is_critical_scenario=is_critical_scenario,
        )

        try:
            trace_file = str(path.relative_to(repo_root)).replace("\\", "/")
        except Exception:
            trace_file = str(path).replace("\\", "/")

        output[session_id] = {
            "session_id": session_id,
            "scenario_name": scenario_name,
            "trace_file": trace_file,
            "trace_version": _safe_text(data.get("trace_version", "")),
            "started_at": _safe_text(data.get("started_at", "")),
            "ended_at": _safe_text(data.get("ended_at", "")),
            "app_entry": _safe_text(data.get("app_entry", "")),
            "event_count": len(normalized_events),
            "event_types": unique_event_types,
            "unique_event_type_count": len(unique_event_types),
            "source_files": unique_source_files,
            "files_touched_count": len(unique_source_files),
            "tags": unique_tags,
            "error_count": error_count,
            "startup_event_count": startup_event_count,
            "load_event_count": load_event_count,
            "save_reset_event_count": save_reset_event_count,
            "critical_event_count": critical_event_count,
            "scenario_score": scenario_score,
            "events": normalized_events,
            "is_startup_scenario": is_startup_scenario,
            "is_load_scenario": is_load_scenario,
            "is_save_reset_scenario": is_save_reset_scenario,
            "is_critical_scenario": is_critical_scenario,
        }

    return dict(sorted(output.items()))


def build_runtime_scenario_summary(
    runtime_scenario_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    event_types: set[str] = set()
    files_touched: set[str] = set()

    total_events = 0
    critical_scenario_count = 0
    startup_scenario_count = 0
    load_scenario_count = 0
    save_reset_scenario_count = 0
    error_scenario_count = 0

    for session_id, payload in runtime_scenario_index.items():
        scenario_event_types = payload.get("event_types", [])
        scenario_files = payload.get("source_files", [])
        if not isinstance(scenario_event_types, list):
            scenario_event_types = []
        if not isinstance(scenario_files, list):
            scenario_files = []

        for item in scenario_event_types:
            text = _safe_text(item)
            if text:
                event_types.add(text)

        for item in scenario_files:
            text = _safe_text(item)
            if text:
                files_touched.add(text)

        total_events += _safe_int(payload.get("event_count", 0))

        if bool(payload.get("is_critical_scenario", False)):
            critical_scenario_count += 1
        if bool(payload.get("is_startup_scenario", False)):
            startup_scenario_count += 1
        if bool(payload.get("is_load_scenario", False)):
            load_scenario_count += 1
        if bool(payload.get("is_save_reset_scenario", False)):
            save_reset_scenario_count += 1
        if _safe_int(payload.get("error_count", 0)) > 0:
            error_scenario_count += 1

        rows.append(
            {
                "session_id": session_id,
                "scenario_name": _safe_text(payload.get("scenario_name", "")),
                "event_count": _safe_int(payload.get("event_count", 0)),
                "unique_event_type_count": _safe_int(
                    payload.get("unique_event_type_count", 0)
                ),
                "files_touched_count": _safe_int(payload.get("files_touched_count", 0)),
                "error_count": _safe_int(payload.get("error_count", 0)),
                "scenario_score": float(payload.get("scenario_score", 0.0)),
                "is_startup_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_startup_scenario", False)),
                "is_load_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_load_scenario", False)),
                "is_save_reset_scenario": bool(
                    payload.get("is_save_reset_scenario", False)
                ),
                "is_critical_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_critical_scenario", False)),
            }
        )

    rows.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -float(item.get("scenario_score", 0.0)),
            item.get("session_id", ""),
        )
    )

    return {
        "scenario_count": len(rows),
        "event_count": total_events,
        "unique_event_type_count": len(event_types),
        "unique_event_types": sorted(event_types),
        "files_touched_by_scenarios": len(files_touched),
        "unique_source_files": sorted(files_touched),
        "critical_scenario_count": critical_scenario_count,
        "startup_scenario_count": startup_scenario_count,
        "load_scenario_count": load_scenario_count,
        "save_reset_scenario_count": save_reset_scenario_count,
        "error_scenario_count": error_scenario_count,
        "scenarios": rows,
    }


def build_runtime_scenario_hotspots(
    runtime_scenario_index: dict[str, dict[str, Any]],
    limit: int = 25,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for session_id, payload in runtime_scenario_index.items():
        rows.append(
            {
                "session_id": session_id,
                "scenario_name": _safe_text(payload.get("scenario_name", "")),
                "trace_file": _safe_text(payload.get("trace_file", "")),
                "event_count": _safe_int(payload.get("event_count", 0)),
                "unique_event_type_count": _safe_int(
                    payload.get("unique_event_type_count", 0)
                ),
                "event_types": list(payload.get("event_types", [])),
                "files_touched_count": _safe_int(payload.get("files_touched_count", 0)),
                "source_files": list(payload.get("source_files", [])),
                "error_count": _safe_int(payload.get("error_count", 0)),
                "scenario_score": float(payload.get("scenario_score", 0.0)),
                "is_startup_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_startup_scenario", False)),
                "is_load_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_load_scenario", False)),
                "is_save_reset_scenario": bool(
                    payload.get("is_save_reset_scenario", False)
                ),
                "is_critical_scenario": bool(payload.get("is_critical_scenario", False)),
            }
        )

    rows.sort(
        key=lambda item: (
            -float(item.get("scenario_score", 0.0)),
            -_safe_int(item.get("error_count", 0)),
            -_safe_int(item.get("files_touched_count", 0)),
            -_safe_int(item.get("event_count", 0)),
            item.get("session_id", ""),
        )
    )

    limit = max(0, _safe_int(limit))
    return rows[:limit]

you prefer calling RuntimeScenarioWriter directly everywhere

If you want, I can now refactor collector_scenario_traces.py into a very clean final facade version so it has one unambiguous purpose.

yes

Use collector_scenario_traces.py as a thin facade over runtime_scenario_writer.py.

That is better than deleting it, because it gives you one stable runtime API for:
start session
log event
finalize session

and keeps the writer class itself low-level and reusable.

Below is a clean final version for direct copy-paste.

developer_tools/project_reasoner/runtime_scenarios/collector_scenario_traces.py

from __future__ import annotations

import atexit
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from developer_tools.project_reasoner.runtime_scenarios.runtime_scenario_writer import (
    RuntimeScenarioWriter,
)


_WRITER: RuntimeScenarioWriter | None = None
_FINALIZED = False


def _safe_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value or "").strip()


def _safe_tags(tags: list[str] | None) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(tags, list):
        return []
    return [_safe_text(tag) for tag in tags if _safe_text(tag)]


def _safe_payload(payload: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return {}
    return dict(payload)


def get_runtime_scenario_writer() -> RuntimeScenarioWriter | None:
    return _WRITER


def has_active_runtime_scenario() -> bool:
    return _WRITER is not None and not _FINALIZED


def start_runtime_scenario(
    scenario_name: str = "manual_app_session",
    app_entry: str = "shell/kanda_main.py",
) -> RuntimeScenarioWriter:
    global _WRITER
    global _FINALIZED

    if _WRITER is not None and not _FINALIZED:
        return _WRITER

    _FINALIZED = False
    _WRITER = RuntimeScenarioWriter(
        scenario_name=_safe_text(scenario_name) or "manual_app_session",
        app_entry=_safe_text(app_entry) or "shell/kanda_main.py",
    )

    _WRITER.add_event(
        event_type="startup",
        source_file=_safe_text(app_entry) or "shell/kanda_main.py",
        source_symbol="start_runtime_scenario",
        message="Runtime scenario session started",
        tags=["startup", "session"],
        payload={},
    )

    atexit.register(finalize_runtime_scenario)
    return _WRITER


def log_runtime_event(
    event_type: str,
    source_file: str,
    source_symbol: str,
    message: str = "",
    tags: list[str] | None = None,
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    writer = start_runtime_scenario()

    writer.add_event(
        event_type=_safe_text(event_type),
        source_file=_safe_text(source_file),
        source_symbol=_safe_text(source_symbol),
        message=_safe_text(message),
        tags=_safe_tags(tags),
        payload=_safe_payload(payload),
    )


def log_runtime_error(
    source_file: str,
    source_symbol: str,
    message: str,
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> None:
    log_runtime_event(
        event_type="error",
        source_file=source_file,
        source_symbol=source_symbol,
        message=message,
        tags=["error"],
        payload=payload,
    )


def finalize_runtime_scenario() -> str:
    global _FINALIZED

    if _FINALIZED:
        if _WRITER is None:
            return ""
        return str(_WRITER.output_path())

    _FINALIZED = True

    if _WRITER is None:
        return ""

    _WRITER.add_event(
        event_type="close_done",
        source_file="shell/kanda_main.py",
        source_symbol="finalize_runtime_scenario",
        message="Runtime scenario session finalized",
        tags=["close", "session"],
        payload={},
    )

    path = _WRITER.finalize()
    return str(path)


def reset_runtime_scenario_state() -> None:
    global _WRITER
    global _FINALIZED

    _WRITER = None
    _FINALIZED = False


def get_runtime_scenario_output_path() -> str:
    writer = get_runtime_scenario_writer()
    if writer is None:
        return ""
    return str(writer.output_path())

Why this version is better

It gives runtime_scenario_writer.py one clear dependency-free responsibility:
write trace files.

It gives collector_scenario_traces.py one clear responsibility:
manage session lifecycle around that writer.

It avoids turning collector_scenario_traces.py into a second analytics module.
That keeps Step 29 clean, because analytics remain only in:
collector_runtime_scenarios.py

Recommended usage

In wrappers like run_kanda_with_coverage.py, use:

from developer_tools.project_reasoner.runtime_scenarios.collector_scenario_traces import (
    finalize_runtime_scenario,
    log_runtime_event,
    start_runtime_scenario,
)

Then:

start_runtime_scenario(
    scenario_name="kanda_app_session",
    app_entry="shell/run_kanda_with_coverage.py",
)

log_runtime_event(
    event_type="startup",
    source_file="shell/run_kanda_with_coverage.py",
    source_symbol="main",
    message="Coverage wrapper entered",
    tags=["startup", "wrapper"],
    payload={},
)

And on exit:

finalize_runtime_scenario()

python -m py_compile "developer_tools\project_reasoner\runtime_scenarios\runtime_scenario_writer.py"

Then run your app wrapper and confirm a file appears in:

developer_tools/project_reasoner/runtime_scenarios

So the final answer is:
do not delete it
keep it
make it a thin facade only
