The remaining message:

Coverage JSON export failed: No source for code: 'E:\eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis\shibokensupport\feature.py'

is separate from that architectural goal.
It means the wrapper/instrumentation split is correct, but coverage JSON export still needs an omit/filter adjustment.

So the architecture objective is achieved.

Current final state

Production path:
python shell\kanda_main.py

Instrumentation path:
python shell\run_kanda_with_coverage.py

This is the correct structure.

If you want, next I can fix the shibokensupport\feature.py coverage export issue so the wrapper also finishes cleanly.

fix the shibokensupport\feature.py

That error happens because Coverage is trying to include a runtime-generated or external shibokensupport module in the JSON export, even though it is not real project source you want indexed.

The clean fix is to tell Coverage to omit it explicitly.

Update shell/run_kanda_with_coverage.py inside _start_coverage().

Replace the current Coverage(...) block with this:

    cov = Coverage(
        data_file=COVERAGE_DATA_FILE,
        source=[str(PROJECT_ROOT)],
        omit=[
            "*/tests/*",
            "*/developer_tools/*",
            "*/older/*",
            "*/chats/*",
            "*/__pycache__/*",
            "*/site-packages/*",
            "*/dist-packages/*",
            "*/shibokensupport/*",
            "shibokensupport/*",
            "*\\shibokensupport\\*",
            "*feature.py",
        ],
    )

Better and safer version

Also add a defensive filter before JSON export, so even if Coverage still records a weird foreign file, it will not break your session.

Replace _write_numbered_json_report() with this version:

def _write_numbered_json_report() -> None:
    if _coverage_instance is None:
        return

    try:
        json_path = _next_json_report_path()
        _coverage_instance.json_report(
            outfile=str(json_path),
            omit=[
                "*/tests/*",
                "*/developer_tools/*",
                "*/older/*",
                "*/chats/*",
                "*/__pycache__/*",
                "*/site-packages/*",
                "*/dist-packages/*",
                "*/shibokensupport/*",
                "shibokensupport/*",
                "*\\shibokensupport\\*",
                "*feature.py",
            ],
        )
        print("Coverage JSON report saved to %s" % json_path)
    except Exception as exc:
        print("Coverage JSON export failed: %s" % exc)

Why this fixes it

Coverage collection itself can still observe imported runtime support modules.
But now:
they are omitted during collection intent,
and omitted again during JSON export,
so they stop poisoning the report.

Best practical result

You keep:
your real app coverage
your runtime scenario trace
your numbered JSON coverage output

And you exclude:
PySide/Shiboken support internals
site-packages noise
non-project foreign files

Validation

Run:

python -m py_compile "shell\run_kanda_with_coverage.py"
python shell\run_kanda_with_coverage.py

Expected result:
no more shibokensupport\feature.py JSON export failure

If it still fails, I’ll give you the stronger fix: filtering measured files before export.

No, that is not the expected final behavior.

What is normal there

Those repeated lines:

[ABORT] No EEG data or timestamps loaded

are just app-side log noise from opening the app without an EEG loaded yet.
They do not mean Project Reasoner is still analyzing the whole project.

These lines are the real end-of-session signals:

Runtime scenario finalized: ...0009_kanda_app_session_trace.json
Coverage saved to E:\eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis\.coverage

So by that point:
the runtime trace was finished
the raw coverage file was saved

What is not normal

This line:

Coverage JSON export failed: No source for code: 'E:\eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis\shibokensupport\feature.py'

means the wrapper did not finish the last export step cleanly.

So if the terminal or UI seems to “keep blinking” or look stuck after close, that is not because the project is still being analyzed in a healthy way.
It is more likely one of these:

the coverage JSON export is failing and leaving the session in an awkward end state
some Qt/matplotlib shutdown activity is still flushing
the console process is still attached briefly while finalization is happening

Important distinction

The big project analysis does not happen when you close run_kanda_with_coverage.py.
That script is mainly:
running the app
collecting runtime trace
collecting coverage

The real large project JSON analysis is done by the data collector, not by simply closing the app.

So the correct answer is:

No, endless blinking after close is not the desired final behavior.
The session mostly finished, but the shutdown is not fully clean because the coverage JSON export is still failing.

What should happen ideally

After closing the app, you should see:
runtime scenario finalized
coverage saved
coverage JSON report saved

and then the process should exit cleanly.

Right now, your shutdown is only partially clean.

Best next move

Apply the omit fix for shibokensupport in run_kanda_with_coverage.py, rerun once, and check whether the last line becomes a successful JSON save instead of that export error. If you want, paste your current _start_coverage() and _write_numbered_json_report() and I’ll rewrite both exactly.

About the “blinking”

What you are seeing during the loaded EEG session is most likely the app continuously redrawing the canvas because timeline/window updates are firing repeatedly.

The repeated lines confirm that:

[STEP 6] Drawing canvas...
[STEP 8] UI widgets refreshed.
[STEP 9] timeline_moved signal emitted.
[✓] EEG plot updated

So the blinking is not “Project Reasoner analyzing the whole project again”.
It is the EEG app itself repeatedly updating the UI and plot.

What is normal

Normal:
app starts
you load EEG
plot refreshes many times
you close app
runtime scenario finalizes
coverage saves
process ends

Not normal:
process never exits
terminal stays hanging indefinitely
same finalization messages repeat forever
CPU remains high after the app closes

From the log you pasted, this run looks normal enough.

One important detail

In this run I do not see:

Coverage JSON report saved to ...

I only see raw coverage saved to .coverage.

So the session is now cleaner, but if you still expect the numbered JSON coverage file, you should verify whether it is being written into:

LOGIC_MAIN_APP\project_jsons

If it is there, all good.
If not, the wrapper is still only partially finishing the coverage-export path, though it is no longer failing noisily.

If you want, the next best step is to isolate whether that 0xc0000139 crash comes from pyarrow specifically and remove it from this EEG runtime path.

Yes. That is the right next step.

0xc0000139 on Windows usually means a native DLL symbol/load problem, and in your trace the first suspicious native import path is:

pyarrow -> pandas -> mne

So the goal is:

confirm whether pyarrow is the trigger
then stop this EEG runtime path from touching pyarrow at all

Do these checks in order.

First, confirm whether pyarrow itself is broken in this env:

python -c "import pyarrow; print(pyarrow.__version__)"

Then check whether plain pandas works:

python -c "import pandas as pd; print(pd.__version__)"

Then check whether pandas is what triggers pyarrow import pressure:

python -c "import pandas; import pandas.compat.pyarrow as m; print('OK', getattr(m, '__file__', 'NOFILE'))"

Then check whether MNE soft-importing pandas is enough to reproduce it:

python -c "from mne.utils.check import _check_pandas_installed; print(_check_pandas_installed())"

How to read the results

If import pyarrow crashes:
the problem is definitely pyarrow

If import pandas crashes but pyarrow is in the stack:
pandas is pulling in broken pyarrow

If both work in isolation but the app still throws 0xc0000139:
the issue may be a mixed DLL/runtime conflict during the EEG path, but pyarrow is still the first thing to exclude

Fastest practical fix

Since your project no longer wants Parquet and is using HDF5, the simplest fix is:

remove pyarrow from this environment, or
prevent pandas from importing it

Best low-risk test:

pip uninstall pyarrow -y

Then rerun:

python -c "import pandas as pd; print(pd.__version__)"
python shell\run_kanda_with_coverage.py

Why this is a good test

Pandas does not require pyarrow for normal DataFrame usage.
If your EEG runtime path only needs pandas and HDF5, removing pyarrow is often the cleanest way to eliminate this Windows native crash source.

If you prefer not uninstalling yet, do a temporary proof test by renaming the package folder in the env if it exists, but uninstall is cleaner.

Yes — this is not a PyCharm visibility problem.

It is a mixed-package conflict inside the same Conda env.

What your output shows

You have both:

pyarrow 21.0.0 from pip
and
pyarrow-core 16.1.0 from conda-forge

That is the problem.

Python is importing:

E:\mne_py3.10\lib\site-packages\pyarrow\__init__.py

So it is seeing the pip-installed pyarrow package, but its native DLL stack does not match the Conda Arrow libraries already in the env.

That is why you get:

ImportError: DLL load failed while importing lib: The specified procedure could not be found.

So the real issue is:

pip pyarrow==21.0.0
mixed with
conda pyarrow-core/libarrow==16.1.0

Those versions are incompatible.

Best fix for your project

Since your project does not want Parquet anymore and is using HDF5, the cleanest fix is:

remove pip pyarrow

Use:

pip uninstall pyarrow -y

Then verify:

python -c "import importlib.util; s = importlib.util.find_spec('pyarrow'); print(s.origin if s else 'NOT_FOUND')"
python -c "import pandas as pd; print(pd.__version__)"

Then rerun the app.

Why this is the best choice

You do not need pyarrow for normal pandas usage in this EEG workflow.
So removing the broken pip package is simpler and safer than trying to reconcile Arrow versions.

Important point

PyCharm is not the root cause here.
If PyCharm uses interpreter E:\mne_py3.10\python.exe, it will see the same broken package state as your terminal.

So the issue is in the env itself, not in PyCharm.

If you wanted to keep pyarrow later

Then you would need a version-consistent setup, for example all from Conda, not mixed Conda core + pip pyarrow.
But for your current app, that is unnecessary complexity.

Recommended next exact steps

pip uninstall pyarrow -y
python -c "import importlib.util; s = importlib.util.find_spec('pyarrow'); print(s.origin if s else 'NOT_FOUND')"
python -c "import pandas as pd; print(pd.__version__)"
python shell\run_kanda_with_coverage.py

def _safe_float(val: Any) -> float | str:
    try:
        if np.isscalar(val) and np.isfinite(val):
            return float(np.round(val, 3))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return "NV"


def _safe_nperseg(x: np.ndarray, n_fft: int) -> int:
    if len(x) <= 0:
        return 1
    return max(1, min(int(n_fft), len(x)))


def min_val(x):
    return np.min(x)


def max_val(x):

def mean(x):

def median(x):

def mode_val(x):

        return np.nan

def variance(x):

def coefficient_of_variation(x):

    return np.std(x) / m if m != 0 else np.nan


def start_amp(x):

def end_amp(x):

def end_start_diff(x):

def peak_to_peak_amplitude(x):
    return np.ptp(x) if len(x) > 0 else np.nan


def average_amplitude_change(x):

def std_dev(x):
    return np.std(x)


def mad(x):

def iqr(x):
    return np.percentile(x, 75) - np.percentile(x, 25)


def ptp(x):
    return np.ptp(x)


def rms(x):
    return np.sqrt(np.mean(x ** 2))


def interquartile_range_coefficient_of_dispersion(x):
    med = median(x)
    return iqr(x) / (2 * med) if med != 0 else np.nan


def skew(x):

def kurtosis(x):

def asymmetry_coefficient(x):

    std_val_local = np.std(x)
    return np.mean(((x - mean_val_local) / std_val_local) ** 3) if std_val_local != 0 else np.nan


def excess_kurtosis(x):

def zero_crossings(x):

def zc_rate(x, sfreq):
    return zero_crossings(x) / (len(x) - 1) * sfreq if len(x) >= 2 else np.nan


def phase_entropy(x):
    analytic_signal = hilbert(x)
    phase = np.angle(analytic_signal)
    hist, _ = np.histogram(phase, bins="auto", density=True)
    hist = hist[hist > 0]
    if len(hist) == 0:
        return 0.0
    return -np.sum(hist * np.log2(hist))


def power_spectral_density(x, sfreq, fmin=0.5, fmax=45, n_fft=2048):
    x = np.asarray(x)
    if x.ndim != 1 or len(x) == 0:
        return np.array([]), np.array([])
    freqs, psd = psd_welch(x, fs=sfreq, nperseg=_safe_nperseg(x, n_fft))
    idx = np.logical_and(freqs >= fmin, freqs <= fmax)
    return freqs[idx], psd[idx]


def relative_power(x, sfreq, freq_bands):
    freqs, psd = power_spectral_density(x, sfreq)
    total_power = np.sum(psd)
    if total_power <= 0:
        return {band: np.nan for band in freq_bands}
    out = {}
    for band, (fmin, fmax) in freq_bands.items():
        mask = np.logical_and(freqs >= fmin, freqs <= fmax)
        out[band] = np.sum(psd[mask]) / total_power
    return out


def peak_frequency_width(x, sfreq, fmin=0.5, fmax=45, n_fft=2048):
    freqs, psd = power_spectral_density(x, sfreq, fmin, fmax, n_fft)
    if len(psd) == 0:
        return np.nan
    peak_idx = int(np.argmax(psd))
    half_max = psd[peak_idx] / 2.0
    left_idx = np.argmin(np.abs(psd[:peak_idx + 1] - half_max))
    right_idx = peak_idx + np.argmin(np.abs(psd[peak_idx:] - half_max))
    return freqs[right_idx] - freqs[left_idx]


def spectral_entropy(x, sfreq, n_fft=2048):
    freqs, psd = power_spectral_density(x, sfreq, n_fft=n_fft)
    if len(psd) == 0 or np.sum(psd) <= 0:
        return 0.0
    psd_norm = psd / np.sum(psd)
    psd_norm = psd_norm[psd_norm > 0]
    return -np.sum(psd_norm * np.log2(psd_norm)) if len(psd_norm) > 0 else 0.0


def spectral_centroid(x, sfreq, n_fft=2048):
    freqs, psd = power_spectral_density(x, sfreq, n_fft=n_fft)
    return np.sum(freqs * psd) / np.sum(psd) if np.sum(psd) > 0 else np.nan


def spectral_bandwidth(x, sfreq, n_fft=2048):
    freqs, psd = power_spectral_density(x, sfreq, n_fft=n_fft)
    centroid = spectral_centroid(x, sfreq, n_fft)
    return np.sqrt(np.sum(((freqs - centroid) ** 2) * psd) / np.sum(psd)) if np.sum(psd) > 0 else np.nan


def time_frequency_analysis(
    x: np.ndarray,
    sfreq: float,
    freqs: np.ndarray = np.arange(1, 30, 1),
    n_cycles: int = 7,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    x = np.asarray(x)
    if x.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("Input must be a 1D signal.")
    x_reshaped = x[np.newaxis, np.newaxis, :]
    power = tfr_array_morlet(
        x_reshaped,
        sfreq,
        freqs,
        n_cycles=n_cycles,
        output="power",
        zero_mean=True,
    )
    times = np.arange(x.shape[0]) / sfreq
    return freqs, times, power[0, 0]


def entropy(x):
    if len(x) < 2 or np.all(x == x[0]):
        return 0.0
    px = np.abs(x) / np.sum(np.abs(x))
    px = px[px > 0]
    return -np.sum(px * np.log2(px))


def sample_entropy(x):
    if len(x) <= 10:
        return np.nan

    ant = _import_antropy()

    try:
        return ant.sample_entropy(x)
    except TypeError as exc:
        if "unexpected keyword argument 'r'" in str(exc):
            r_val = 0.2 * np.std(x)
            if r_val <= 0:
                return 0.0
            try:
                return ant.sample_entropy(x, r=r_val)
            except Exception:
                return np.nan
        return np.nan
    except Exception:
        return np.nan


def wavelet_entropy(x, wavelet="db4", level=None, normalize=True):
    coeffs = pywt.wavedec(x, wavelet, level=level)
    energies = []
    total_energy = 0.0
    for coeff in coeffs:
        energy = np.sum(coeff ** 2)
        energies.append(energy)
        total_energy += energy

    if total_energy == 0:
        return 0.0

    probabilities = np.array(energies) / total_energy
    probabilities = probabilities[probabilities > 0]
    entropy_value = -np.sum(probabilities * np.log2(probabilities))

    if normalize:
        max_entropy = np.log2(len(energies)) if len(energies) > 1 else 1.0
        return entropy_value / max_entropy if max_entropy > 0 else 0.0
    return entropy_value


def lzcr(x):

    ant = _import_antropy()
    try:

    except Exception:

def hjorth_mobility(x):
    if len(x) < 2 or np.var(x) == 0:
        return np.nan
    return np.sqrt(np.var(np.diff(x)) / np.var(x))


def hjorth_complexity(x):
    if len(x) < 3:
        return np.nan
    mob = hjorth_mobility(x)
    return hjorth_mobility(np.diff(x)) / mob if mob and not np.isnan(mob) else np.nan


def permutation_entropy(x, order=3, delay=1, normalize=True):
    try:
        x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
        n = len(x)
        if n < order * delay:
            return np.nan

        permutations = np.zeros((n - (order - 1) * delay, order), dtype=np.int64)
        for i in range(n - (order - 1) * delay):
            segment = x[i:i + order * delay:delay]
            permutations[i] = np.argsort(segment)

        _, counts = np.unique(permutations, axis=0, return_counts=True)
        probs = counts / counts.sum()
        pe = -np.sum(probs * np.log(probs + np.finfo(float).eps))

        if normalize:
            pe /= np.log(factorial(order))
        return float(pe)

    except Exception as exc:
        logger.debug("permutation_entropy failed: %s", exc)
        return np.nan


def detrended_fluctuation_analysis(x, nvals=None):
    try:
        return dfa(x, nvals=nvals)
    except Exception:
        return np.nan


def lyapunov_exponent(x, emb_dim=10, tau=1, min_tsep=10, maxtsep=20):
    try:
        lyap_vals = nolds.lyap_e(
            x,
            emb_dim=emb_dim,
            tau=tau,
            min_tsep=min_tsep,
            maxtsep=maxtsep,
        )
        return float(lyap_vals[0]) if isinstance(lyap_vals, (list, np.ndarray)) else float(lyap_vals)
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.debug("lyapunov_exponent failed: %s", exc)
        return np.nan


def higuchi_fractal_dimension(x, k_max=10):
    n = len(x)
    if n < 4:
        return np.nan
    lk = np.zeros(k_max)
    for k in range(1, k_max + 1):
        lm = np.zeros(k)
        for m in range(k):
            i = np.arange(1, int(np.floor((n - m - 1) / k) + 1))
            if len(i) == 0:
                continue
            lm[m] = np.sum(np.abs(x[m + i * k] - x[m + (i - 1) * k])) * (n - 1) / (i[-1] * k * k)
        lk[k - 1] = np.mean(lm)
    valid = lk > 0
    if np.sum(valid) < 2:
        return np.nan
    return np.polyfit(np.log(1 / np.arange(1, k_max + 1)[valid]), np.log(lk[valid]), 1)[0]


def multiscale_entropy(x, scales):
    mse_values = []
    for scale in scales:
        if scale <= 0:
            mse_values.append(np.nan)
            continue
        trimmed = x[: len(x) // scale * scale]
        if len(trimmed) == 0:
            mse_values.append(np.nan)
            continue
        coarse = np.mean(np.split(trimmed, len(trimmed) // scale), axis=1)
        mse_values.append(sample_entropy(coarse))
    return mse_values


def approximate_entropy(x, m=2, r=None):
    if r is None:
        r = 0.2 * np.std(x)
    n = len(x)
    if n < m + 1:
        return np.nan

    def _phi(m_val):
        patterns = [tuple(x[i:i + m_val]) for i in range(n - m_val + 1)]
        count = 0
        for i in range(n - m_val + 1):
            match = 0
            for j in range(n - m_val + 1):
                if np.max(np.abs(np.array(patterns[i]) - np.array(patterns[j]))) <= r:
                    match += 1
            count += (match - 1 if m_val == m else match)
        return np.log(count / (n - m_val + 1)) if count > 0 else 0

    return _phi(m) - _phi(m + 1)


def spike_energy(x):
    return np.sum(np.abs(x))


def slope(x):
    if len(x) < 2 or not np.all(np.isfinite(x)) or np.all(x == x[0]):
        return np.nan
    return np.polyfit(np.arange(len(x)), x, 1)[0]


def energy_envelope(x):

def root_mean_square_amplitude(x):

def coherence(x, y, sfreq, fmin=0.5, fmax=45, n_fft=2048):
    f, cxy = signal_coherence(x, y, fs=sfreq, nperseg=_safe_nperseg(np.asarray(x), n_fft))
    idx = np.logical_and(f >= fmin, f <= fmax)
    return f[idx], cxy[idx]


def phase_locking_value(x, y, sfreq, freq_bands, n_fft=2048):
    _ = sfreq
    _ = freq_bands
    _ = n_fft
    analytic_signal1 = hilbert(x)
    analytic_signal2 = hilbert(y)
    phase_diff = np.angle(analytic_signal1) - np.angle(analytic_signal2)
    plv = np.abs(np.mean(np.exp(1j * phase_diff)))
    return {"global": plv}


def cross_correlation(x, y, max_lag):
    n = len(x)
    if len(y) != n:
        raise ValueError("Signals must have the same length.")
    correlation = np.correlate(x - np.mean(x), y - np.mean(y), mode="full") / (np.std(x) * np.std(y) * n)
    lags = np.arange(-max_lag, max_lag + 1)
    return lags, correlation[n - 1 - max_lag:n + max_lag]


def transfer_function_gain(x, y, sfreq, fmin=0.5, fmax=45, n_fft=2048):
    try:
        fx, px = power_spectral_density(x, sfreq, fmin, fmax, n_fft)
        fy, py = power_spectral_density(y, sfreq, fmin, fmax, n_fft)
        if len(fx) == 0 or len(fy) == 0:
            return np.array([]), np.array([]), np.array([])
        min_len = min(len(px), len(py))
        gain = np.divide(py[:min_len], px[:min_len], out=np.full(min_len, np.nan), where=px[:min_len] != 0)
        return fx[:min_len], gain.astype(complex), np.abs(gain)
    except Exception:
        return np.array([]), np.array([]), np.array([])


def generalized_synchronization_index(x, y, emb_dim=10, lag=1, epsilon=None):
    _ = emb_dim
    _ = lag
    NearestNeighbors = _import_nearest_neighbors()

    n = len(x)
    if len(y) != n:
        raise ValueError("Signals must have the same length.")

    if epsilon is None:
        epsilon = 0.1 * np.std(np.concatenate((x, y)))

    knn = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=1, metric="euclidean")
    knn.fit(y.reshape(-1, 1))
    distances_yx, _ = knn.kneighbors(x.reshape(-1, 1))
    c_val = np.mean(np.heaviside(epsilon - distances_yx.flatten(), 0))

    knn.fit(x.reshape(-1, 1))
    distances_xy, _ = knn.kneighbors(y.reshape(-1, 1))
    l_val = np.mean(np.heaviside(epsilon - distances_xy.flatten(), 0))

    return np.sqrt(c_val * l_val)


def hemispheric_asymmetry(left_ch_data, right_ch_data, sfreq, freq_bands):
    freqs, psd_left = power_spectral_density(left_ch_data, sfreq)
    _, psd_right = power_spectral_density(right_ch_data, sfreq)
    asymmetry = {}
    for band, (fmin, fmax) in freq_bands.items():
        idx = np.logical_and(freqs >= fmin, freqs <= fmax)
        power_left = np.sum(psd_left[idx])
        power_right = np.sum(psd_right[idx])
        denom = power_left + power_right
        asymmetry[band] = (power_left - power_right) / denom if denom != 0 else np.nan
    return asymmetry


def normalized_cross_correlation(x, y, max_lag):
    n = len(x)
    if len(y) != n:
        raise ValueError("The signals must have the same length.")
    correlation = correlate(x, y, mode="full")
    lags = np.arange(-max_lag, max_lag + 1)
    segment = correlation[n - 1 - max_lag:n + max_lag]
    norm_x = np.sqrt(np.sum(x ** 2))
    norm_y = np.sqrt(np.sum(y ** 2))
    if norm_x == 0 or norm_y == 0:
        return lags, np.zeros_like(segment)
    return lags, segment / (norm_x * norm_y)


def transfer_entropy(x, y, k=3, delay=1):
    NearestNeighbors = _import_nearest_neighbors()

    n = len(x)
    if n <= k + delay:
        return np.nan

    def get_neighbors(data, k_neighbors):
        knn = NearestNeighbors(n_neighbors=k_neighbors)
        knn.fit(data)
        distances, _ = knn.kneighbors()
        return distances

    x_hist = np.array([x[i:i + k] for i in range(n - k - delay + 1)])
    y_hist = np.array([y[i:i + k] for i in range(n - k - delay + 1)])
    y_next = np.array([y[i + delay:i + k + delay] for i in range(n - k - delay + 1)])

    d_y_next = get_neighbors(y_next, k)
    d_xy = get_neighbors(np.hstack((x_hist, y_hist)), k)
    d_x_y_next = get_neighbors(np.hstack((x_hist, y_next)), k)

    def log_ratio(dist1, dist2):
        nz1 = dist1[dist1 > 0]
        nz2 = dist2[dist2 > 0]
        if len(nz1) < k or len(nz2) < k:
            return 0.0
        return np.mean(np.log(nz1[:, -1] / nz2[:, -1]))

    return log_ratio(d_xy, d_x_y_next) - log_ratio(d_y_next, y_hist)


def epoching(data, timestamps, event_timestamp, pre_event_ms, post_event_ms, sfreq):
    pre_samples = int(pre_event_ms * sfreq / 1000)
    post_samples = int(post_event_ms * sfreq / 1000)
    event_idx = np.argmin(np.abs(timestamps - event_timestamp))
    start_idx = int(event_idx - pre_samples)
    end_idx = int(event_idx + post_samples + 1)

    if start_idx >= 0 and end_idx <= len(data):
        return data[start_idx:end_idx]
    return None


def averaging(epochs):
    if epochs and len(epochs) > 0:
        valid_epochs = [epoch for epoch in epochs if epoch is not None]
        if valid_epochs:
            return np.mean(np.array(valid_epochs), axis=0)
    return None


def find_peak_latency_amplitude(erp, sfreq, time_window_ms, expected_peak_polarity="positive"):
    _ = sfreq
    time = np.linspace(-time_window_ms[0], time_window_ms[1], len(erp)) / 1000
    start_index = np.argmin(np.abs(time * 1000 - time_window_ms[0]))
    end_index = np.argmin(np.abs(time * 1000 - time_window_ms[1]))
    segment = erp[start_index:end_index]
    time_segment = time[start_index:end_index]

    peak_index_local = np.argmax(segment) if expected_peak_polarity == "positive" else np.argmin(segment)
    peak_amplitude = segment[peak_index_local]
    peak_latency = time_segment[peak_index_local] * 1000
    return peak_latency, peak_amplitude


def analyze_p300(erp, sfreq, time_window_ms=(250, 500)):
    return find_peak_latency_amplitude(erp, sfreq, time_window_ms, expected_peak_polarity="positive")


def area_under_curve(erp, time):
    return np.trapz(erp, time)


def half_width_half_maximum(erp, time, peak_latency, expected_peak_polarity="positive"):
    peak_index = np.argmin(np.abs(time - peak_latency / 1000))
    peak_amplitude = erp[peak_index]
    half_amplitude = peak_amplitude / 2.0

    if expected_peak_polarity == "positive":
        above_half = np.where(erp >= half_amplitude)[0]
    else:
        above_half = np.where(erp <= half_amplitude)[0]

    if len(above_half) < 2:
        return np.nan

    left_index = above_half[above_half < peak_index][-1] if any(above_half < peak_index) else 0
    right_index = above_half[above_half > peak_index][0] if any(above_half > peak_index) else len(erp) - 1
    return (time[right_index] - time[left_index]) * 1000


def instantaneous_frequency(x, sfreq):
    analytic_signal = hilbert(x)
    instantaneous_phase = np.unwrap(np.angle(analytic_signal))
    return np.diff(instantaneous_phase) / (2.0 * np.pi) * sfreq


def dominant_frequency(x, sfreq, fmin=0.5, fmax=45, n_fft=2048):
    try:
        x = np.asarray(x)
        psd, freqs = psd_array_welch(
            x,
            sfreq=sfreq,
            fmin=fmin,
            fmax=fmax,
            n_fft=min(n_fft, len(x)) if len(x) > 0 else 1,
            n_overlap=min(n_fft // 2, max(len(x) - 1, 0)),
            verbose=False,
        )
        if len(psd) > 0:
            return freqs[int(np.argmax(psd))]
        return np.nan
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.debug("dominant_frequency failed: %s", exc)
        return np.nan


def dominant_frequency_std(x_segments, sfreq, fmin=0.5, fmax=45, n_fft=2048):
    dominant_frequencies = [dominant_frequency(seg, sfreq, fmin, fmax, n_fft) for seg in x_segments]
    dominant_frequencies = [f for f in dominant_frequencies if not np.isnan(f)]
    return np.std(dominant_frequencies) if dominant_frequencies else np.nan


def percentiles(x, percentiles_list):
    return np.percentile(x, percentiles_list)


def skewness_per_band(x, sfreq, freq_bands, n_fft=2048):
    freqs, psd = power_spectral_density(x, sfreq, n_fft=n_fft)
    out = {}
    for band, (fmin, fmax) in freq_bands.items():
        idx = np.logical_and(freqs >= fmin, freqs <= fmax)
        power_in_band = psd[idx]
        out[band] = sp_stats.skew(power_in_band) if len(power_in_band) > 1 else np.nan
    return out


def kurtosis_per_band(x, sfreq, freq_bands, n_fft=2048):
    freqs, psd = power_spectral_density(x, sfreq, n_fft=n_fft)
    out = {}
    for band, (fmin, fmax) in freq_bands.items():
        idx = np.logical_and(freqs >= fmin, freqs <= fmax)
        power_in_band = psd[idx]
        out[band] = sp_stats.kurtosis(power_in_band) if len(power_in_band) > 1 else np.nan
    return out


def robust_std_dev(x):
    return sp_stats.median_abs_deviation(x, scale="normal")


def robust_mean(x):
    return np.median(x)


def robust_interquartile_range(x):
    return iqr(x)


def trimmed_mean(x, trim_fraction=0.1):
    return sp_stats.trim_mean(x, trim_fraction)


def global_field_power(data):
    return np.std(data, axis=0) if getattr(data, "ndim", 1) > 1 else np.nan


def dissimilarity_index(data1, data2):
    data1 = np.asarray(data1)
    data2 = np.asarray(data2)
    if data1.shape != data2.shape:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must have the same shape")
    norm1 = (data1 - np.mean(data1)) / np.std(data1)
    norm2 = (data2 - np.mean(data2)) / np.std(data2)
    return float(np.mean((norm1 - norm2) ** 2))


def phase_synchronization_index(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> float:
    if x.shape != y.shape:
        raise ValueError("Signals must have the same shape.")
    analytic_x = hilbert(x)
    analytic_y = hilbert(y)
    phase_diff = np.angle(analytic_x) - np.angle(analytic_y)
    return float(np.abs(np.mean(np.exp(1j * phase_diff))))


def phase_coherence(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> float:
    if x.shape != y.shape:
        raise ValueError("Signals must have the same shape")
    analytic_x = hilbert(x)
    analytic_y = hilbert(y)
    phase_diff = np.angle(analytic_x) - np.angle(analytic_y)
    return float(np.abs(np.mean(np.exp(1j * phase_diff))))


def detect_artifacts(signal: np.ndarray, threshold: float = 100.0) -> float:
    signal = np.asarray(signal)
    if signal.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("Input signal must be a 1D array.")
    artifact_mask = np.abs(signal) > threshold
    return float(np.sum(artifact_mask) / len(signal))


def signal_quality(signal: np.ndarray, threshold: float = 100.0) -> float:
    signal = np.asarray(signal)
    if signal.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("Input signal must be a 1D array.")
    clean_mask = np.abs(signal) <= threshold
    return float(np.sum(clean_mask) / len(signal))


def compute_pca(signal: np.ndarray, n_components: int = 3) -> np.ndarray:
    PCA = _import_pca()

    signal = np.asarray(signal)
    if signal.ndim == 1:
        raise ValueError("Input signal must be 2D (n_channels x n_times) for PCA.")
    if signal.shape[0] < n_components:
        raise ValueError("Number of channels is less than requested PCA components.")

    pca = PCA(n_components=n_components)
    pca.fit(signal)
    return pca.explained_variance_ratio_


def compute_ica(signal: np.ndarray, sfreq: float = 256.0, n_components: int = 5) -> np.ndarray:
    signal = np.asarray(signal)
    if signal.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Input signal must be 2D (n_channels x n_times).")

    n_channels, _ = signal.shape
    ch_names = [f"EEG {i}" for i in range(n_channels)]
    info = mne.create_info(ch_names=ch_names, sfreq=sfreq, ch_types="eeg")
    raw = mne.io.RawArray(signal, info)

    ica = mne.preprocessing.ICA(n_components=n_components, random_state=97, max_iter="auto")
    ica.fit(raw)

    components = ica.get_sources(raw).get_data()
    var_total = np.var(signal, axis=1).sum()
    var_components = np.var(components, axis=1)
    explained_ratio = var_components / var_total if var_total != 0 else np.full(len(var_components), np.nan)
    return explained_ratio[:n_components]


def microstate_analysis(signal: np.ndarray, n_states: int = 4) -> dict:
    KMeans = _import_kmeans()

    if signal.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Input signal must be 2D (n_channels x n_times)")

    data = signal.T
    n_times, _ = data.shape

    gfp = np.std(data, axis=1)
    peaks, _ = find_peaks(gfp, height=np.percentile(gfp, 75))

    if len(peaks) < n_states:
        raise ValueError(f"Only {len(peaks)} GFP peaks found. Need at least {n_states}.")

    peak_data = data[peaks]
    kmeans = KMeans(
        n_clusters=n_states,
        init="k-means++",
        n_init=20,
        max_iter=500,
        random_state=42,
    ).fit(peak_data)

    centroids = kmeans.cluster_centers_
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(data, centroids.T)
    labels = np.argmax(corr_matrix[:n_times, n_times:], axis=1)
    coverage = np.bincount(labels, minlength=n_states) / n_times * 100

    return {
        "maps": centroids.T,
        "labels": labels,
        "coverage": coverage,
        "gfp": gfp,
        "peaks": peaks,
    }


def topographic_variance(signal: np.ndarray) -> float:
    signal = np.asarray(signal)
    if signal.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Signal must be a 2D array (n_channels x n_times)")
    spatial_var = np.var(signal, axis=0)
    return float(np.mean(spatial_var))

def compute_all(matrix_2d, channel_names, sfreq=1000):
    results = {}

    pd = None
    try:
        pd = _import_pandas()
    except Exception:
        pd = None

    if pd is not None and isinstance(matrix_2d, pd.DataFrame):
        data_values = matrix_2d.values
    else:
        data_values = matrix_2d

    for i, ch in enumerate(channel_names):
        ch_stats = {}
        for _category, metrics in EEG_STAT_FUNCTIONS.items():
            for name, metric in metrics.items():
                try:
                    channel_data = data_values[i] if len(data_values.shape) > 1 else data_values

                    if name == "Zcross/s":
                        val = metric["func"](channel_data, sfreq)
                    else:
                        val = metric["func"](channel_data)

                    ch_stats[name] = _safe_float(val)

                except Exception as exc:
                    logger.debug("Error computing %s for channel %s: %s", name, ch, exc)
                    ch_stats[name] = "NV"

        results[ch] = ch_stats

    return results


def check_metric_names_match(table_instance):
    if not hasattr(table_instance, "df") or table_instance.df.empty:
        logger.debug("DataFrame is empty or not available")
        return

    df_columns = table_instance.df.columns.tolist()
    stat_functions = EEG_STAT_FUNCTIONS.keys()

    matches = set(df_columns) & set(stat_functions)
    missing_in_stats = set(df_columns) - set(stat_functions)
    missing_in_df = set(stat_functions) - set(df_columns)

    logger.debug("Perfect matches: %s", len(matches))
    logger.debug("Columns missing in EEG_STAT_FUNCTIONS: %s", len(missing_in_stats))
    logger.debug("Metrics missing in DataFrame: %s", len(missing_in_df))


def microvolts_amplitude_calc(data: np.ndarray, sensors: list[str]):
    stats_results = []

    for i, signal in enumerate(data):
        ch_stats = {}
        try:
            ch_stats["min"] = np.min(signal)
            ch_stats["max"] = np.max(signal)
            ch_stats["mean"] = np.mean(signal)
            ch_stats["median"] = np.median(signal)
            ch_stats["mode"] = sp_stats.mode(signal, keepdims=True)[0][0] if len(signal) > 0 else np.nan
            ch_stats["var"] = np.var(signal)
            ch_stats["std"] = np.std(signal)
            ch_stats["mad"] = sp_stats.median_abs_deviation(signal, scale="normal")
            ch_stats["iqr"] = np.percentile(signal, 75) - np.percentile(signal, 25)
            ch_stats["ptp"] = np.ptp(signal)
            ch_stats["rms"] = np.sqrt(np.mean(signal ** 2))
            ch_stats["cv"] = ch_stats["std"] / ch_stats["mean"] if ch_stats["mean"] != 0 else np.nan
            ch_stats["robust_std"] = ch_stats["mad"]
            ch_stats["robust_mean"] = ch_stats["median"]
            ch_stats["robust_iqr"] = ch_stats["iqr"]
            ch_stats["trimmed_mean"] = sp_stats.trim_mean(signal, 0.1)
            ch_stats["percentile_5"] = np.percentile(signal, 5)
            ch_stats["percentile_95"] = np.percentile(signal, 95)
            ch_stats["iqr_med_ratio"] = ch_stats["iqr"] / (2 * ch_stats["median"]) if ch_stats["median"] != 0 else np.nan
            ch_stats["skew"] = sp_stats.skew(signal)
            ch_stats["kurtosis"] = sp_stats.kurtosis(signal)
            mean_val_local = ch_stats["mean"]
            std_val_local = ch_stats["std"]
            ch_stats["asymmetry_coeff"] = (
                np.mean(((signal - mean_val_local) / std_val_local) ** 3) if std_val_local != 0 else np.nan
            )
            ch_stats["excess_kurtosis"] = ch_stats["kurtosis"] - 3
            ch_stats["start_amp"] = signal[0] if len(signal) > 0 else np.nan
            ch_stats["end_amp"] = signal[-1] if len(signal) > 0 else np.nan
            ch_stats["end_start_diff"] = ch_stats["end_amp"] - ch_stats["start_amp"]
            ch_stats["avg_delta"] = np.mean(np.abs(np.diff(signal))) if len(signal) >= 2 else np.nan
            ch_stats["slope"] = np.polyfit(np.arange(len(signal)), signal, 1)[0] if len(signal) >= 2 else np.nan
            ch_stats["spike_energy"] = np.sum(np.abs(signal))
            ch_stats["energy_envelope"] = np.sum(signal ** 2)

        except Exception as exc:
            logger.debug("Failed to compute stats for sensor %s: %s", sensors[i], exc)
            for key in [
                "min",
                "max",
                "mean",
                "median",
                "mode",
                "var",
                "std",
                "mad",
                "iqr",
                "ptp",
                "rms",
                "cv",
                "robust_std",
                "robust_mean",
                "robust_iqr",
                "trimmed_mean",
                "percentile_5",
                "percentile_95",
                "iqr_med_ratio",
                "skew",
                "kurtosis",
                "asymmetry_coeff",
                "excess_kurtosis",
                "start_amp",
                "end_amp",
                "end_start_diff",
                "avg_delta",
                "slope",
                "spike_energy",
                "energy_envelope",
            ]:
                ch_stats[key] = np.nan

        stats_results.append(ch_stats)

    pd = _import_pandas()
    stats_df = pd.DataFrame(stats_results, index=sensors)
    logger.debug("Returning stats DataFrame with shape: %s", stats_df.shape)
    return stats_df

from v10_model_registry import LocalModelRegistry
from v10_models import ConversationTurn, RetrievalBundle
from v10_prompt_builder import PromptBuilder
from v10_retriever import ProjectRetriever


def shorten_path(path: str, max_len: int = 90) -> str:
    if len(path) <= max_len:
        return path
    return "..." + path[-(max_len - 3):]


class JsonProjectReasonerV9(QMainWindow):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Project JSON Explorer V10 - Local AI Reasoner")
        self.resize(1880, 1080)

        self.project_index = JsonProjectIndex()
        self.retriever = ProjectRetriever(self.project_index)
        self.prompt_builder = PromptBuilder()
        self.ai = LocalAIReasoner()
        self.memory = ConversationMemory()
        self.model_registry = LocalModelRegistry()

        self._last_bundle = RetrievalBundle([], [], [])
        self._last_prompt = ""
        self._last_selected_model = ""
        self._pending_question = ""

        self.json_path_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.question_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.cache_dir_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.governance_path_edit = QLineEdit()

        self.model_combo = QComboBox()
        self.refresh_models_button = QPushButton("Refresh Models")

        self.load_button = QPushButton("Load JSON")
        self.ask_ai_button = QPushButton("Ask Local AI")
        self.clear_button = QPushButton("Clear")
        self.clear_memory_button = QPushButton("Clear Memory")
        self.pick_cache_dir_button = QPushButton("Set Cache Dir")
        self.pick_governance_button = QPushButton("Set Governance State")

        self.quick_startup_button = QPushButton("Explain startup chain")
        self.quick_topomap_button = QPushButton("Explain topomap chain")
        self.quick_timeline_button = QPushButton("Explain timeline chain")
        self.quick_responsibility_button = QPushButton("Responsibility map")
        self.quick_uncertainty_button = QPushButton("Uncertainty report")

        self.file_evidence_list = QListWidget()
        self.symbol_evidence_list = QListWidget()
        self.history_list = QListWidget()

        self.detail_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.detail_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self.answer_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.answer_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self.prompt_preview = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.prompt_preview.setReadOnly(True)

        self.log_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()
        self.refresh_models()

    def _on_ai_token_ready(self, token: str) -> None:
        current = self.answer_box.toPlainText()
        if current == "[Streaming...]\n\n":
            self.answer_box.setPlainText("")
        cursor = self.answer_box.textCursor()
        cursor.movePosition(cursor.End)
        cursor.insertText(token)
        self.answer_box.setTextCursor(cursor)
        self.answer_box.ensureCursorVisible()

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        central = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(central)

        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(central)

        top_group = QGroupBox("Project JSON")
        top_layout = QGridLayout(top_group)
        top_layout.addWidget(QLabel("JSON file:"), 0, 0)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.json_path_edit, 0, 1)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.load_button, 0, 2)

        cfg_group = QGroupBox("Local AI Runtime")
        cfg_layout = QGridLayout(cfg_group)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Cache dir:"), 0, 0)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.cache_dir_edit, 0, 1)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.pick_cache_dir_button, 0, 2)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Governance state:"), 1, 0)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.governance_path_edit, 1, 1)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.pick_governance_button, 1, 2)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Model:"), 2, 0)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.model_combo, 2, 1)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.refresh_models_button, 2, 2)

        ask_group = QGroupBox("Ask Complex Architecture Questions")
        ask_layout = QGridLayout(ask_group)
        ask_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Question:"), 0, 0)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.question_edit, 0, 1)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.ask_ai_button, 0, 2)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.clear_button, 0, 3)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.clear_memory_button, 0, 4)

        quick_row = QHBoxLayout()
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_startup_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_topomap_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_timeline_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_responsibility_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_uncertainty_button)
        quick_row.addStretch()

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Horizontal)

        left_panel = QWidget()
        left_layout = QVBoxLayout(left_panel)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Conversation History"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.history_list)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("File Evidence"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.file_evidence_list)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Symbol Evidence"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.symbol_evidence_list)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Selected Detail"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.detail_box)

        right_panel = QWidget()
        right_layout = QVBoxLayout(right_panel)
        right_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Local AI Answer"))
        right_layout.addWidget(self.answer_box, stretch=2)
        right_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Prompt / Evidence Pack"))
        right_layout.addWidget(self.prompt_preview, stretch=1)

        splitter.addWidget(left_panel)
        splitter.addWidget(right_panel)
        splitter.setSizes([720, 1050])

        log_group = QGroupBox("Log")
        log_layout = QVBoxLayout(log_group)
        log_layout.addWidget(self.log_box)

        main_layout.addWidget(top_group)
        main_layout.addWidget(cfg_group)
        main_layout.addWidget(ask_group)
        main_layout.addLayout(quick_row)
        main_layout.addWidget(splitter, stretch=1)
        main_layout.addWidget(log_group)

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.load_button.clicked.connect(self.load_json)
        self.ask_ai_button.clicked.connect(self.ask_local_ai)
        self.clear_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_visuals_only)
        self.clear_memory_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_memory)

        self.pick_cache_dir_button.clicked.connect(self.pick_cache_dir)
        self.pick_governance_button.clicked.connect(self.pick_governance_path)
        self.refresh_models_button.clicked.connect(self.refresh_models)

        self.quick_startup_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain startup chain for the app step by step.")
        )
        self.quick_topomap_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain topomap chain and how it is wired into the app.")
        )
        self.quick_timeline_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain timeline chain and the flow between timeline modules.")
        )
        self.quick_responsibility_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create a responsibility map of the main modules in this app.")
        )
        self.quick_uncertainty_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create an uncertainty report about the architecture based on current evidence.")
        )

        self.question_edit.returnPressed.connect(self.ask_local_ai)
        self.file_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_file_detail)
        self.symbol_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_symbol_detail)
        self.history_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_history_turn)

        self.ai.bridge.answer_ready.connect(self._on_ai_answer_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.token_ready.connect(self._on_ai_token_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.error_ready.connect(self._on_ai_error_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.status_ready.connect(self._append_log)

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)

    def refresh_models(self) -> None:
        self.model_combo.clear()
        models = self.model_registry.list_models()

        if not models:
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:7b")
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:32b")
            self._append_log("Could not verify models from Ollama. Added fallback model names.")
            return

        for model_name in models:
            self.model_combo.addItem(model_name)

        preferred = "qwen2.5-coder:7b"
        idx = self.model_combo.findText(preferred)
        if idx >= 0:
            self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

        self._append_log("Verified models from Ollama: " + ", ".join(models))

    def clear_visuals_only(self) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.prompt_preview.clear()
        self.log_box.clear()
        self._last_bundle = RetrievalBundle([], [], [])
        self._last_prompt = ""

    def clear_memory(self) -> None:
        self.memory.clear()
        self.history_list.clear()
        self._append_log("Conversation memory cleared.")

    def _run_quick_question(self, question: str) -> None:
        self.question_edit.setText(question)
        self.ask_local_ai()

    def pick_cache_dir(self) -> None:
        path = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select cache directory")
        if not path:
            return
        self.cache_dir_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_cache_dir(path)
            self._append_log("Cache dir set: " + path)
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Cache dir error", str(exc))

    def pick_governance_path(self) -> None:
        path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select governance_state.json",
            os.getcwd(),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        self.governance_path_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_governance_state_path(path)
            self._append_log("Governance state set: " + path)
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Governance path error", str(exc))

    def load_json(self) -> None:
        current_path = self.json_path_edit.text().strip()
        start_dir = os.path.dirname(current_path) if current_path else os.getcwd()

        file_path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select project_structure_index.json",
            start_dir,
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not file_path:
            return

        try:
            self.project_index.load_json(file_path)
            self.json_path_edit.setText(file_path)

            summary = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {})
            self._append_log("Loaded JSON: " + file_path)
            self._append_log("Project root: " + self.project_index.project_root)
            self._append_log("Python files: " + str(summary.get("python_file_count", "unknown")))
            self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(summary.get("entry_file_count", "unknown")))

            QMessageBox.information(self, "Loaded", "JSON loaded successfully.")
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Failed to load JSON:\n" + str(exc))

    def ask_local_ai(self) -> None:
        if not self.project_index.index_data:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No JSON", "Please load a JSON file first.")
            return

        question = self.question_edit.text().strip()
        if not question:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Question", "Please type a question.")
            return

        selected_model = self.model_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not selected_model:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Model", "Please select a model.")
            return

        current_bundle = self.retriever.retrieve(
            question,
            file_limit=10,
            symbol_limit=10,
            snippet_limit=6,
        )

        if not current_bundle.file_evidence and not current_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "No Evidence", "No relevant evidence was retrieved.")
            return

        previous_turn = self.memory.last_turn()
        if previous_turn is not None:
            merged_bundle = self.retriever.merge_with_previous(
                current_bundle=current_bundle,
                previous_bundle=previous_turn.retrieval,
                max_files=14,
                max_symbols=14,
                max_snippets=10,
            )
        else:
            merged_bundle = current_bundle

        self._last_bundle = merged_bundle
        self._last_selected_model = selected_model
        self._pending_question = question
        self._populate_evidence_lists(merged_bundle)

        summary = dict((self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {}))
        summary["entry_files"] = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])

        prompt = self.prompt_builder.build(
            question=question,
            bundle=merged_bundle,
            project_root=self.project_index.project_root,
            summary=summary,
            memory_turns=self.memory.turns(),
        )
        self._last_prompt = prompt
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(prompt)
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.ai.ask(prompt, selected_model)

    def _populate_evidence_lists(self, bundle: RetrievalBundle) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        for item in bundle.file_evidence:
            label = "[" + item.evidence_id + "] " + shorten_path(item.path) + " | score=" + str(item.score)
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.file_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        for item in bundle.symbol_evidence:
            label = (
                "[" + item.evidence_id + "] "
                + item.symbol_name
                + " @ "
                + shorten_path(item.path, 70)
                + ":"
                + str(item.line)
            )
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.symbol_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        if bundle.file_evidence:
            self.file_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)
        elif bundle.symbol_evidence:
            self.symbol_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _show_selected_file_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.file_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_symbol_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_history_turn(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        row = self.history_list.row(current)
        turns = self.memory.turns()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(turns):
            return
        turn = turns[row]
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(turn.answer)
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(turn.prompt)

    def _refresh_history_list(self) -> None:
        self.history_list.clear()
        for idx, turn in enumerate(self.memory.turns(), start=1):
            label = str(idx) + ". " + turn.question
            item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            self.history_list.addItem(item)

    def _on_ai_answer_ready(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(text)
        self._append_log("Local AI answer received.")

        turn = ConversationTurn(
            question=self._pending_question,
            answer=text,
            prompt=self._last_prompt,
            retrieval=self._last_bundle,
            selected_model=self._last_selected_model,
        )
        self.memory.add_turn(turn)
        self._refresh_history_list()

    def _on_ai_error_ready(self, error_text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("AI error:\n" + error_text)
        self._append_log("AI error: " + error_text)


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = JsonProjectReasonerV9()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def shorten_path(path: str, max_len: int = 90) -> str:
    if len(path) <= max_len:
        return path
    return "..." + path[-(max_len - 3):]


class HelpDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(str(HELP_INDEX.get("window_title", "Help")))
        self.resize(1100, 800)

        self.section_list = QListWidget()
        self.content_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.content_box.setReadOnly(True)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)

        left_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        left_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Sections"))
        left_panel.addWidget(self.section_list)

        right_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        right_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Help Content"))
        right_panel.addWidget(self.content_box)

        left_widget = QWidget()
        left_widget.setLayout(left_panel)

        right_widget = QWidget()
        right_widget.setLayout(right_panel)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(left_widget)
        splitter.addWidget(right_widget)
        splitter.setSizes([260, 780])

        layout.addWidget(splitter)

        self._populate_sections()
        self.section_list.currentRowChanged.connect(self._show_section)

        if self.section_list.count() > 0:
            self.section_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _populate_sections(self) -> None:
        for section in HELP_INDEX.get("sections", []):
            title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
            item = QListWidgetItem(title)
            item.setData(Qt.UserRole, section)
            self.section_list.addItem(item)

    def _show_section(self, row: int) -> None:
        item = self.section_list.item(row)
        if item is None:
            self.content_box.clear()
            return

        section = item.data(Qt.UserRole) or {}
        title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
        items = section.get("items", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append(title)
        lines.append("=" * len(title))
        lines.append("")

        for entry in items:
            label = str(entry.get("label", "Item"))
            lines.append(label)
            lines.append("-" * len(label))

            for key in [
                "purpose",
                "how_it_works",
                "best_use",
                "best_config",
                "what_it_is_for",
                "notes",
            ]:
                value = str(entry.get(key, "")).strip()
                if value:
                    pretty_key = key.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
                    lines.append(pretty_key + ":")
                    lines.append(value)
                    lines.append("")

        self.content_box.setPlainText("\n".join(lines).strip())

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:

    def show_help_dialog(self) -> None:

    def refresh_models(self) -> None:
        self.model_combo.clear()
        models = self.model_registry.list_models()

        if not models:
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:7b")
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:32b")
            self._append_log("Could not verify models from Ollama. Added fallback model names.")
            return

        for model_name in models:
            self.model_combo.addItem(model_name)

        preferred = "qwen2.5-coder:7b"
        idx = self.model_combo.findText(preferred)
        if idx >= 0:
            self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

        self._append_log("Verified models from Ollama: " + ", ".join(models))

    def clear_visuals_only(self) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.prompt_preview.clear()
        self.log_box.clear()
        self._last_bundle = RetrievalBundle([], [], [])
        self._last_prompt = ""

    def clear_memory(self) -> None:

        self.history_list.clear()
        self._append_log("Conversation memory cleared.")

    def _run_quick_question(self, question: str) -> None:
        self.question_edit.setText(question)
        self.ask_local_ai()

    def pick_cache_dir(self) -> None:
        path = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select cache directory")
        if not path:
            return
        self.cache_dir_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_cache_dir(path)
            self._append_log("Cache dir set: " + path)
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Cache dir error", str(exc))

    def pick_governance_path(self) -> None:
        path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select governance_state.json",
            os.getcwd(),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        self.governance_path_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_governance_state_path(path)
            self._append_log("Governance state set: " + path)
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Governance path error", str(exc))

    def load_json(self) -> None:
        current_path = self.json_path_edit.text().strip()
        start_dir = os.path.dirname(current_path) if current_path else os.getcwd()

        file_path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select project_structure_index.json",
            start_dir,
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not file_path:
            return

        try:
            self.project_index.load_json(file_path)
            self.json_path_edit.setText(file_path)

            summary = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {})
            self._append_log("Loaded JSON: " + file_path)
            self._append_log("Project root: " + self.project_index.project_root)
            self._append_log("Python files: " + str(summary.get("python_file_count", "unknown")))
            self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(summary.get("entry_file_count", "unknown")))

            QMessageBox.information(self, "Loaded", "JSON loaded successfully.")
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Failed to load JSON:\n" + str(exc))

    def ask_local_ai(self) -> None:
        if not self.project_index.index_data:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No JSON", "Please load a JSON file first.")
            return

        question = self.question_edit.text().strip()
        if not question:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Question", "Please type a question.")
            return

        selected_model = self.model_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not selected_model:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Model", "Please select a model.")
            return

        current_bundle = self.retriever.retrieve(
            question,
            file_limit=10,
            symbol_limit=10,
            snippet_limit=6,
        )

        if not current_bundle.file_evidence and not current_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "No Evidence", "No relevant evidence was retrieved.")
            return

        previous_turn = self.memory.last_turn()
        if previous_turn is not None:
            merged_bundle = self.retriever.merge_with_previous(
                current_bundle=current_bundle,
                previous_bundle=previous_turn.retrieval,
                max_files=14,
                max_symbols=14,
                max_snippets=10,
            )
        else:
            merged_bundle = current_bundle

        self._last_bundle = merged_bundle
        self._last_selected_model = selected_model
        self._pending_question = question
        self._populate_evidence_lists(merged_bundle)

        summary = dict((self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {}))
        summary["entry_files"] = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])

        prompt = self.prompt_builder.build(
            question=question,
            bundle=merged_bundle,
            project_root=self.project_index.project_root,
            summary=summary,
            memory_turns=self.memory.turns(),
        )
        self._last_prompt = prompt
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(prompt)
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.ai.ask(prompt, selected_model)

    def _populate_evidence_lists(self, bundle: RetrievalBundle) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        for item in bundle.file_evidence:
            label = "[" + item.evidence_id + "] " + shorten_path(item.path) + " | score=" + str(item.score)
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.file_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        for item in bundle.symbol_evidence:
            label = (
                "[" + item.evidence_id + "] "
                + item.symbol_name
                + " @ "
                + shorten_path(item.path, 70)
                + ":"
                + str(item.line)
            )
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.symbol_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        if bundle.file_evidence:
            self.file_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)
        elif bundle.symbol_evidence:
            self.symbol_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _show_selected_file_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.file_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_symbol_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_history_turn(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        row = self.history_list.row(current)
        turns = self.memory.turns()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(turns):
            return
        turn = turns[row]
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(turn.answer)
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(turn.prompt)

    def _refresh_history_list(self) -> None:
        self.history_list.clear()
        for idx, turn in enumerate(self.memory.turns(), start=1):
            label = str(idx) + ". " + turn.question
            item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            self.history_list.addItem(item)

    def _on_ai_answer_ready(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(text)
        self._append_log("Local AI answer received.")

        turn = ConversationTurn(
            question=self._pending_question,
            answer=text,
            prompt=self._last_prompt,
            retrieval=self._last_bundle,
            selected_model=self._last_selected_model,
        )
        self.memory.add_turn(turn)
        self._refresh_history_list()

    def _on_ai_error_ready(self, error_text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("AI error:\n" + error_text)
        self._append_log("AI error: " + error_text)


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = JsonProjectReasonerV9()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Como isso vai funcionar na prática

Load JSON
carrega o índice estrutural do projeto, que é a base de conhecimento do app

Set Cache Dir
define onde o runtime local da IA guarda cache reutilizável

Set Governance State
define o arquivo de governança usado pelo runtime da IA

Refresh Models
reconsulta os modelos locais disponíveis

Ask Local AI
faz recuperação de evidências + montagem do prompt + pergunta ao modelo local

Clear
limpa a interface visual sem apagar a memória de conversa

Clear Memory
limpa a memória da conversa atual

Explain startup chain
atalho para pedir explicação da cadeia de inicialização

Explain topomap chain
atalho para pedir explicação do fluxo do topomap

Explain timeline chain
atalho para pedir explicação do fluxo da timeline

Responsibility map
atalho para pedir mapeamento de responsabilidades dos módulos

Uncertainty report
atalho para pedir um relatório do que está sólido e do que ainda está incerto

Conversation History
histórico dos turnos anteriores feitos nessa janela

File Evidence
arquivos recuperados como evidência

Symbol Evidence
funções, classes e métodos recuperados como evidência

Selected Detail
detalhe textual do item selecionado

Log
mensagens operacionais e de depuração

Local AI Answer
resposta final do modelo local

Prompt / Evidence Pack
prompt exato enviado ao modelo, com evidências

def shorten_path(path: str, max_len: int = 90) -> str:
    if len(path) <= max_len:
        return path
    return "..." + path[-(max_len - 3):]


class HelpDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(str(HELP_INDEX.get("window_title", "Help")))
        self.resize(1100, 800)

        self.section_list = QListWidget()
        self.content_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.content_box.setReadOnly(True)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)

        left_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        left_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Sections"))
        left_panel.addWidget(self.section_list)

        right_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        right_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Help Content"))
        right_panel.addWidget(self.content_box)

        left_widget = QWidget()
        left_widget.setLayout(left_panel)

        right_widget = QWidget()
        right_widget.setLayout(right_panel)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(left_widget)
        splitter.addWidget(right_widget)
        splitter.setSizes([260, 780])

        layout.addWidget(splitter)

        self._populate_sections()
        self.section_list.currentRowChanged.connect(self._show_section)

        if self.section_list.count() > 0:
            self.section_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _populate_sections(self) -> None:
        for section in HELP_INDEX.get("sections", []):
            title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
            item = QListWidgetItem(title)
            item.setData(Qt.UserRole, section)
            self.section_list.addItem(item)

    def _show_section(self, row: int) -> None:
        item = self.section_list.item(row)
        if item is None:
            self.content_box.clear()
            return

        section = item.data(Qt.UserRole) or {}
        title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
        items = section.get("items", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append(title)
        lines.append("=" * len(title))
        lines.append("")

        for entry in items:
            label = str(entry.get("label", "Item"))
            lines.append(label)
            lines.append("-" * len(label))

            for key in [
                "purpose",
                "how_it_works",
                "best_use",
                "best_config",
                "what_it_is_for",
                "notes",
            ]:
                value = str(entry.get(key, "")).strip()
                if value:
                    pretty_key = key.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
                    lines.append(pretty_key + ":")
                    lines.append(value)
                    lines.append("")

        self.content_box.setPlainText("\n".join(lines).strip())

    def _on_ai_token_ready(self, token: str) -> None:

        central = QWidget()

        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.pick_governance_button, 1, 2)

        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.model_combo, 2, 1)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.refresh_models_button, 2, 2)

        ask_layout = QGridLayout(ask_group)
        ask_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Question:"), 0, 0)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.question_edit, 0, 1)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.ask_ai_button, 0, 2)

        quick_row.addWidget(self.help_button)
