    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.load_button.clicked.connect(self.load_json)
        self.ask_ai_button.clicked.connect(self.ask_local_ai)
        self.clear_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_visuals_only)
        self.clear_memory_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_memory)

        self.pick_cache_dir_button.clicked.connect(self.pick_cache_dir)
        self.pick_governance_button.clicked.connect(self.pick_governance_path)
        self.refresh_models_button.clicked.connect(self.refresh_models)
        self.help_button.clicked.connect(self.show_help_dialog)

        self.quick_startup_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain startup chain for the app step by step.")
        )
        self.quick_topomap_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain topomap chain and how it is wired into the app.")
        )
        self.quick_timeline_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain timeline chain and the flow between timeline modules.")
        )
        self.quick_responsibility_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create a responsibility map of the main modules in this app.")
        )
        self.quick_uncertainty_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create an uncertainty report about the architecture based on current evidence.")
        )

        self.question_edit.returnPressed.connect(self.ask_local_ai)
        self.file_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_file_detail)
        self.symbol_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_symbol_detail)
        self.history_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_history_turn)

        self.ai.bridge.answer_ready.connect(self._on_ai_answer_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.token_ready.connect(self._on_ai_token_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.error_ready.connect(self._on_ai_error_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.status_ready.connect(self._append_log)

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)

    def show_help_dialog(self) -> None:
        dialog = HelpDialog(self)
        dialog.exec()

    def refresh_models(self) -> None:
        self.model_combo.clear()
        models = self.model_registry.list_models()

        if not models:
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:7b")
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:32b")
            self._append_log("Could not verify models from Ollama. Added fallback model names.")
            return

        for model_name in models:
            self.model_combo.addItem(model_name)

        preferred = "qwen2.5-coder:7b"
        idx = self.model_combo.findText(preferred)
        if idx >= 0:
            self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

        self._append_log("Verified models from Ollama: " + ", ".join(models))

    def clear_visuals_only(self) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.prompt_preview.clear()
        self.log_box.clear()
        self._last_bundle = RetrievalBundle([], [], [])
        self._last_prompt = ""

    def clear_memory(self) -> None:
        self.memory.clear()
        self.history_list.clear()
        self._append_log("Conversation memory cleared.")

    def _run_quick_question(self, question: str) -> None:
        self.question_edit.setText(question)
        self.ask_local_ai()

    def pick_cache_dir(self) -> None:
        path = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select cache directory")
        if not path:
            return
        self.cache_dir_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_cache_dir(path)
            self._append_log("Cache dir set: " + path)
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Cache dir error", str(exc))

    def pick_governance_path(self) -> None:
        path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select governance_state.json",
            os.getcwd(),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        self.governance_path_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_governance_state_path(path)
            self._append_log("Governance state set: " + path)
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Governance path error", str(exc))

    def load_json(self) -> None:
        current_path = self.json_path_edit.text().strip()
        start_dir = os.path.dirname(current_path) if current_path else os.getcwd()

        file_path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select project_structure_index.json",
            start_dir,
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not file_path:
            return

        try:
            self.project_index.load_json(file_path)
            self.json_path_edit.setText(file_path)

            summary = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {})
            self._append_log("Loaded JSON: " + file_path)
            self._append_log("Project root: " + self.project_index.project_root)
            self._append_log("Python files: " + str(summary.get("python_file_count", "unknown")))
            self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(summary.get("entry_file_count", "unknown")))

            QMessageBox.information(self, "Loaded", "JSON loaded successfully.")
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Failed to load JSON:\n" + str(exc))

    def ask_local_ai(self) -> None:
        if not self.project_index.index_data:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No JSON", "Please load a JSON file first.")
            return

        question = self.question_edit.text().strip()
        if not question:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Question", "Please type a question.")
            return

        selected_model = self.model_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not selected_model:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Model", "Please select a model.")
            return

        current_bundle = self.retriever.retrieve(
            question,
            file_limit=10,
            symbol_limit=10,
            snippet_limit=6,
        )

        if not current_bundle.file_evidence and not current_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "No Evidence", "No relevant evidence was retrieved.")
            return

        previous_turn = self.memory.last_turn()
        if previous_turn is not None:
            merged_bundle = self.retriever.merge_with_previous(
                current_bundle=current_bundle,
                previous_bundle=previous_turn.retrieval,
                max_files=14,
                max_symbols=14,
                max_snippets=10,
            )
        else:
            merged_bundle = current_bundle

        self._last_bundle = merged_bundle
        self._last_selected_model = selected_model
        self._pending_question = question
        self._populate_evidence_lists(merged_bundle)

        summary = dict((self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {}))
        summary["entry_files"] = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])

        prompt = self.prompt_builder.build(
            question=question,
            bundle=merged_bundle,
            project_root=self.project_index.project_root,
            summary=summary,
            memory_turns=self.memory.turns(),
        )
        self._last_prompt = prompt
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(prompt)
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.ai.ask(prompt, selected_model)

    def _populate_evidence_lists(self, bundle: RetrievalBundle) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        for item in bundle.file_evidence:
            label = "[" + item.evidence_id + "] " + shorten_path(item.path) + " | score=" + str(item.score)
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.file_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        for item in bundle.symbol_evidence:
            label = (
                "[" + item.evidence_id + "] "
                + item.symbol_name
                + " @ "
                + shorten_path(item.path, 70)
                + ":"
                + str(item.line)
            )
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.symbol_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        if bundle.file_evidence:
            self.file_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)
        elif bundle.symbol_evidence:
            self.symbol_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _show_selected_file_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.file_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_symbol_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_history_turn(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        row = self.history_list.row(current)
        turns = self.memory.turns()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(turns):
            return
        turn = turns[row]
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(turn.answer)
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(turn.prompt)

    def _refresh_history_list(self) -> None:
        self.history_list.clear()
        for idx, turn in enumerate(self.memory.turns(), start=1):
            label = str(idx) + ". " + turn.question
            item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            self.history_list.addItem(item)

    def _on_ai_answer_ready(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(text)
        self._append_log("Local AI answer received.")

        turn = ConversationTurn(
            question=self._pending_question,
            answer=text,
            prompt=self._last_prompt,
            retrieval=self._last_bundle,
            selected_model=self._last_selected_model,
        )
        self.memory.add_turn(turn)
        self._refresh_history_list()

    def _on_ai_error_ready(self, error_text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("AI error:\n" + error_text)
        self._append_log("AI error: " + error_text)


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = JsonProjectReasonerV9()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from __future__ import annotations

import os

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt

    QApplication,

from v10_ai_bridge import LocalAIReasoner
from v10_conversation_memory import ConversationMemory

def shorten_path(path: str, max_len: int = 90) -> str:
    if len(path) <= max_len:
        return path
    return "..." + path[-(max_len - 3):]


class HelpDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(str(HELP_INDEX.get("window_title", "Help")))
        self.resize(1100, 800)

        self.section_list = QListWidget()
        self.content_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.content_box.setReadOnly(True)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)

        left_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        left_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Sections"))
        left_panel.addWidget(self.section_list)

        right_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        right_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Help Content"))
        right_panel.addWidget(self.content_box)

        left_widget = QWidget()
        left_widget.setLayout(left_panel)

        right_widget = QWidget()
        right_widget.setLayout(right_panel)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(left_widget)
        splitter.addWidget(right_widget)
        splitter.setSizes([260, 780])

        layout.addWidget(splitter)

        self._populate_sections()
        self.section_list.currentRowChanged.connect(self._show_section)

        if self.section_list.count() > 0:
            self.section_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _populate_sections(self) -> None:
        for section in HELP_INDEX.get("sections", []):
            title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
            item = QListWidgetItem(title)
            item.setData(Qt.UserRole, section)
            self.section_list.addItem(item)

    def _show_section(self, row: int) -> None:
        item = self.section_list.item(row)
        if item is None:
            self.content_box.clear()
            return

        section = item.data(Qt.UserRole) or {}
        title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
        items = section.get("items", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append(title)
        lines.append("=" * len(title))
        lines.append("")

        for entry in items:
            label = str(entry.get("label", "Item"))
            lines.append(label)
            lines.append("-" * len(label))

            for key in [
                "purpose",
                "how_it_works",
                "best_use",
                "best_config",
                "what_it_is_for",
                "notes",
            ]:
                value = str(entry.get(key, "")).strip()
                if value:
                    pretty_key = key.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
                    lines.append(pretty_key + ":")
                    lines.append(value)
                    lines.append("")

        self.content_box.setPlainText("\n".join(lines).strip())


class JsonProjectReasonerV9(QMainWindow):

        self.setWindowTitle("Project JSON Explorer V10 - Local AI Reasoner")
        self.resize(1880, 1080)

        self.project_index = JsonProjectIndex()

        self.prompt_builder = PromptBuilder()

        self.clear_button = QPushButton("Clear")
        self.clear_memory_button = QPushButton("Clear Memory")
        self.pick_cache_dir_button = QPushButton("Set Cache Dir")
        self.pick_governance_button = QPushButton("Set Governance State")

        self.quick_startup_button = QPushButton("Explain startup chain")
        self.quick_topomap_button = QPushButton("Explain topomap chain")
        self.quick_timeline_button = QPushButton("Explain timeline chain")
        self.quick_responsibility_button = QPushButton("Responsibility map")
        self.quick_uncertainty_button = QPushButton("Uncertainty report")

        self.file_evidence_list = QListWidget()
        self.symbol_evidence_list = QListWidget()
        self.history_list = QListWidget()

        self.detail_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.detail_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self.answer_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.answer_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self.prompt_preview = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.prompt_preview.setReadOnly(True)

        self.log_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()
        self.refresh_models()

    def _on_ai_token_ready(self, token: str) -> None:
        current = self.answer_box.toPlainText()
        if current == "[Streaming...]\n\n":
            self.answer_box.setPlainText("")
        cursor = self.answer_box.textCursor()
        cursor.movePosition(cursor.End)
        cursor.insertText(token)
        self.answer_box.setTextCursor(cursor)
        self.answer_box.ensureCursorVisible()

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        central = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(central)

        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(central)

        top_group = QGroupBox("Project JSON")
        top_layout = QGridLayout(top_group)
        top_layout.addWidget(QLabel("JSON file:"), 0, 0)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.json_path_edit, 0, 1)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.load_button, 0, 2)

        cfg_group = QGroupBox("Local AI Runtime")
        cfg_layout = QGridLayout(cfg_group)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Cache dir:"), 0, 0)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.cache_dir_edit, 0, 1)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.pick_cache_dir_button, 0, 2)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Governance state:"), 1, 0)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.governance_path_edit, 1, 1)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.pick_governance_button, 1, 2)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Model:"), 2, 0)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.model_combo, 2, 1)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.refresh_models_button, 2, 2)

        ask_group = QGroupBox("Ask Complex Architecture Questions")
        ask_layout = QGridLayout(ask_group)
        ask_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Question:"), 0, 0)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.question_edit, 0, 1)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.ask_ai_button, 0, 2)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.clear_button, 0, 3)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.clear_memory_button, 0, 4)

        quick_row = QHBoxLayout()
        quick_row.addWidget(self.help_button)
        quick_row.addSpacing(12)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_startup_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_topomap_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_timeline_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_responsibility_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_uncertainty_button)
        quick_row.addStretch()

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Horizontal)

        left_panel = QWidget()
        left_layout = QVBoxLayout(left_panel)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Conversation History"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.history_list)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("File Evidence"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.file_evidence_list)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Symbol Evidence"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.symbol_evidence_list)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Selected Detail"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.detail_box)

        right_panel = QWidget()
        right_layout = QVBoxLayout(right_panel)
        right_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Local AI Answer"))
        right_layout.addWidget(self.answer_box, stretch=2)
        right_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Prompt / Evidence Pack"))
        right_layout.addWidget(self.prompt_preview, stretch=1)

        splitter.addWidget(left_panel)
        splitter.addWidget(right_panel)
        splitter.setSizes([720, 1050])

        log_group = QGroupBox("Log")
        log_layout = QVBoxLayout(log_group)

        main_layout.addWidget(top_group)
        main_layout.addWidget(cfg_group)
        main_layout.addWidget(ask_group)
        main_layout.addLayout(quick_row)
        main_layout.addWidget(splitter, stretch=1)
        main_layout.addWidget(log_group)

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.load_button.clicked.connect(self.load_json)
        self.ask_ai_button.clicked.connect(self.ask_local_ai)
        self.clear_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_visuals_only)
        self.clear_memory_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_memory)

        self.pick_cache_dir_button.clicked.connect(self.pick_cache_dir)
        self.pick_governance_button.clicked.connect(self.pick_governance_path)
        self.refresh_models_button.clicked.connect(self.refresh_models)
        self.help_button.clicked.connect(self.show_help_dialog)

        self.quick_startup_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain startup chain for the app step by step.")
        )
        self.quick_topomap_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain topomap chain and how it is wired into the app.")
        )
        self.quick_timeline_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain timeline chain and the flow between timeline modules.")
        )
        self.quick_responsibility_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create a responsibility map of the main modules in this app.")
        )
        self.quick_uncertainty_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create an uncertainty report about the architecture based on current evidence.")
        )

        self.question_edit.returnPressed.connect(self.ask_local_ai)
        self.file_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_file_detail)
        self.symbol_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_symbol_detail)
        self.history_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_history_turn)

        self.ai.bridge.answer_ready.connect(self._on_ai_answer_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.token_ready.connect(self._on_ai_token_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.error_ready.connect(self._on_ai_error_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.status_ready.connect(self._append_log)

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)

    def show_help_dialog(self) -> None:
        dialog = HelpDialog(self)
        dialog.exec()

    def refresh_models(self) -> None:
        self.model_combo.clear()
        models = self.model_registry.list_models()

        if not models:
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:7b")
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:32b")
            self._append_log("Could not verify models from Ollama. Added fallback model names.")
            return

        for model_name in models:
            self.model_combo.addItem(model_name)

        preferred = "qwen2.5-coder:7b"
        idx = self.model_combo.findText(preferred)
        if idx >= 0:
            self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

        self._append_log("Verified models from Ollama: " + ", ".join(models))

    def clear_visuals_only(self) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.prompt_preview.clear()
        self.log_box.clear()
        self._last_bundle = RetrievalBundle([], [], [])
        self._last_prompt = ""

    def clear_memory(self) -> None:
        self.memory.clear()
        self.history_list.clear()
        self._append_log("Conversation memory cleared.")

    def _run_quick_question(self, question: str) -> None:
        self.question_edit.setText(question)
        self.ask_local_ai()

    def pick_cache_dir(self) -> None:
        path = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select cache directory")
        if not path:
            return
        self.cache_dir_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_cache_dir(path)
            self._append_log("Cache dir set: " + path)
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Cache dir error", str(exc))

    def pick_governance_path(self) -> None:
        path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select governance_state.json",
            os.getcwd(),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        self.governance_path_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_governance_state_path(path)
            self._append_log("Governance state set: " + path)
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Governance path error", str(exc))

    def load_json(self) -> None:
        current_path = self.json_path_edit.text().strip()
        start_dir = os.path.dirname(current_path) if current_path else os.getcwd()

        file_path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select project_structure_index.json",
            start_dir,
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not file_path:
            return

        try:
            self.project_index.load_json(file_path)
            self.json_path_edit.setText(file_path)

            summary = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {})
            self._append_log("Loaded JSON: " + file_path)
            self._append_log("Project root: " + self.project_index.project_root)
            self._append_log("Python files: " + str(summary.get("python_file_count", "unknown")))
            self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(summary.get("entry_file_count", "unknown")))

            QMessageBox.information(self, "Loaded", "JSON loaded successfully.")
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Failed to load JSON:\n" + str(exc))

    def ask_local_ai(self) -> None:
        if not self.project_index.index_data:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No JSON", "Please load a JSON file first.")
            return

        question = self.question_edit.text().strip()
        if not question:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Question", "Please type a question.")
            return

        selected_model = self.model_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not selected_model:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Model", "Please select a model.")
            return

        current_bundle = self.retriever.retrieve(
            question,
            file_limit=10,
            symbol_limit=10,
            snippet_limit=6,
        )

        if not current_bundle.file_evidence and not current_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "No Evidence", "No relevant evidence was retrieved.")
            return

        previous_turn = self.memory.last_turn()
        if previous_turn is not None:
            merged_bundle = self.retriever.merge_with_previous(
                current_bundle=current_bundle,
                previous_bundle=previous_turn.retrieval,
                max_files=14,
                max_symbols=14,
                max_snippets=10,
            )
        else:
            merged_bundle = current_bundle

        self._last_bundle = merged_bundle
        self._last_selected_model = selected_model
        self._pending_question = question
        self._populate_evidence_lists(merged_bundle)

        summary = dict((self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {}))
        summary["entry_files"] = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])

        prompt = self.prompt_builder.build(
            question=question,
            bundle=merged_bundle,
            project_root=self.project_index.project_root,
            summary=summary,
            memory_turns=self.memory.turns(),
        )
        self._last_prompt = prompt
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(prompt)
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.ai.ask(prompt, selected_model)

    def _populate_evidence_lists(self, bundle: RetrievalBundle) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        for item in bundle.file_evidence:
            label = "[" + item.evidence_id + "] " + shorten_path(item.path) + " | score=" + str(item.score)
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.file_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        for item in bundle.symbol_evidence:
            label = (
                "[" + item.evidence_id + "] "
                + item.symbol_name
                + " @ "
                + shorten_path(item.path, 70)
                + ":"
                + str(item.line)
            )
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.symbol_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        if bundle.file_evidence:
            self.file_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)
        elif bundle.symbol_evidence:
            self.symbol_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _show_selected_file_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.file_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_symbol_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_history_turn(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        row = self.history_list.row(current)
        turns = self.memory.turns()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(turns):
            return
        turn = turns[row]
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(turn.answer)
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(turn.prompt)

    def _refresh_history_list(self) -> None:
        self.history_list.clear()
        for idx, turn in enumerate(self.memory.turns(), start=1):
            label = str(idx) + ". " + turn.question
            item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            self.history_list.addItem(item)

    def _on_ai_answer_ready(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(text)
        self._append_log("Local AI answer received.")

        turn = ConversationTurn(
            question=self._pending_question,
            answer=text,
            prompt=self._last_prompt,
            retrieval=self._last_bundle,
            selected_model=self._last_selected_model,
        )
        self.memory.add_turn(turn)
        self._refresh_history_list()

    def _on_ai_error_ready(self, error_text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("AI error:\n" + error_text)
        self._append_log("AI error: " + error_text)


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = JsonProjectReasonerV9()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

do you remember developer_tools/project_reasoner/runtime_scenarios logic and other logic we implemented after  setp 25?

Yes.

I remember the main logic we established after step 25, especially around developer_tools/project_reasoner/runtime_scenarios and the V10 collector/runtime expansion.

What was implemented after that, at the important level

runtime_scenarios
This layer became the session-level runtime capture system for real app runs.
It writes numbered trace files like:
developer_tools/project_reasoner/runtime_scenarios\000x_<scenario>_trace.json

Its role is to capture:
session start
session end
app entry used
ordered runtime events
basic payloads per event

Core behavior we confirmed
start_runtime_scenario(...)
starts a numbered session trace

log_runtime_event(...)
appends structured events during runtime

finalize_runtime_scenario()
closes and writes the final trace JSON

This was wired into:
shell/run_kanda_with_coverage.py
and also into the collector runner / runtime collector runners where relevant

Then we added hotspot instrumentation

runtime_hotspot_hooks.py
This became the dynamic monkey-patch layer that installs runtime event hooks into selected app hotspots before app launch.

Its purpose is:
patch selected functions/methods
emit begin/done runtime events
enrich traces with real architectural flow, not just startup/close

We evolved it from simple session tracing into hotspot-aware tracing.

Targets we confirmed included things like:
display_pyside6_eeg_visualizer
EEGVisualizerCore.load_eeg
EEGVisualizerCore.on_timeline_moved
EEGMainWindowBuilder.handle_tab_switch

And later additional targets were explored/added where import paths were valid.

Why this mattered
Step 29 stopped being just:
“the app opened and closed”

and started becoming:
“these architectural hotspots were really executed during this session”

Then Step 29 ingestion into V10 collector

In reasoner_context_collector, we added ingestion of runtime scenario traces into the collector output JSON.

That gave you structures like:
runtime_scenario_index
runtime_scenario_summary
runtime_scenario_hotspots

So the collector started reading the trace files and integrating them into:
the final index JSON
the evidence base used by the retriever
the future AI reasoning path

Then Step 30 runtime feature attribution

We added:
collector_runtime_feature_attribution.py

Its role is:
take runtime scenario events
map source files to features
map files to subsystem buckets
map files to boundary roles
map files to chronology status
score sessions by touched features and buckets

Outputs included:
runtime_feature_attribution_index
runtime_feature_attribution_summary
runtime_feature_attribution_hotspots

This is the layer that turned raw runtime events into:
“what parts of the project were actually exercised”

That was the big semantic gain after step 29.

What we concluded about its value
You asked how much the system “knows” now.
We concluded roughly:
static collector gives structural knowledge
step 29 adds session/runtime truth
step 30 adds feature-level runtime meaning

And we discussed that stopping at Tier 2 is reasonable for a huge project if you want to avoid making Project Reasoner too complex.

We also aligned that:
Tier 3 could improve understanding further
but Tier 2 is already enough to keep helping you stay on track architecturally

Purpose:
Defines the governance_state.json file used by the local AI runtime.

How it works:
This JSON is passed into the AI bridge/runtime so the model can operate under the current project governance rules, safety constraints, architecture policies, or other controlled execution rules.

Best config:
Best practice: point this to the canonical governance file for the project, not to a temporary copy. Use the current official governance_state.json that matches the active project architecture.

Notes:
This is important when the local AI must stay aligned with the current project rules and constraints.

do we create an empty file governance_state.json?

No.

You should not create an empty governance_state.json just to satisfy the field.

Why

An empty file is usually worse than no file because:
it may parse as invalid JSON
or parse as {} and give a false impression that governance is configured
or break parts of the AI runtime that expect specific keys

Better rule

If governance is not implemented yet for this V10 flow, there are only 2 good options:

    leave it unset

    point it to a real minimal valid governance JSON

Best practical choice now

If your runtime does not strictly require governance yet, leave the field empty and do not select a file.

If you want a safe starter file, then create a minimal valid governance_state.json, not an empty one.

A good minimal starter example is:

{
  "version": "1.0",
  "project_name": "eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis",
  "governance_enabled": true,
  "mode": "advisory",
  "rules": [],
  "notes": "Minimal starter governance state."
}

When to use this starter file

Use it only if:
LocalAIReasoner.set_governance_state_path(...) expects a real JSON file
or you want to standardize the workflow now even before full governance rules are added

When not to use it

Do not create it if the runtime already works fine with no governance path selected.

Best recommendation

For now:
do not create an empty file.

Create a real minimal JSON only if the runtime needs one.

If you want, I can draft a more future-proof governance_state.json for your Project Reasoner and KANDA architecture.

yes

Use this as a safe starter governance_state.json:

{
  "version": "1.0",
  "project_name": "eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis",
  "governance_enabled": true,
  "mode": "advisory",
  "active_profile": "default",
  "policies": {
    "allow_architecture_reasoning": true,
    "allow_code_explanations": true,
    "allow_refactor_suggestions": true,
    "allow_write_actions": false,
    "require_evidence_for_claims": true,
    "prefer_project_index_evidence": true,
    "prefer_runtime_trace_evidence": true
  },
  "constraints": {
    "respect_project_boundaries": true,
    "respect_canonical_paths": true,
    "avoid_guessing_missing_logic": true,
    "flag_uncertainty_when_evidence_is_weak": true
  },
  "runtime": {
    "cache_enabled": true,
    "memory_enabled": true,
    "trace_awareness_enabled": true
  },
  "rules": [
    {
      "id": "R001",
      "title": "Prefer indexed evidence",
      "enabled": true,
      "description": "Answers should prioritize evidence from the loaded project index."
    },
    {
      "id": "R002",
      "title": "Prefer runtime evidence when available",
      "enabled": true,
      "description": "When runtime traces exist, use them to support real execution-path claims."
    },
    {
      "id": "R003",
      "title": "Do not overstate certainty",
      "enabled": true,
      "description": "If evidence is incomplete, explicitly present uncertainty."
    },
    {
      "id": "R004",
      "title": "No write actions by default",
      "enabled": true,
      "description": "The reasoner should remain read-oriented unless explicitly upgraded."
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Minimal starter governance state for Project Reasoner V10."
}

valid JSON
not empty
safe for future expansion
clear enough for advisory governance
unlikely to break consumers that expect a structured object

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (
    QApplication,
    QComboBox,
    QFileDialog,
    QDialog,
    QGridLayout,
    QGroupBox,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QListWidget,
    QListWidgetItem,
    QMainWindow,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QSplitter,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from v10_ai_bridge import LocalAIReasoner
from v10_conversation_memory import ConversationMemory
from v10_help_index import HELP_INDEX
from v10_index_loader import JsonProjectIndex
from v10_model_registry import LocalModelRegistry
from v10_models import ConversationTurn, RetrievalBundle
from v10_prompt_builder import PromptBuilder
from v10_retriever import ProjectRetriever


def shorten_path(path: str, max_len: int = 90) -> str:
    if len(path) <= max_len:
        return path
    return "..." + path[-(max_len - 3):]


class HelpDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(str(HELP_INDEX.get("window_title", "Help")))
        self.resize(1100, 800)

        self.section_list = QListWidget()
        self.content_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.content_box.setReadOnly(True)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)

        left_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        left_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Sections"))
        left_panel.addWidget(self.section_list)

        right_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        right_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Help Content"))
        right_panel.addWidget(self.content_box)

        left_widget = QWidget()
        left_widget.setLayout(left_panel)

        right_widget = QWidget()
        right_widget.setLayout(right_panel)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(left_widget)
        splitter.addWidget(right_widget)
        splitter.setSizes([260, 780])

        layout.addWidget(splitter)

        self._populate_sections()
        self.section_list.currentRowChanged.connect(self._show_section)

        if self.section_list.count() > 0:
            self.section_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _populate_sections(self) -> None:
        for section in HELP_INDEX.get("sections", []):
            title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
            item = QListWidgetItem(title)
            item.setData(Qt.UserRole, section)
            self.section_list.addItem(item)

    def _show_section(self, row: int) -> None:
        item = self.section_list.item(row)
        if item is None:
            self.content_box.clear()
            return

        section = item.data(Qt.UserRole) or {}
        title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
        items = section.get("items", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append(title)
        lines.append("=" * len(title))
        lines.append("")

        for entry in items:
            label = str(entry.get("label", "Item"))
            lines.append(label)
            lines.append("-" * len(label))

            for key in [
                "purpose",
                "how_it_works",
                "best_use",
                "best_config",
                "what_it_is_for",
                "notes",
            ]:
                value = str(entry.get(key, "")).strip()
                if value:
                    pretty_key = key.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
                    lines.append(pretty_key + ":")
                    lines.append(value)
                    lines.append("")

        self.content_box.setPlainText("\n".join(lines).strip())


class JsonProjectReasonerV9(QMainWindow):
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle("Project JSON Explorer V10 - Local AI Reasoner")
        self.resize(1880, 1080)

        self.project_index = JsonProjectIndex()
        self.retriever = ProjectRetriever(self.project_index)
        self.prompt_builder = PromptBuilder()
        self.ai = LocalAIReasoner()
        self.memory = ConversationMemory()
        self.model_registry = LocalModelRegistry()

        self._last_bundle = RetrievalBundle([], [], [])
        self._last_prompt = ""
        self._last_selected_model = ""
        self._pending_question = ""

        self.json_path_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.question_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.cache_dir_edit = QLineEdit()
        self.governance_path_edit = QLineEdit()

        self.model_combo = QComboBox()
        self.refresh_models_button = QPushButton("Refresh Models")
        self.help_button = QPushButton("Help (?)")
        self.help_button.setFixedWidth(80)

        self.load_button = QPushButton("Load JSON")
        self.ask_ai_button = QPushButton("Ask Local AI")
        self.clear_button = QPushButton("Clear")
        self.clear_memory_button = QPushButton("Clear Memory")
        self.pick_cache_dir_button = QPushButton("Set Cache Dir")
        self.pick_governance_button = QPushButton("Set Governance State")

        self.quick_startup_button = QPushButton("Explain startup chain")
        self.quick_topomap_button = QPushButton("Explain topomap chain")
        self.quick_timeline_button = QPushButton("Explain timeline chain")
        self.quick_responsibility_button = QPushButton("Responsibility map")
        self.quick_uncertainty_button = QPushButton("Uncertainty report")

        self.file_evidence_list = QListWidget()
        self.symbol_evidence_list = QListWidget()
        self.history_list = QListWidget()

        self.detail_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.detail_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self.answer_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.answer_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self.prompt_preview = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.prompt_preview.setReadOnly(True)

        self.log_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.log_box.setReadOnly(True)

        self._build_ui()
        self._connect_signals()
        self.refresh_models()

    def _on_ai_token_ready(self, token: str) -> None:
        current = self.answer_box.toPlainText()
        if current == "[Streaming...]\n\n":
            self.answer_box.setPlainText("")
        cursor = self.answer_box.textCursor()
        cursor.movePosition(cursor.End)
        cursor.insertText(token)
        self.answer_box.setTextCursor(cursor)
        self.answer_box.ensureCursorVisible()

    def _build_ui(self) -> None:
        central = QWidget()
        self.setCentralWidget(central)

        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(central)

        top_group = QGroupBox("Project JSON")
        top_layout = QGridLayout(top_group)
        top_layout.addWidget(QLabel("JSON file:"), 0, 0)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.json_path_edit, 0, 1)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.load_button, 0, 2)

        cfg_group = QGroupBox("Local AI Runtime")
        cfg_layout = QGridLayout(cfg_group)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Cache dir:"), 0, 0)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.cache_dir_edit, 0, 1)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.pick_cache_dir_button, 0, 2)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Governance state:"), 1, 0)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.governance_path_edit, 1, 1)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.pick_governance_button, 1, 2)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Model:"), 2, 0)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.model_combo, 2, 1)
        cfg_layout.addWidget(self.refresh_models_button, 2, 2)

        ask_group = QGroupBox("Ask Complex Architecture Questions")
        ask_layout = QGridLayout(ask_group)
        ask_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Question:"), 0, 0)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.question_edit, 0, 1)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.ask_ai_button, 0, 2)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.clear_button, 0, 3)
        ask_layout.addWidget(self.clear_memory_button, 0, 4)

        quick_row = QHBoxLayout()
        quick_row.addWidget(self.help_button)
        quick_row.addSpacing(12)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_startup_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_topomap_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_timeline_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_responsibility_button)
        quick_row.addWidget(self.quick_uncertainty_button)
        quick_row.addStretch()

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Horizontal)

        left_panel = QWidget()
        left_layout = QVBoxLayout(left_panel)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Conversation History"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.history_list)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("File Evidence"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.file_evidence_list)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Symbol Evidence"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.symbol_evidence_list)
        left_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Selected Detail"))
        left_layout.addWidget(self.detail_box)

        right_panel = QWidget()
        right_layout = QVBoxLayout(right_panel)
        right_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Local AI Answer"))
        right_layout.addWidget(self.answer_box, stretch=2)
        right_layout.addWidget(QLabel("Prompt / Evidence Pack"))
        right_layout.addWidget(self.prompt_preview, stretch=1)

        splitter.addWidget(left_panel)
        splitter.addWidget(right_panel)
        splitter.setSizes([720, 1050])

        log_group = QGroupBox("Log")
        log_layout = QVBoxLayout(log_group)
        log_layout.addWidget(self.log_box)

        main_layout.addWidget(top_group)
        main_layout.addWidget(cfg_group)
        main_layout.addWidget(ask_group)
        main_layout.addLayout(quick_row)
        main_layout.addWidget(splitter, stretch=1)
        main_layout.addWidget(log_group)

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.load_button.clicked.connect(self.load_json)
        self.ask_ai_button.clicked.connect(self.ask_local_ai)
        self.clear_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_visuals_only)
        self.clear_memory_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_memory)

        self.pick_cache_dir_button.clicked.connect(self.pick_cache_dir)
        self.pick_governance_button.clicked.connect(self.pick_governance_path)
        self.refresh_models_button.clicked.connect(self.refresh_models)
        self.help_button.clicked.connect(self.show_help_dialog)

        self.quick_startup_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain startup chain for the app step by step.")
        )
        self.quick_topomap_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain topomap chain and how it is wired into the app.")
        )
        self.quick_timeline_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain timeline chain and the flow between timeline modules.")
        )
        self.quick_responsibility_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create a responsibility map of the main modules in this app.")
        )
        self.quick_uncertainty_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create an uncertainty report about the architecture based on current evidence.")
        )

        self.question_edit.returnPressed.connect(self.ask_local_ai)
        self.file_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_file_detail)
        self.symbol_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_symbol_detail)
        self.history_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_history_turn)

        self.ai.bridge.answer_ready.connect(self._on_ai_answer_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.token_ready.connect(self._on_ai_token_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.error_ready.connect(self._on_ai_error_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.status_ready.connect(self._append_log)

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)

    def show_help_dialog(self) -> None:
        dialog = HelpDialog(self)
        dialog.exec()

    def refresh_models(self) -> None:
        self.model_combo.clear()
        models = self.model_registry.list_models()

        if not models:
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:7b")
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:32b")
            self._append_log("Could not verify models from Ollama. Added fallback model names.")
            return

        for model_name in models:
            self.model_combo.addItem(model_name)

        preferred = "qwen2.5-coder:7b"
        idx = self.model_combo.findText(preferred)
        if idx >= 0:
            self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

        self._append_log("Verified models from Ollama: " + ", ".join(models))

    def clear_visuals_only(self) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.prompt_preview.clear()
        self.log_box.clear()
        self._last_bundle = RetrievalBundle([], [], [])
        self._last_prompt = ""

    def clear_memory(self) -> None:
        self.memory.clear()
        self.history_list.clear()
        self._append_log("Conversation memory cleared.")

    def _run_quick_question(self, question: str) -> None:
        self.question_edit.setText(question)
        self.ask_local_ai()

    def pick_cache_dir(self) -> None:
        path = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select cache directory")
        if not path:
            return
        self.cache_dir_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_cache_dir(path)
            self._append_log("Cache dir set: " + path)
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Cache dir error", str(exc))

    def pick_governance_path(self) -> None:
        path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select governance_state.json",
            os.getcwd(),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        self.governance_path_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_governance_state_path(path)
            self._append_log("Governance state set: " + path)
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Governance path error", str(exc))

    def load_json(self) -> None:
        current_path = self.json_path_edit.text().strip()
        start_dir = os.path.dirname(current_path) if current_path else os.getcwd()

        file_path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select project_structure_index.json",
            start_dir,
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not file_path:
            return

        try:
            self.project_index.load_json(file_path)
            self.json_path_edit.setText(file_path)

            summary = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {})
            self._append_log("Loaded JSON: " + file_path)
            self._append_log("Project root: " + self.project_index.project_root)
            self._append_log("Python files: " + str(summary.get("python_file_count", "unknown")))
            self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(summary.get("entry_file_count", "unknown")))

            QMessageBox.information(self, "Loaded", "JSON loaded successfully.")
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Failed to load JSON:\n" + str(exc))

    def ask_local_ai(self) -> None:
        if not self.project_index.index_data:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No JSON", "Please load a JSON file first.")
            return

        question = self.question_edit.text().strip()
        if not question:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Question", "Please type a question.")
            return

        selected_model = self.model_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not selected_model:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Model", "Please select a model.")
            return

        current_bundle = self.retriever.retrieve(
            question,
            file_limit=10,
            symbol_limit=10,
            snippet_limit=6,
        )

        if not current_bundle.file_evidence and not current_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "No Evidence", "No relevant evidence was retrieved.")
            return

        previous_turn = self.memory.last_turn()
        if previous_turn is not None:
            merged_bundle = self.retriever.merge_with_previous(
                current_bundle=current_bundle,
                previous_bundle=previous_turn.retrieval,
                max_files=14,
                max_symbols=14,
                max_snippets=10,
            )
        else:
            merged_bundle = current_bundle

        self._last_bundle = merged_bundle
        self._last_selected_model = selected_model
        self._pending_question = question
        self._populate_evidence_lists(merged_bundle)

        summary = dict((self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {}))
        summary["entry_files"] = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])

        prompt = self.prompt_builder.build(
            question=question,
            bundle=merged_bundle,
            project_root=self.project_index.project_root,
            summary=summary,
            memory_turns=self.memory.turns(),
        )
        self._last_prompt = prompt
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(prompt)
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.ai.ask(prompt, selected_model)

    def _populate_evidence_lists(self, bundle: RetrievalBundle) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        for item in bundle.file_evidence:
            label = "[" + item.evidence_id + "] " + shorten_path(item.path) + " | score=" + str(item.score)
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.file_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        for item in bundle.symbol_evidence:
            label = (
                "[" + item.evidence_id + "] "
                + item.symbol_name
                + " @ "
                + shorten_path(item.path, 70)
                + ":"
                + str(item.line)
            )
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.symbol_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        if bundle.file_evidence:
            self.file_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)
        elif bundle.symbol_evidence:
            self.symbol_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _show_selected_file_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.file_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_symbol_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_history_turn(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        row = self.history_list.row(current)
        turns = self.memory.turns()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(turns):
            return
        turn = turns[row]
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(turn.answer)
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(turn.prompt)

    def _refresh_history_list(self) -> None:
        self.history_list.clear()
        for idx, turn in enumerate(self.memory.turns(), start=1):
            label = str(idx) + ". " + turn.question
            item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            self.history_list.addItem(item)

    def _on_ai_answer_ready(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(text)
        self._append_log("Local AI answer received.")

        turn = ConversationTurn(
            question=self._pending_question,
            answer=text,
            prompt=self._last_prompt,
            retrieval=self._last_bundle,
            selected_model=self._last_selected_model,
        )
        self.memory.add_turn(turn)
        self._refresh_history_list()

    def _on_ai_error_ready(self, error_text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("AI error:\n" + error_text)
        self._append_log("AI error: " + error_text)


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = JsonProjectReasonerV9()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def shorten_path(path: str, max_len: int = 90) -> str:
    if len(path) <= max_len:
        return path
    return "..." + path[-(max_len - 3):]


class HelpDialog(QDialog):
    def __init__(self, parent: QWidget | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setWindowTitle(str(HELP_INDEX.get("window_title", "Help")))
        self.resize(1100, 800)

        self.section_list = QListWidget()
        self.content_box = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.content_box.setReadOnly(True)

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)

        left_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        left_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Sections"))
        left_panel.addWidget(self.section_list)

        right_panel = QVBoxLayout()
        right_panel.addWidget(QLabel("Help Content"))
        right_panel.addWidget(self.content_box)

        left_widget = QWidget()
        left_widget.setLayout(left_panel)

        right_widget = QWidget()
        right_widget.setLayout(right_panel)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Horizontal)
        splitter.addWidget(left_widget)
        splitter.addWidget(right_widget)
        splitter.setSizes([260, 780])

        layout.addWidget(splitter)

        self._populate_sections()
        self.section_list.currentRowChanged.connect(self._show_section)

        if self.section_list.count() > 0:
            self.section_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _populate_sections(self) -> None:
        for section in HELP_INDEX.get("sections", []):
            title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
            item = QListWidgetItem(title)
            item.setData(Qt.UserRole, section)
            self.section_list.addItem(item)

    def _show_section(self, row: int) -> None:
        item = self.section_list.item(row)
        if item is None:
            self.content_box.clear()
            return

        section = item.data(Qt.UserRole) or {}
        title = str(section.get("title", "Untitled"))
        items = section.get("items", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append(title)
        lines.append("=" * len(title))
        lines.append("")

        for entry in items:
            label = str(entry.get("label", "Item"))
            lines.append(label)
            lines.append("-" * len(label))

            for key in [
                "purpose",
                "how_it_works",
                "best_use",
                "best_config",
                "what_it_is_for",
                "notes",
            ]:
                value = str(entry.get(key, "")).strip()
                if value:
                    pretty_key = key.replace("_", " ").capitalize()
                    lines.append(pretty_key + ":")
                    lines.append(value)
                    lines.append("")

        self.content_box.setPlainText("\n".join(lines).strip())

    def _restore_last_config(self) -> None:
        json_path = str(self.settings.value("json_path", "", type=str) or "")
        cache_dir = str(self.settings.value("cache_dir", "", type=str) or "")
        governance_path = str(self.settings.value("governance_path", "", type=str) or "")
        selected_model = str(self.settings.value("selected_model", "", type=str) or "")

    def _connect_signals(self) -> None:
        self.load_button.clicked.connect(self.load_json)
        self.ask_ai_button.clicked.connect(self.ask_local_ai)
        self.clear_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_visuals_only)
        self.clear_memory_button.clicked.connect(self.clear_memory)

        self.pick_cache_dir_button.clicked.connect(self.pick_cache_dir)
        self.pick_governance_button.clicked.connect(self.pick_governance_path)
        self.refresh_models_button.clicked.connect(self.refresh_models)
        self.help_button.clicked.connect(self.show_help_dialog)

        self.quick_startup_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain startup chain for the app step by step.")
        )
        self.quick_topomap_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain topomap chain and how it is wired into the app.")
        )
        self.quick_timeline_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Explain timeline chain and the flow between timeline modules.")
        )
        self.quick_responsibility_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create a responsibility map of the main modules in this app.")
        )
        self.quick_uncertainty_button.clicked.connect(
            lambda: self._run_quick_question("Create an uncertainty report about the architecture based on current evidence.")
        )

        self.question_edit.returnPressed.connect(self.ask_local_ai)
        self.file_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_file_detail)
        self.symbol_evidence_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_symbol_detail)
        self.history_list.currentItemChanged.connect(self._show_selected_history_turn)

        self.ai.bridge.answer_ready.connect(self._on_ai_answer_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.token_ready.connect(self._on_ai_token_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.error_ready.connect(self._on_ai_error_ready)
        self.ai.bridge.status_ready.connect(self._append_log)

        self.model_combo.currentTextChanged.connect(self._save_last_config)

    def _append_log(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.log_box.appendPlainText(text)

    def show_help_dialog(self) -> None:
        dialog = HelpDialog(self)
        dialog.exec()

    def refresh_models(self) -> None:
        self.model_combo.clear()
        models = self.model_registry.list_models()

        if not models:
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:7b")
            self.model_combo.addItem("qwen2.5-coder:32b")
            self._append_log("Could not verify models from Ollama. Added fallback model names.")
            self._save_last_config()
            return

        for model_name in models:
            self.model_combo.addItem(model_name)

        preferred = "qwen2.5-coder:7b"
        idx = self.model_combo.findText(preferred)
        if idx >= 0:
            self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

        self._append_log("Verified models from Ollama: " + ", ".join(models))
        self._save_last_config()

    def clear_visuals_only(self) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.prompt_preview.clear()
        self.log_box.clear()
        self._last_bundle = RetrievalBundle([], [], [])
        self._last_prompt = ""

    def clear_memory(self) -> None:
        self.memory.clear()
        self.history_list.clear()
        self._append_log("Conversation memory cleared.")

    def _run_quick_question(self, question: str) -> None:
        self.question_edit.setText(question)
        self.ask_local_ai()

    def pick_cache_dir(self) -> None:
        path = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(self, "Select cache directory")
        if not path:
            return
        self.cache_dir_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_cache_dir(path)
            self._append_log("Cache dir set: " + path)
            self._save_last_config()

        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Cache dir error", str(exc))

    def pick_governance_path(self) -> None:
        path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select governance_state.json",
            os.getcwd(),
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not path:
            return
        self.governance_path_edit.setText(path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_governance_state_path(path)
            self._append_log("Governance state set: " + path)
            self._save_last_config()

        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "Governance path error", str(exc))

    def load_json(self) -> None:
        current_path = self.json_path_edit.text().strip()
        start_dir = os.path.dirname(current_path) if current_path else os.getcwd()

        file_path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self,
            "Select project_structure_index.json",
            start_dir,
            "JSON Files (*.json)",
        )
        if not file_path:
            return

        try:
            self.project_index.load_json(file_path)
            self.json_path_edit.setText(file_path)

            summary = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {})
            self._append_log("Loaded JSON: " + file_path)
            self._append_log("Project root: " + self.project_index.project_root)
            self._append_log("Python files: " + str(summary.get("python_file_count", "unknown")))
            self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(summary.get("entry_file_count", "unknown")))
            self._save_last_config()


            QMessageBox.information(self, "Loaded", "JSON loaded successfully.")
        except Exception as exc:
            QMessageBox.critical(self, "Error", "Failed to load JSON:\n" + str(exc))

    def ask_local_ai(self) -> None:
        if not self.project_index.index_data:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No JSON", "Please load a JSON file first.")
            return

        question = self.question_edit.text().strip()
        if not question:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Question", "Please type a question.")
            return

        selected_model = self.model_combo.currentText().strip()
        if not selected_model:
            QMessageBox.warning(self, "No Model", "Please select a model.")
            return

        current_bundle = self.retriever.retrieve(
            question,
            file_limit=10,
            symbol_limit=10,
            snippet_limit=6,
        )

        if not current_bundle.file_evidence and not current_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            QMessageBox.information(self, "No Evidence", "No relevant evidence was retrieved.")
            return

        previous_turn = self.memory.last_turn()
        if previous_turn is not None:
            merged_bundle = self.retriever.merge_with_previous(
                current_bundle=current_bundle,
                previous_bundle=previous_turn.retrieval,
                max_files=14,
                max_symbols=14,
                max_snippets=10,
            )
        else:
            merged_bundle = current_bundle

        self._last_bundle = merged_bundle
        self._last_selected_model = selected_model
        self._pending_question = question
        self._populate_evidence_lists(merged_bundle)

        summary = dict((self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {}))
        summary["entry_files"] = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])

        prompt = self.prompt_builder.build(
            question=question,
            bundle=merged_bundle,
            project_root=self.project_index.project_root,
            summary=summary,
            memory_turns=self.memory.turns(),
        )
        self._last_prompt = prompt
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(prompt)
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("[Streaming...]\n\n")

        self.ai.ask(prompt, selected_model)

    def _populate_evidence_lists(self, bundle: RetrievalBundle) -> None:
        self.file_evidence_list.clear()
        self.symbol_evidence_list.clear()
        self.detail_box.clear()

        for item in bundle.file_evidence:
            label = "[" + item.evidence_id + "] " + shorten_path(item.path) + " | score=" + str(item.score)
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.file_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        for item in bundle.symbol_evidence:
            label = (
                "[" + item.evidence_id + "] "
                + item.symbol_name
                + " @ "
                + shorten_path(item.path, 70)
                + ":"
                + str(item.line)
            )
            list_item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            list_item.setData(Qt.UserRole, item.evidence_id)
            self.symbol_evidence_list.addItem(list_item)

        if bundle.file_evidence:
            self.file_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)
        elif bundle.symbol_evidence:
            self.symbol_evidence_list.setCurrentRow(0)

    def _show_selected_file_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.file_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_symbol_detail(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        evidence_id = current.data(Qt.UserRole)
        for item in self._last_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if item.evidence_id == evidence_id:
                self.detail_box.setPlainText(item.detail)
                return

    def _show_selected_history_turn(self, current: QListWidgetItem, previous: QListWidgetItem) -> None:
        _ = previous
        if not current:
            return
        row = self.history_list.row(current)
        turns = self.memory.turns()
        if row < 0 or row >= len(turns):
            return
        turn = turns[row]
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(turn.answer)
        self.prompt_preview.setPlainText(turn.prompt)

    def _refresh_history_list(self) -> None:
        self.history_list.clear()
        for idx, turn in enumerate(self.memory.turns(), start=1):
            label = str(idx) + ". " + turn.question
            item = QListWidgetItem(label)
            self.history_list.addItem(item)

    def _on_ai_answer_ready(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText(text)
        self._append_log("Local AI answer received.")

        turn = ConversationTurn(
            question=self._pending_question,
            answer=text,
            prompt=self._last_prompt,
            retrieval=self._last_bundle,
            selected_model=self._last_selected_model,
        )
        self.memory.add_turn(turn)
        self._refresh_history_list()

    def _on_ai_error_ready(self, error_text: str) -> None:
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("AI error:\n" + error_text)
        self._append_log("AI error: " + error_text)


def main() -> None:
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = JsonProjectReasonerV9()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

Yes. I checked the module, and the main persistence problem is here:

__init__ currently does this:

self._build_ui()
self._connect_signals()
self.refresh_models()
self._restore_last_config()

Why this breaks persistence

Because _connect_signals() already connects:

self.model_combo.currentTextChanged.connect(self._save_last_config)

Then refresh_models() changes the combo contents and current selection during startup, which triggers _save_last_config() too early.

At that moment:
json_path_edit is still empty
cache_dir_edit is still empty
governance_path_edit is still empty

So your previous saved values get overwritten with blanks before _restore_last_config() runs.

That is the real bug.

What is correct in your module

These parts are fine:
QSettings import
self.settings = QSettings("Kanda", "ProjectReasonerV10")
closeEvent
_restore_last_config
_save_last_config
calling _save_last_config() after load_json
calling _save_last_config() after pick_cache_dir
calling _save_last_config() after pick_governance_path

What must be corrected

You need a startup guard so settings are not saved while the window is still initializing.

Best fix

Add a flag:
self._settings_ready = False

Only allow _save_last_config() after startup restore is complete.

Exact corrections

    In __init__, after:

self.settings = QSettings("Kanda", "ProjectReasonerV10")

add:

self._settings_ready = False

    Still in __init__, replace:

self._build_ui()
self._connect_signals()
self.refresh_models()
self._restore_last_config()

with:

self._build_ui()
self._connect_signals()
self.refresh_models()
self._restore_last_config()
self._settings_ready = True

    In _save_last_config(), add this at the top:

if not getattr(self, "_settings_ready", False):
    return

So it becomes:

def _save_last_config(self) -> None:
    if not getattr(self, "_settings_ready", False):
        return

    self.settings.setValue("json_path", self.json_path_edit.text().strip())
    self.settings.setValue("cache_dir", self.cache_dir_edit.text().strip())
    self.settings.setValue("governance_path", self.governance_path_edit.text().strip())
    self.settings.setValue("selected_model", self.model_combo.currentText().strip())
    self.settings.setValue("window_geometry", self.saveGeometry())
    self.settings.sync()

That alone should stop the startup overwrite.

One more useful improvement

Your _restore_last_config() is fine for text fields and geometry, but the selected model restore depends on the model already existing in the combo. Since you call refresh_models() before _restore_last_config(), that part is okay.

So with the startup guard, your order can remain as-is.

Summary of exactly where to correct

Add here in __init__:

self.model_registry = LocalModelRegistry()
self.settings = QSettings("Kanda", "ProjectReasonerV10")
self._settings_ready = False

Keep this order:

self._build_ui()
self._connect_signals()
self.refresh_models()
self._restore_last_config()
self._settings_ready = True

And change _save_last_config() to:

def _save_last_config(self) -> None:
    if not getattr(self, "_settings_ready", False):
        return

    self.settings.setValue("json_path", self.json_path_edit.text().strip())
    self.settings.setValue("cache_dir", self.cache_dir_edit.text().strip())
    self.settings.setValue("governance_path", self.governance_path_edit.text().strip())
    self.settings.setValue("selected_model", self.model_combo.currentText().strip())
    self.settings.setValue("window_geometry", self.saveGeometry())
    self.settings.sync()

Why this fixes it

Because during startup:
refresh_models() can change the combo
signals can fire
but _save_last_config() will do nothing until _settings_ready = True

Then only real user changes will persist.

Validation after correction

Run:

python -m py_compile "developer_tools\project_reasoner\project_reasoner_v10\v10_main_window.py"
python "developer_tools\project_reasoner\project_reasoner_v10\v10_main_window.py"

Then:
set JSON
set cache dir
set governance path
change model
close window
open again

Expected:
all fields persist correctly

If you want, I can rewrite your full module with only these exact corrections inserted.
