Partly yes, but not ideal.

Why this happened

Your local AI did answer from project evidence, but it likely retrieved older/legacy UI files first, such as ProjectJsonExplorerV2 and ProjectJsonExplorerV3, instead of prioritizing the current V10 window and current app architecture.

So this means:

it is aware of the project index
but it is not yet focused enough on the current canonical implementation

What this tells us

Good news:
the retrieval-answer pipeline is working
the model is reading indexed evidence
the prompt/evidence flow is alive

Not good:
retrieval ranking is still too permissive
legacy files are contaminating the answer
the question was broad, so the retriever grabbed semantically similar but outdated UI classes

So the answer is:
expected at this stage, yes
desired final behavior, no

Why the question triggered this

Are you aware of the project?

is too broad.

For a broad prompt like that, the retriever often grabs:
old explorer classes
older UI builders
generic architecture snippets
files with many “project/json/explorer/ui” matches

That is why the answer drifted into V2/V3.

What a better answer should look like eventually

It should mention current things like:
JsonProjectReasonerV9 in v10_main_window.py
JsonProjectIndex
ProjectRetriever
PromptBuilder
LocalAIReasoner
runtime scenarios
runtime feature attribution
collector output JSON
current V10 help/governance/cache/model flow

So the current result shows:
the system is not hallucinating randomly
but retrieval prioritization still needs refinement

Best immediate validation

Ask much more anchored questions, for example:

Based on v10_main_window.py, explain how the V10 Project Reasoner sends project data to the local AI.

Using the currently loaded V10 index, explain the role of JsonProjectIndex, ProjectRetriever, PromptBuilder, and LocalAIReasoner.

Explain the current V10 GUI structure in developer_tools/project_reasoner/project_reasoner_v10/v10_main_window.py only.

Explain how runtime_scenarios and runtime_feature_attribution extend the collector output in the current project.

These should give much better answers.

What should be improved next

The retriever should prioritize:
current V10 files
active code
canonical files
non-legacy paths
maybe files marked current in chronology / active-code indexes

The simplest improvement would be one of these:

    boost current V10 paths

    penalize older, v2, v3, legacy, archived files

    prefer files marked active/current by your collector metadata

    add an option like “current code only”

Best concise verdict

So yes, this result is understandable for the current stage, but it also shows the next real problem clearly:

the system knows the project,
but it does not yet reliably distinguish canonical current architecture from older similar architecture.

That is the next thing to tighten.

Send me v10_retriever.py and I will show you exactly where to make it prefer current/canonical files over old ones.

Based on v10_main_window.py, explain how the V10 Project Reasoner sends project data to the local AI.

AttributeError: 'PySide6.QtGui.QTextCursor' object has no attribute 'End'

Yes — this is a real bug in the GUI streaming code.

What is wrong

In _on_ai_token_ready, you have:

cursor.movePosition(cursor.End)

cursor is an instance of QTextCursor.
End is not an instance attribute there, so PySide6 raises:

AttributeError: 'PySide6.QtGui.QTextCursor' object has no attribute 'End'

Correct fix

Use the enum from QTextCursor, not from the cursor instance.

    Update imports

Add QTextCursor to the QtGui imports.

If you do not already import it, add:

from PySide6.QtGui import QTextCursor

    Replace the broken line

Replace:

cursor.movePosition(cursor.End)

with:

cursor.movePosition(QTextCursor.MoveOperation.End)

Safest corrected method

Use this version for _on_ai_token_ready:

def _on_ai_token_ready(self, token: str) -> None:
    current = self.answer_box.toPlainText()
    if current == "[Streaming...]\n\n":
        self.answer_box.setPlainText("")

    cursor = self.answer_box.textCursor()
    cursor.movePosition(QTextCursor.MoveOperation.End)
    cursor.insertText(token)
    self.answer_box.setTextCursor(cursor)
    self.answer_box.ensureCursorVisible()

Where to correct

In:
developer_tools/project_reasoner/project_reasoner_v10/v10_main_window.py

At the top, add:

from PySide6.QtGui import QTextCursor

Then fix the line inside _on_ai_token_ready.

Why you saw many repeated tracebacks

Because the model was streaming token by token.
Each arriving token called _on_ai_token_ready.
Each call hit the same bad line.
So you got one traceback per token.

Validation

Run:

python -m py_compile "developer_tools\project_reasoner\project_reasoner_v10\v10_main_window.py"
python "developer_tools\project_reasoner\project_reasoner_v10\v10_main_window.py"

Then ask again:
Based on v10_main_window.py, explain how the V10 Project Reasoner sends project data to the local AI.

Expected result:
no repeated traceback
streamed text should appear normally in Local AI Answer

If you want, paste the import section around your QtGui imports and I’ll tell you the exact final import block.

in json path in gui we have E:/eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis/developer_tools/project_reasoner/reasoner_context_collector/outputs/project_reasoner_v10_index.json but json is not loaded 

That is expected with your current code.

What is happening

The saved config restores only the text field:

if json_path:
    self.json_path_edit.setText(json_path)

So the path reappears in the GUI, but the JSON is not actually loaded into:

self.project_index.index_data

That means:
the field is restored
but the internal project index is still empty

So if you ask the AI right after opening, the app still behaves as if no JSON was loaded.

Why

Your _restore_last_config() restores:
the JSON path text
cache dir
governance path
selected model
window geometry

But it does not call:

self.project_index.load_json(json_path)

So this is not a persistence failure of the field.
It is a missing auto-load step.

What to do

You have 2 choices.

Option 1
Keep current behavior

The path is remembered, but the user still clicks Load JSON manually each session.

Option 2
Auto-load the remembered JSON on startup

This is usually the better UX.

Best fix

In _restore_last_config(), replace the JSON-path section:

if json_path:
    self.json_path_edit.setText(json_path)

with:

if json_path:
    self.json_path_edit.setText(json_path)
    try:
        if os.path.exists(json_path):
            self.project_index.load_json(json_path)
            summary = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {})
            self._append_log("Auto-loaded JSON: " + json_path)
            self._append_log("Project root: " + self.project_index.project_root)
            self._append_log("Python files: " + str(summary.get("python_file_count", "unknown")))
            self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(summary.get("entry_file_count", "unknown")))
    except Exception as exc:
        self._append_log("Auto-load JSON failed: " + str(exc))

Where to correct

Inside:

def _restore_last_config(self) -> None:

Use this full corrected version:

def _restore_last_config(self) -> None:
    json_path = str(self.settings.value("json_path", "", type=str) or "")
    cache_dir = str(self.settings.value("cache_dir", "", type=str) or "")
    governance_path = str(self.settings.value("governance_path", "", type=str) or "")
    selected_model = str(self.settings.value("selected_model", "", type=str) or "")
    geometry = self.settings.value("window_geometry")

    if json_path:
        self.json_path_edit.setText(json_path)
        try:
            if os.path.exists(json_path):
                self.project_index.load_json(json_path)
                summary = (self.project_index.index_data or {}).get("project_summary", {})
                self._append_log("Auto-loaded JSON: " + json_path)
                self._append_log("Project root: " + self.project_index.project_root)
                self._append_log("Python files: " + str(summary.get("python_file_count", "unknown")))
                self._append_log("Entry files: " + str(summary.get("entry_file_count", "unknown")))
        except Exception as exc:
            self._append_log("Auto-load JSON failed: " + str(exc))

    if cache_dir:
        self.cache_dir_edit.setText(cache_dir)
        try:
            self.ai.set_cache_dir(cache_dir)
        except Exception:
            pass

    if governance_path:
        self.governance_path_edit.setText(governance_path)
        try:
            self.ai.set_governance_state_path(governance_path)
        except Exception:
            pass

    if selected_model:
        idx = self.model_combo.findText(selected_model)
        if idx >= 0:
            self.model_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx)

    if geometry is not None:
        try:
            self.restoreGeometry(geometry)
        except Exception:
            pass

Important note

Because you already have the startup guard:

self._settings_ready = False
...
self._restore_last_config()
self._settings_ready = True

this auto-load is safe and will not overwrite settings during restore.

How to validate

After changing it:

python -m py_compile "developer_tools\project_reasoner\project_reasoner_v10\v10_main_window.py"
python "developer_tools\project_reasoner\project_reasoner_v10\v10_main_window.py"

Expected on startup:
the JSON path field is filled
the log shows Auto-loaded JSON: ...
and you should be able to ask questions immediately without clicking Load JSON

The other issue you also need to fix is the streaming bug in _on_ai_token_ready, otherwise answers may still fail while streaming.

# developer_tools/project_reasoner/project_reasoner_v10/v10_retriever.py

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from typing import Any

from v10_index_loader import JsonProjectIndex
from v10_models import EvidenceItem, RetrievalBundle, SymbolEvidenceItem


def norm_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value).strip().lower() if value is not None else ""


def tokenize_query(text: str) -> list[str]:
    tokens = re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+", text.lower())
    stop_words = {
        "the",
        "is",
        "are",
        "a",
        "an",
        "of",
        "to",
        "me",
        "show",
        "which",
        "what",
        "where",
        "who",
        "does",
        "do",
        "in",
        "on",
        "for",
        "and",
        "or",
        "with",
        "code",
        "module",
        "file",
        "implementing",
        "implements",
        "created",
        "creates",
        "create",
        "that",
        "this",
        "app",
        "about",
        "how",
        "from",
        "explain",
    }
    return [token for token in tokens if token not in stop_words]


def safe_read_text(path: str) -> str:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        return handle.read()


class ProjectRetriever:
    def __init__(self, project_index: JsonProjectIndex) -> None:
        self.idx = project_index

    def retrieve(
        self,
        question: str,
        *,
        file_limit: int = 10,
        symbol_limit: int = 10,
        snippet_limit: int = 6,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_evidence = self._retrieve_files(question, file_limit)
        symbol_evidence = self._retrieve_symbols(question, symbol_limit)
        snippet_evidence = self._retrieve_snippets(file_evidence, symbol_evidence, snippet_limit)
        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=file_evidence,
            symbol_evidence=symbol_evidence,
            snippet_evidence=snippet_evidence,
        )

    def merge_with_previous(
        self,
        current_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        previous_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        *,
        max_files: int = 14,
        max_symbols: int = 14,
        max_snippets: int = 10,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_map: dict[str, EvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.file_evidence + previous_bundle.file_evidence:
            key = item.path
            old = file_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                file_map[key] = item

        symbol_map: dict[str, SymbolEvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.symbol_evidence + previous_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            key = item.symbol_name
            old = symbol_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                symbol_map[key] = item

        snippet_map: dict[tuple[str, int, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.snippet_evidence + previous_bundle.snippet_evidence:
            key = (item.get("path", ""), int(item.get("line", 0)), item.get("anchor", ""))
            snippet_map[key] = item

        merged_files = sorted(file_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.path))[:max_files]
        merged_symbols = sorted(symbol_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.symbol_name))[:max_symbols]
        merged_snippets = list(snippet_map.values())[:max_snippets]

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_files, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "F" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_symbols, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "S" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_snippets, start=1):
            item["snippet_id"] = "SN" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=merged_files,
            symbol_evidence=merged_symbols,
            snippet_evidence=merged_snippets,
        )

    def _retrieve_files(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[EvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        entry_files = set((self.idx.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", []))
        scored: list[EvidenceItem] = []

        for path, file_record in self.idx.files_by_path.items():
            module_name = file_record.get("module_name", "")
            docstring = file_record.get("docstring", "")
            strings = " ".join(file_record.get("strings", []))
            comments = " ".join(file_record.get("comments", []))
            entry_markers = " ".join(file_record.get("entry_markers", []))
            ui_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("ui_keyword_hits", []))
            eeg_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("eeg_keyword_hits", []))
            semantic_hints = " ".join(file_record.get("semantic_hints", []))
            roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

            function_names: list[str] = []
            class_names: list[str] = []
            called_symbols: list[str] = []

            for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
                function_names.append(fn.get("qualname", ""))
                function_names.append(fn.get("name", ""))
                for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                    called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
                class_names.append(cls.get("name", ""))
                for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                    function_names.append(method.get("qualname", ""))
                    function_names.append(method.get("name", ""))
                    for call in method.get("calls", []):
                        called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            haystack = " ".join(
                [
                    norm_text(path),
                    norm_text(module_name),
                    norm_text(docstring),
                    norm_text(strings),
                    norm_text(comments),
                    norm_text(entry_markers),
                    norm_text(ui_hits),
                    norm_text(eeg_hits),
                    norm_text(semantic_hints),
                    norm_text(" ".join(function_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(class_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(called_symbols)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(roles)),
                ]
            )

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 3
                    reasons.append("token:" + token)

            if path in entry_files and any(key in q for key in ["start", "startup", "main", "launch", "open app"]):
                score += 14
                reasons.append("entry-file")

            if "topomap" in q and ("topomap" in haystack or "amplitude_map" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("topomap-related")

            if "timeline" in q and "timeline" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("timeline-related")

            if "splash" in q and "splash" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("splash-related")

            if "tab" in q and ("tab" in haystack or "notebook" in haystack or "addtab" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("tab-related")

            if ("reset" in q or "snapshot" in q) and ("reset" in haystack or "snapshot" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("reset-related")

            if "responsibility" in q and ("manager" in haystack or "builder" in haystack or "controller" in haystack):
                score += 10
                reasons.append("responsibility-related")

            if "uncertainty" in q and ("warning" in haystack or "try" in haystack or "exception" in haystack):
                score += 8
                reasons.append("uncertainty-related")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            detail = self._build_compact_file_evidence(path, reasons)
            scored.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    path=path,
                    module_name=module_name,
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=detail,
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[EvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="F" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    path=item.path,
                    module_name=item.module_name,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_symbols(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[SymbolEvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        scored: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []

        for symbol_name, detail in self.idx.symbol_details.items():
            record = detail["record"]
            blob = norm_text(symbol_name)
            docstring = norm_text(record.get("docstring", ""))
            calls_blob = ""

            if detail["kind"] in ("function", "method"):
                calls_blob = norm_text(" ".join([c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])]))

            haystack = " ".join([blob, docstring, calls_blob])

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []
            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 4
                    reasons.append("symbol-token:" + token)

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            scored.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    symbol_name=symbol_name,
                    kind=detail["kind"],
                    path=detail["file"],
                    line=detail["line"],
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=self._build_symbol_evidence(symbol_name),
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.symbol_name))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="S" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    symbol_name=item.symbol_name,
                    kind=item.kind,
                    path=item.path,
                    line=item.line,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_snippets(
        self,
        file_evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
        symbol_evidence: list[SymbolEvidenceItem],
        limit: int,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        snippets: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()

        for item in symbol_evidence:
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, item.line)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, item.line, radius=20)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": item.line,
                    "anchor": item.symbol_name,
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        for item in file_evidence:
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, 1)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, 1, radius=40)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": 1,
                    "anchor": "file-start",
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        return snippets

    def _read_snippet(self, abs_path: str, line: int, radius: int) -> str:
        text = safe_read_text(abs_path)
        lines = text.splitlines()
        if not lines:
            return ""

        start = max(1, line - radius)
        end = min(len(lines), line + radius)
        out: list[str] = []

        for idx in range(start, end + 1):
            out.append(str(idx).rjust(5) + " | " + lines[idx - 1])

        return "\n".join(out)

    def _build_compact_file_evidence(self, path: str, reasons: list[str]) -> str:
        file_record = self.idx.files_by_path[path]
        roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Path: " + path)
        lines.append("Module: " + str(file_record.get("module_name", "")))
        lines.append("Reasons: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))))

        if roles:
            lines.append("Roles: " + ", ".join(roles))

        entry_markers = file_record.get("entry_markers", [])
        if entry_markers:
            lines.append("Entry markers: " + "; ".join(entry_markers[:6]))

        top_functions: list[str] = []
        for fn in file_record.get("functions", [])[:8]:
            top_functions.append(fn.get("qualname", "") + "@" + str(fn.get("lineno", "")))
        if top_functions:
            lines.append("Functions: " + " | ".join(top_functions))

        top_classes: list[str] = []
        for cls in file_record.get("classes", [])[:6]:
            class_text = cls.get("name", "") + "@" + str(cls.get("lineno", ""))
            methods = cls.get("methods", [])[:4]
            if methods:
                class_text += " methods=" + ",".join([m.get("name", "") for m in methods])
            top_classes.append(class_text)
        if top_classes:
            lines.append("Classes: " + " | ".join(top_classes))

        imports_out = sorted(self.idx.import_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if imports_out:
            lines.append("Imports out: " + " | ".join(imports_out[:8]))

        calls_out = sorted(self.idx.call_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if calls_out:
            lines.append("Calls out: " + " | ".join(calls_out[:10]))

        docstring = str(file_record.get("docstring", "")).strip()
        if docstring:
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", docstring)
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _build_symbol_evidence(self, symbol_name: str) -> str:
        detail = self.idx.symbol_details[symbol_name]
        path = detail["file"]
        line = detail["line"]
        kind = detail["kind"]
        record = detail["record"]

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Symbol: " + symbol_name)
        lines.append("Kind: " + kind)
        lines.append("Location: " + path + ":" + str(line))

        if record.get("docstring"):
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(record.get("docstring", "")).strip())
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        if kind in ("function", "method"):
            calls = [c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])[:20]]
            if calls:
                lines.append("Calls: " + " | ".join(calls))

        return "\n".join(lines)

Yes. The problem is in this retriever, and the main weakness is exactly where we expected: it has no strong notion of current/canonical vs old/legacy.

Your current retriever does this well

It matches:
path text
module names
docstrings
strings/comments
function/class names
calls
semantic roles

But it does this poorly

It does not strongly reward exact file/path mentions from the user question.
It does not penalize legacy paths like older, v8, v9, v2, v3.
It does not boost project_reasoner_v10 when the user explicitly asks about V10.
It does not boost the exact filename v10_main_window.py enough.
It uses broad token matching, so old similarly named explorers can outrank the current one.

That is why your answer drifted into JsonProjectReasonerV8.

What to fix

You should improve _retrieve_files() first.
That alone will likely solve most of the bad answers.

def path_tokens(path: str) -> list[str]:
    normalized = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
    parts = re.split(r"[\/_\-.]+", normalized)
    return [part for part in parts if part]


def detect_version_bias(question: str) -> dict[str, bool]:
    q = norm_text(question)
    return {
        "ask_v10": "v10" in q or "project_reasoner_v10" in q,
        "ask_v9": "v9" in q or "project_reasoner_v9" in q,
        "ask_v8": "v8" in q or "project_reasoner_v8" in q,
        "ask_current": any(word in q for word in ["current", "canonical", "latest", "active"]),
        "ask_only_file": ".py" in q or "/" in q or "\\" in q,
    }


def is_legacy_path(path: str) -> bool:
    low = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
    legacy_markers = [
        "/older/",
        "/legacy/",
        "project_reasoner_v2",
        "project_reasoner_v3",
        "project_reasoner_v4",
        "project_reasoner_v5",
        "project_reasoner_v6",
        "project_reasoner_v7",
        "project_reasoner_v8",
    ]
    return any(marker in low for marker in legacy_markers)


def file_name_from_path(path: str) -> str:
    return os.path.basename(path.replace("\\", "/")).lower()

Your merge_with_previous() is okay, but if a previous bad V8 bundle is merged into a current V10 query, it can contaminate the answer. Not mandatory yet, but later you should make merging aware of file generation/version.

instead of older V8/V3 explorers.

# developer_tools/project_reasoner/project_reasoner_v10/v10_retriever.py

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from typing import Any

from v10_index_loader import JsonProjectIndex
from v10_models import EvidenceItem, RetrievalBundle, SymbolEvidenceItem


def norm_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value).strip().lower() if value is not None else ""


def tokenize_query(text: str) -> list[str]:
    tokens = re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+", text.lower())
    stop_words = {
        "the",
        "is",
        "are",
        "a",
        "an",
        "of",
        "to",
        "me",
        "show",
        "which",
        "what",
        "where",
        "who",
        "does",
        "do",
        "in",
        "on",
        "for",
        "and",
        "or",
        "with",
        "code",
        "module",
        "file",
        "implementing",
        "implements",
        "created",
        "creates",
        "create",
        "that",
        "this",
        "app",
        "about",
        "how",
        "from",
        "explain",
    }
    return [token for token in tokens if token not in stop_words]


def safe_read_text(path: str) -> str:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        return handle.read()

def path_tokens(path: str) -> list[str]:
    normalized = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
    parts = re.split(r"[\/_\-.]+", normalized)
    return [part for part in parts if part]


def detect_version_bias(question: str) -> dict[str, bool]:
    q = norm_text(question)
    return {
        "ask_v10": "v10" in q or "project_reasoner_v10" in q,
        "ask_v9": "v9" in q or "project_reasoner_v9" in q,
        "ask_v8": "v8" in q or "project_reasoner_v8" in q,
        "ask_current": any(word in q for word in ["current", "canonical", "latest", "active"]),
        "ask_only_file": ".py" in q or "/" in q or "\\" in q,
    }


def is_legacy_path(path: str) -> bool:
    low = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
    legacy_markers = [
        "/older/",
        "/legacy/",
        "project_reasoner_v2",
        "project_reasoner_v3",
        "project_reasoner_v4",
        "project_reasoner_v5",
        "project_reasoner_v6",
        "project_reasoner_v7",
        "project_reasoner_v8",
    ]
    return any(marker in low for marker in legacy_markers)


def file_name_from_path(path: str) -> str:
    return os.path.basename(path.replace("\\", "/")).lower()


class ProjectRetriever:
    def __init__(self, project_index: JsonProjectIndex) -> None:
        self.idx = project_index

    def retrieve(
        self,
        question: str,
        *,
        file_limit: int = 10,
        symbol_limit: int = 10,
        snippet_limit: int = 6,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_evidence = self._retrieve_files(question, file_limit)
        symbol_evidence = self._retrieve_symbols(question, symbol_limit)
        snippet_evidence = self._retrieve_snippets(file_evidence, symbol_evidence, snippet_limit)
        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=file_evidence,
            symbol_evidence=symbol_evidence,
            snippet_evidence=snippet_evidence,
        )

    def merge_with_previous(
        self,
        current_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        previous_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        *,
        max_files: int = 14,
        max_symbols: int = 14,
        max_snippets: int = 10,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_map: dict[str, EvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.file_evidence + previous_bundle.file_evidence:
            key = item.path
            old = file_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                file_map[key] = item

        symbol_map: dict[str, SymbolEvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.symbol_evidence + previous_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            key = item.symbol_name
            old = symbol_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                symbol_map[key] = item

        snippet_map: dict[tuple[str, int, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.snippet_evidence + previous_bundle.snippet_evidence:
            key = (item.get("path", ""), int(item.get("line", 0)), item.get("anchor", ""))
            snippet_map[key] = item

        merged_files = sorted(file_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.path))[:max_files]
        merged_symbols = sorted(symbol_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.symbol_name))[:max_symbols]
        merged_snippets = list(snippet_map.values())[:max_snippets]

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_files, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "F" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_symbols, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "S" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_snippets, start=1):
            item["snippet_id"] = "SN" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=merged_files,
            symbol_evidence=merged_symbols,
            snippet_evidence=merged_snippets,
        )

    def _retrieve_files(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[EvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        entry_files = set((self.idx.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", []))
        scored: list[EvidenceItem] = []

        for path, file_record in self.idx.files_by_path.items():
            module_name = file_record.get("module_name", "")
            docstring = file_record.get("docstring", "")
            strings = " ".join(file_record.get("strings", []))
            comments = " ".join(file_record.get("comments", []))
            entry_markers = " ".join(file_record.get("entry_markers", []))
            ui_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("ui_keyword_hits", []))
            eeg_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("eeg_keyword_hits", []))
            semantic_hints = " ".join(file_record.get("semantic_hints", []))
            roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

            function_names: list[str] = []
            class_names: list[str] = []
            called_symbols: list[str] = []

            for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
                function_names.append(fn.get("qualname", ""))
                function_names.append(fn.get("name", ""))
                for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                    called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
                class_names.append(cls.get("name", ""))
                for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                    function_names.append(method.get("qualname", ""))
                    function_names.append(method.get("name", ""))
                    for call in method.get("calls", []):
                        called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            haystack = " ".join(
                [
                    norm_text(path),
                    norm_text(module_name),
                    norm_text(docstring),
                    norm_text(strings),
                    norm_text(comments),
                    norm_text(entry_markers),
                    norm_text(ui_hits),
                    norm_text(eeg_hits),
                    norm_text(semantic_hints),
                    norm_text(" ".join(function_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(class_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(called_symbols)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(roles)),
                ]
            )

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 3
                    reasons.append("token:" + token)

            if path in entry_files and any(key in q for key in ["start", "startup", "main", "launch", "open app"]):
                score += 14
                reasons.append("entry-file")

            if "topomap" in q and ("topomap" in haystack or "amplitude_map" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("topomap-related")

            if "timeline" in q and "timeline" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("timeline-related")

            if "splash" in q and "splash" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("splash-related")

            if "tab" in q and ("tab" in haystack or "notebook" in haystack or "addtab" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("tab-related")

            if ("reset" in q or "snapshot" in q) and ("reset" in haystack or "snapshot" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("reset-related")

            if "responsibility" in q and ("manager" in haystack or "builder" in haystack or "controller" in haystack):
                score += 10
                reasons.append("responsibility-related")

            if "uncertainty" in q and ("warning" in haystack or "try" in haystack or "exception" in haystack):
                score += 8
                reasons.append("uncertainty-related")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            detail = self._build_compact_file_evidence(path, reasons)
            scored.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    path=path,
                    module_name=module_name,
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=detail,
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[EvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="F" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    path=item.path,
                    module_name=item.module_name,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_symbols(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[SymbolEvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        scored: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []

        for symbol_name, detail in self.idx.symbol_details.items():
            record = detail["record"]
            blob = norm_text(symbol_name)
            docstring = norm_text(record.get("docstring", ""))
            calls_blob = ""

            if detail["kind"] in ("function", "method"):
                calls_blob = norm_text(" ".join([c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])]))

            haystack = " ".join([blob, docstring, calls_blob])

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []
            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 4
                    reasons.append("symbol-token:" + token)

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            scored.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    symbol_name=symbol_name,
                    kind=detail["kind"],
                    path=detail["file"],
                    line=detail["line"],
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=self._build_symbol_evidence(symbol_name),
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.symbol_name))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="S" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    symbol_name=item.symbol_name,
                    kind=item.kind,
                    path=item.path,
                    line=item.line,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_snippets(
        self,
        file_evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
        symbol_evidence: list[SymbolEvidenceItem],
        limit: int,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        snippets: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()

        for item in symbol_evidence:
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, item.line)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, item.line, radius=20)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": item.line,
                    "anchor": item.symbol_name,
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        for item in file_evidence:
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, 1)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, 1, radius=40)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": 1,
                    "anchor": "file-start",
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        return snippets

    def _read_snippet(self, abs_path: str, line: int, radius: int) -> str:
        text = safe_read_text(abs_path)
        lines = text.splitlines()
        if not lines:
            return ""

        start = max(1, line - radius)
        end = min(len(lines), line + radius)
        out: list[str] = []

        for idx in range(start, end + 1):
            out.append(str(idx).rjust(5) + " | " + lines[idx - 1])

        return "\n".join(out)

    def _build_compact_file_evidence(self, path: str, reasons: list[str]) -> str:
        file_record = self.idx.files_by_path[path]
        roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Path: " + path)
        lines.append("Module: " + str(file_record.get("module_name", "")))
        lines.append("Reasons: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))))

        if roles:
            lines.append("Roles: " + ", ".join(roles))

        entry_markers = file_record.get("entry_markers", [])
        if entry_markers:
            lines.append("Entry markers: " + "; ".join(entry_markers[:6]))

        top_functions: list[str] = []
        for fn in file_record.get("functions", [])[:8]:
            top_functions.append(fn.get("qualname", "") + "@" + str(fn.get("lineno", "")))
        if top_functions:
            lines.append("Functions: " + " | ".join(top_functions))

        top_classes: list[str] = []
        for cls in file_record.get("classes", [])[:6]:
            class_text = cls.get("name", "") + "@" + str(cls.get("lineno", ""))
            methods = cls.get("methods", [])[:4]
            if methods:
                class_text += " methods=" + ",".join([m.get("name", "") for m in methods])
            top_classes.append(class_text)
        if top_classes:
            lines.append("Classes: " + " | ".join(top_classes))

        imports_out = sorted(self.idx.import_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if imports_out:
            lines.append("Imports out: " + " | ".join(imports_out[:8]))

        calls_out = sorted(self.idx.call_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if calls_out:
            lines.append("Calls out: " + " | ".join(calls_out[:10]))

        docstring = str(file_record.get("docstring", "")).strip()
        if docstring:
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", docstring)
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _build_symbol_evidence(self, symbol_name: str) -> str:
        detail = self.idx.symbol_details[symbol_name]
        path = detail["file"]
        line = detail["line"]
        kind = detail["kind"]
        record = detail["record"]

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Symbol: " + symbol_name)
        lines.append("Kind: " + kind)
        lines.append("Location: " + path + ":" + str(line))

        if record.get("docstring"):
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(record.get("docstring", "")).strip())
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        if kind in ("function", "method"):
            calls = [c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])[:20]]
            if calls:
                lines.append("Calls: " + " | ".join(calls))

        return "\n".join(lines)

It does 4 important things:

strongly boosts exact path and filename matches
penalizes any legacy or non-V10 project_reasoner generations
keeps retrieval focused on current canonical V10 code

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from typing import Any

from v10_index_loader import JsonProjectIndex
from v10_models import EvidenceItem, RetrievalBundle, SymbolEvidenceItem


def norm_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value).strip().lower() if value is not None else ""


def tokenize_query(text: str) -> list[str]:
    tokens = re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+", text.lower())
    stop_words = {
        "the",
        "is",
        "are",
        "a",
        "an",
        "of",
        "to",
        "me",
        "show",
        "which",
        "what",
        "where",
        "who",
        "does",
        "do",
        "in",
        "on",
        "for",
        "and",

        "implementing",
        "implements",
        "created",
        "creates",
        "create",
        "that",
        "this",
        "app",
        "about",
        "how",
        "from",
        "explain",
        "based",
        "using",
        "only",
        "current",
    }
    return [token for token in tokens if token not in stop_words]


def safe_read_text(path: str) -> str:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        return handle.read()


def path_tokens(path: str) -> list[str]:
    normalized = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
    parts = re.split(r"[\/_\-.]+", normalized)
    return [part for part in parts if part]


def detect_version_bias(question: str) -> dict[str, bool]:
    q = norm_text(question)
    return {
        "ask_v10": "v10" in q or "project_reasoner_v10" in q,
        "ask_current": any(word in q for word in ["current", "canonical", "latest", "active"]),
        "ask_only_file": ".py" in q or "/" in q or "\\" in q,
    }


def is_legacy_path(path: str) -> bool:
    low = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
    legacy_markers = [
        "/older/",
        "/legacy/",
        "project_reasoner_v2",
        "project_reasoner_v3",
        "project_reasoner_v4",
        "project_reasoner_v5",
        "project_reasoner_v6",
        "project_reasoner_v7",
        "project_reasoner_v8",
        "project_reasoner_v9",
        "/v2_",
        "/v3_",
        "/v4_",
        "/v5_",
        "/v6_",
        "/v7_",
        "/v8_",
        "/v9_",
    ]
    return any(marker in low for marker in legacy_markers)


def file_name_from_path(path: str) -> str:
    return os.path.basename(path.replace("\\", "/")).lower()


def is_allowed_v10_path(path: str) -> bool:
    low = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
    if "project_reasoner_v10" not in low:
        return False
    if is_legacy_path(path):
        return False
    return True


class ProjectRetriever:
    def __init__(self, project_index: JsonProjectIndex) -> None:
        self.idx = project_index

    def retrieve(
        self,
        question: str,
        *,
        file_limit: int = 10,
        symbol_limit: int = 10,
        snippet_limit: int = 6,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_evidence = self._retrieve_files(question, file_limit)
        symbol_evidence = self._retrieve_symbols(question, symbol_limit)
        snippet_evidence = self._retrieve_snippets(file_evidence, symbol_evidence, snippet_limit)
        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=file_evidence,
            symbol_evidence=symbol_evidence,
            snippet_evidence=snippet_evidence,
        )

    def merge_with_previous(
        self,
        current_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        previous_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        *,
        max_files: int = 14,
        max_symbols: int = 14,
        max_snippets: int = 10,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_map: dict[str, EvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.file_evidence + previous_bundle.file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_v10_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.path
            old = file_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                file_map[key] = item

        symbol_map: dict[str, SymbolEvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.symbol_evidence + previous_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_v10_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.symbol_name + "|" + item.path
            old = symbol_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                symbol_map[key] = item

        snippet_map: dict[tuple[str, int, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.snippet_evidence + previous_bundle.snippet_evidence:
            path = str(item.get("path", ""))
            if not is_allowed_v10_path(path):
                continue
            key = (path, int(item.get("line", 0)), str(item.get("anchor", "")))
            snippet_map[key] = item

        merged_files = sorted(file_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.path))[:max_files]
        merged_symbols = sorted(symbol_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.symbol_name, x.path))[:max_symbols]
        merged_snippets = list(snippet_map.values())[:max_snippets]

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_files, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "F" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_symbols, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "S" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_snippets, start=1):
            item["snippet_id"] = "SN" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=merged_files,
            symbol_evidence=merged_symbols,
            snippet_evidence=merged_snippets,
        )

    def _retrieve_files(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[EvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        entry_files = {
            path for path in (self.idx.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])
            if is_allowed_v10_path(path)
        }
        version_bias = detect_version_bias(q)
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[EvidenceItem] = []

        for path, file_record in self.idx.files_by_path.items():
            if not is_allowed_v10_path(path):
                continue

            module_name = file_record.get("module_name", "")
            docstring = file_record.get("docstring", "")
            strings = " ".join(file_record.get("strings", []))
            comments = " ".join(file_record.get("comments", []))
            entry_markers = " ".join(file_record.get("entry_markers", []))
            ui_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("ui_keyword_hits", []))
            eeg_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("eeg_keyword_hits", []))
            semantic_hints = " ".join(file_record.get("semantic_hints", []))
            roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

            function_names: list[str] = []
            class_names: list[str] = []
            called_symbols: list[str] = []

            for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
                function_names.append(fn.get("qualname", ""))
                function_names.append(fn.get("name", ""))
                for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                    called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
                class_names.append(cls.get("name", ""))
                for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                    function_names.append(method.get("qualname", ""))
                    function_names.append(method.get("name", ""))
                    for call in method.get("calls", []):
                        called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            haystack = " ".join(
                [
                    norm_text(path),
                    norm_text(module_name),
                    norm_text(docstring),
                    norm_text(strings),
                    norm_text(comments),
                    norm_text(entry_markers),
                    norm_text(ui_hits),
                    norm_text(eeg_hits),
                    norm_text(semantic_hints),
                    norm_text(" ".join(function_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(class_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(called_symbols)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(roles)),
                ]
            )

            normalized_path = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if normalized_path in q:
                score += 120
                reasons.append("exact-path-match")

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 80
                reasons.append("exact-filename-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 80
                    reasons.append("question-filename-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 3
                    reasons.append("token:" + token)

            if "project_reasoner_v10" in normalized_path or base_name.startswith("v10_"):
                score += 40
                reasons.append("v10-allowed")

            if version_bias["ask_v10"]:
                if "project_reasoner_v10" in normalized_path or base_name.startswith("v10_"):
                    score += 40
                    reasons.append("v10-boost")

            if version_bias["ask_current"]:
                score += 20
                reasons.append("current-boost")

            if path in entry_files and any(key in q for key in ["start", "startup", "main", "launch", "open app"]):
                score += 14
                reasons.append("entry-file")

            if "topomap" in q and ("topomap" in haystack or "amplitude_map" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("topomap-related")

            if "timeline" in q and "timeline" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("timeline-related")

            if "splash" in q and "splash" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("splash-related")

            if "tab" in q and ("tab" in haystack or "notebook" in haystack or "addtab" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("tab-related")

            if ("reset" in q or "snapshot" in q) and ("reset" in haystack or "snapshot" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("reset-related")

            if "responsibility" in q and ("manager" in haystack or "builder" in haystack or "controller" in haystack):
                score += 10
                reasons.append("responsibility-related")

            if "uncertainty" in q and ("warning" in haystack or "try" in haystack or "exception" in haystack):
                score += 8
                reasons.append("uncertainty-related")

            if "ask_local_ai" in q and "ask_local_ai" in haystack:
                score += 25
                reasons.append("exact-symbol-ask_local_ai")

            if "localaireasoner" in q and "localaireasoner" in haystack:
                score += 20
                reasons.append("exact-symbol-local-ai")

            if "projectretriever" in q and "projectretriever" in haystack:
                score += 20
                reasons.append("exact-symbol-project-retriever")

            if "promptbuilder" in q and "promptbuilder" in haystack:
                score += 20
                reasons.append("exact-symbol-prompt-builder")

            if "v10_main_window.py" in q and base_name == "v10_main_window.py":
                score += 100
                reasons.append("target-main-window")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            detail = self._build_compact_file_evidence(path, reasons)
            scored.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    path=path,
                    module_name=module_name,
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=detail,
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[EvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="F" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    path=item.path,
                    module_name=item.module_name,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_symbols(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[SymbolEvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        version_bias = detect_version_bias(q)
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []

        for symbol_name, detail in self.idx.symbol_details.items():
            path = detail["file"]
            if not is_allowed_v10_path(path):
                continue

            record = detail["record"]
            blob = norm_text(symbol_name)
            docstring = norm_text(record.get("docstring", ""))
            calls_blob = ""

            if detail["kind"] in ("function", "method"):
                calls_blob = norm_text(" ".join([c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])]))

            haystack = " ".join([blob, docstring, calls_blob])

            normalized_path = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 30
                reasons.append("symbol-file-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 30
                    reasons.append("symbol-question-file-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 4
                    reasons.append("symbol-token:" + token)

            if version_bias["ask_v10"]:
                if "project_reasoner_v10" in normalized_path or base_name.startswith("v10_"):
                    score += 24
                    reasons.append("symbol-v10-boost")

            if version_bias["ask_current"]:
                score += 10
                reasons.append("symbol-current-boost")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            scored.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    symbol_name=symbol_name,
                    kind=detail["kind"],
                    path=path,
                    line=detail["line"],
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=self._build_symbol_evidence(symbol_name),
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.symbol_name, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="S" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    symbol_name=item.symbol_name,
                    kind=item.kind,
                    path=item.path,
                    line=item.line,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_snippets(
        self,
        file_evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
        symbol_evidence: list[SymbolEvidenceItem],
        limit: int,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        snippets: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()

        for item in symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_v10_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, item.line)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, item.line, radius=20)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": item.line,
                    "anchor": item.symbol_name,
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        for item in file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_v10_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, 1)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, 1, radius=40)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": 1,
                    "anchor": "file-start",
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        return snippets

    def _read_snippet(self, abs_path: str, line: int, radius: int) -> str:
        text = safe_read_text(abs_path)
        lines = text.splitlines()
        if not lines:
            return ""

        start = max(1, line - radius)
        end = min(len(lines), line + radius)
        out: list[str] = []

        for idx in range(start, end + 1):
            out.append(str(idx).rjust(5) + " | " + lines[idx - 1])

        return "\n".join(out)

    def _build_compact_file_evidence(self, path: str, reasons: list[str]) -> str:
        file_record = self.idx.files_by_path[path]
        roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Path: " + path)
        lines.append("Module: " + str(file_record.get("module_name", "")))
        lines.append("Reasons: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))))

        if roles:
            lines.append("Roles: " + ", ".join(roles))

        entry_markers = file_record.get("entry_markers", [])
        if entry_markers:
            lines.append("Entry markers: " + "; ".join(entry_markers[:6]))

        top_functions: list[str] = []
        for fn in file_record.get("functions", [])[:8]:
            top_functions.append(fn.get("qualname", "") + "@" + str(fn.get("lineno", "")))
        if top_functions:
            lines.append("Functions: " + " | ".join(top_functions))

        top_classes: list[str] = []
        for cls in file_record.get("classes", [])[:6]:
            class_text = cls.get("name", "") + "@" + str(cls.get("lineno", ""))
            methods = cls.get("methods", [])[:4]
            if methods:
                class_text += " methods=" + ",".join([m.get("name", "") for m in methods])
            top_classes.append(class_text)
        if top_classes:
            lines.append("Classes: " + " | ".join(top_classes))

        imports_out = sorted(self.idx.import_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if imports_out:
            lines.append("Imports out: " + " | ".join(imports_out[:8]))

        calls_out = sorted(self.idx.call_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if calls_out:
            lines.append("Calls out: " + " | ".join(calls_out[:10]))

        docstring = str(file_record.get("docstring", "")).strip()
        if docstring:
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", docstring)
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _build_symbol_evidence(self, symbol_name: str) -> str:
        detail = self.idx.symbol_details[symbol_name]
        path = detail["file"]
        line = detail["line"]
        kind = detail["kind"]
        record = detail["record"]

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Symbol: " + symbol_name)
        lines.append("Kind: " + kind)
        lines.append("Location: " + path + ":" + str(line))

        if record.get("docstring"):
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(record.get("docstring", "")).strip())
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        if kind in ("function", "method"):
            calls = [c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])[:20]]
            if calls:
                lines.append("Calls: " + " | ".join(calls))

        return "\n".join(lines)

Based on v10_main_window.py, explain how the V10 Project Reasoner sends project data to the local AI.

Expected improvement:
it should stop citing V8/V9 and stay inside V10-only evidence.

The next highest-value improvement after this is to make the prompt builder explicitly tell the model:
“Use only V10 evidence items shown below; ignore older generations.”

can this be hard coded “Use only V10 evidence items shown below; ignore older generations.”

Yes, and you should.

That sentence is a good hard guardrail in the prompt layer.

Best answer:
do it in both places

Retriever level
already restrict evidence to V10-only

Prompt layer
explicitly instruct the model:

Use only V10 evidence items shown below. Ignore older generations, legacy files, V8, V9, and any unstated assumptions.

Why both are useful

Retriever filtering reduces bad evidence coming in.
Prompt hard-coding reduces model drift even if some stray evidence slips through.

Where to put it

Best place:
developer_tools/project_reasoner/project_reasoner_v10/v10_prompt_builder.py

You want it near the top of the final prompt, before the evidence pack.

Recommended wording

Use this exact instruction block:

SYSTEM CONSTRAINTS:
- Use only V10 evidence items shown below.
- Ignore older generations, legacy implementations, V8, V9, and archived variants.
- Do not infer behavior from files that are not included in the evidence pack.
- If the evidence is insufficient, say so explicitly.
- Prefer exact file, symbol, and snippet evidence over general similarity.

Even stronger version

SYSTEM CONSTRAINTS:
- The authoritative scope for this session is Project Reasoner V10 only.
- Use only evidence items whose paths belong to project_reasoner_v10.
- Ignore V9, V8, older, legacy, archived, and non-V10 generations even if they seem similar.
- Do not answer from memory when the evidence pack does not support the claim.
- If evidence is partial, report uncertainty explicitly.

What I recommend

Since you already made the retriever V10-only, use the stronger version.

Important limitation

Hard-coding this in the prompt is very helpful, but it is not a substitute for retrieval filtering.
If the retriever sends bad evidence, the model may still get confused.
So prompt hard-coding is reinforcement, not the only protection.

Best implementation strategy

In v10_prompt_builder.py, add a constant like:

V10_SCOPE_GUARDRAIL = (
    "SYSTEM CONSTRAINTS:\n"
    "- The authoritative scope for this session is Project Reasoner V10 only.\n"
    "- Use only evidence items whose paths belong to project_reasoner_v10.\n"
    "- Ignore V9, V8, older, legacy, archived, and non-V10 generations even if they seem similar.\n"
    "- Do not answer from memory when the evidence pack does not support the claim.\n"
    "- If evidence is partial, report uncertainty explicitly.\n"
)

Then prepend it to the built prompt before the question and evidence sections.

So yes:
hard-code it in the prompt builder. That is the correct move.

Paste v10_prompt_builder.py and I will show you exactly where to insert it.
