        "project",
    }
    return [token for token in tokens if token not in stop_words]


def safe_read_text(path: str) -> str:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        return handle.read()


def file_name_from_path(path: str) -> str:
    return os.path.basename(path.replace("\\", "/")).lower()


def is_allowed_project_path(path: str) -> bool:
    low = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()

    blocked_parts = [
        "/developer_tools/",
        "/.git/",
        "/.idea/",
        "/.venv/",
        "/venv/",
        "/env/",
        "/site-packages/",
        "/__pycache__/",
        "/build/",
        "/dist/",
        "/scratches/",
        "/consoles/",
        "/external libraries/",
        "/logic_main_app/chats/",
    ]

    return not any(part in low for part in blocked_parts)


class ProjectRetriever:
    def __init__(self, project_index: JsonProjectIndex) -> None:
        self.idx = project_index

    def retrieve(
        self,
        question: str,
        *,
        file_limit: int = 10,
        symbol_limit: int = 10,
        snippet_limit: int = 6,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_evidence = self._retrieve_files(question, file_limit)
        symbol_evidence = self._retrieve_symbols(question, symbol_limit)
        snippet_evidence = self._retrieve_snippets(file_evidence, symbol_evidence, snippet_limit)
        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=file_evidence,
            symbol_evidence=symbol_evidence,
            snippet_evidence=snippet_evidence,
        )

    def merge_with_previous(
        self,
        current_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        previous_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        *,
        max_files: int = 14,
        max_symbols: int = 14,
        max_snippets: int = 10,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_map: dict[str, EvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.file_evidence + previous_bundle.file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.path
            old = file_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                file_map[key] = item

        symbol_map: dict[str, SymbolEvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.symbol_evidence + previous_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.symbol_name + "|" + item.path
            old = symbol_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                symbol_map[key] = item

        snippet_map: dict[tuple[str, int, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.snippet_evidence + previous_bundle.snippet_evidence:
            path = str(item.get("path", ""))
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue
            key = (path, int(item.get("line", 0)), str(item.get("anchor", "")))
            snippet_map[key] = item

        merged_files = sorted(file_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.path))[:max_files]
        merged_symbols = sorted(symbol_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.symbol_name, x.path))[:max_symbols]
        merged_snippets = list(snippet_map.values())[:max_snippets]

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_files, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "F" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_symbols, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "S" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_snippets, start=1):
            item["snippet_id"] = "SN" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=merged_files,
            symbol_evidence=merged_symbols,
            snippet_evidence=merged_snippets,
        )

    def _retrieve_files(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[EvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        entry_files = {
            path for path in (self.idx.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])
            if is_allowed_project_path(path)
        }
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[EvidenceItem] = []

        for path, file_record in self.idx.files_by_path.items():
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue

            module_name = file_record.get("module_name", "")
            docstring = file_record.get("docstring", "")
            strings = " ".join(file_record.get("strings", []))
            comments = " ".join(file_record.get("comments", []))
            entry_markers = " ".join(file_record.get("entry_markers", []))
            ui_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("ui_keyword_hits", []))
            eeg_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("eeg_keyword_hits", []))
            semantic_hints = " ".join(file_record.get("semantic_hints", []))
            roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

            function_names: list[str] = []
            class_names: list[str] = []
            called_symbols: list[str] = []

            for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
                function_names.append(fn.get("qualname", ""))
                function_names.append(fn.get("name", ""))
                for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                    called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
                class_names.append(cls.get("name", ""))
                for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                    function_names.append(method.get("qualname", ""))
                    function_names.append(method.get("name", ""))
                    for call in method.get("calls", []):
                        called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            haystack = " ".join(
                [
                    norm_text(path),
                    norm_text(module_name),
                    norm_text(docstring),
                    norm_text(strings),
                    norm_text(comments),
                    norm_text(entry_markers),
                    norm_text(ui_hits),
                    norm_text(eeg_hits),
                    norm_text(semantic_hints),
                    norm_text(" ".join(function_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(class_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(called_symbols)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(roles)),
                ]
            )

            normalized_path = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if normalized_path in q:
                score += 120
                reasons.append("exact-path-match")

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 80
                reasons.append("exact-filename-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 80
                    reasons.append("question-filename-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 3
                    reasons.append("token:" + token)

            if path in entry_files and any(key in q for key in ["start", "startup", "main", "launch", "open", "show"]):
                score += 14
                reasons.append("entry-file")

            if "topomap" in q and ("topomap" in haystack or "amplitude_map" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("topomap-related")

            if "timeline" in q and "timeline" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("timeline-related")

            if "splash" in q and "splash" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("splash-related")

            if "tab" in q and ("tab" in haystack or "notebook" in haystack or "addtab" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("tab-related")

            if ("reset" in q or "snapshot" in q or "cleanup" in q or "close" in q) and (
                "reset" in haystack or "snapshot" in haystack or "cleanup" in haystack or "close" in haystack
            ):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("reset-related")

            if "responsibility" in q and ("manager" in haystack or "builder" in haystack or "controller" in haystack):
                score += 10
                reasons.append("responsibility-related")

            if "uncertainty" in q and ("warning" in haystack or "try" in haystack or "exception" in haystack):
                score += 8
                reasons.append("uncertainty-related")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            detail = self._build_compact_file_evidence(path, reasons)
            scored.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    path=path,
                    module_name=module_name,
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=detail,
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[EvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="F" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    path=item.path,
                    module_name=item.module_name,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_symbols(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[SymbolEvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []

        for symbol_name, detail in self.idx.symbol_details.items():
            path = detail["file"]
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue

            record = detail["record"]
            blob = norm_text(symbol_name)
            docstring = norm_text(record.get("docstring", ""))
            calls_blob = ""

            if detail["kind"] in ("function", "method"):
                calls_blob = norm_text(" ".join([c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])]))

            haystack = " ".join([blob, docstring, calls_blob])

            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 30
                reasons.append("symbol-file-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 30
                    reasons.append("symbol-question-file-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 4
                    reasons.append("symbol-token:" + token)

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            scored.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    symbol_name=symbol_name,
                    kind=detail["kind"],
                    path=path,
                    line=detail["line"],
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=self._build_symbol_evidence(symbol_name),
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.symbol_name, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="S" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    symbol_name=item.symbol_name,
                    kind=item.kind,
                    path=item.path,
                    line=item.line,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_snippets(
        self,
        file_evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
        symbol_evidence: list[SymbolEvidenceItem],
        limit: int,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        snippets: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()

        for item in symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, item.line)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, item.line, radius=20)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": item.line,
                    "anchor": item.symbol_name,
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        for item in file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, 1)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, 1, radius=40)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": 1,
                    "anchor": "file-start",
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        return snippets

    def _read_snippet(self, abs_path: str, line: int, radius: int) -> str:
        text = safe_read_text(abs_path)
        lines = text.splitlines()
        if not lines:
            return ""

        start = max(1, line - radius)
        end = min(len(lines), line + radius)
        out: list[str] = []

        for idx in range(start, end + 1):
            out.append(str(idx).rjust(5) + " | " + lines[idx - 1])

        return "\n".join(out)

    def _build_compact_file_evidence(self, path: str, reasons: list[str]) -> str:
        file_record = self.idx.files_by_path[path]
        roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Path: " + path)
        lines.append("Module: " + str(file_record.get("module_name", "")))
        lines.append("Reasons: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))))

        if roles:
            lines.append("Roles: " + ", ".join(roles))

        entry_markers = file_record.get("entry_markers", [])
        if entry_markers:
            lines.append("Entry markers: " + "; ".join(entry_markers[:6]))

        top_functions: list[str] = []
        for fn in file_record.get("functions", [])[:8]:
            top_functions.append(fn.get("qualname", "") + "@" + str(fn.get("lineno", "")))
        if top_functions:
            lines.append("Functions: " + " | ".join(top_functions))

        top_classes: list[str] = []
        for cls in file_record.get("classes", [])[:6]:
            class_text = cls.get("name", "") + "@" + str(cls.get("lineno", ""))
            methods = cls.get("methods", [])[:4]
            if methods:
                class_text += " methods=" + ",".join([m.get("name", "") for m in methods])
            top_classes.append(class_text)
        if top_classes:
            lines.append("Classes: " + " | ".join(top_classes))

        imports_out = sorted(self.idx.import_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if imports_out:
            lines.append("Imports out: " + " | ".join(imports_out[:8]))

        calls_out = sorted(self.idx.call_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if calls_out:
            lines.append("Calls out: " + " | ".join(calls_out[:10]))

        docstring = str(file_record.get("docstring", "")).strip()
        if docstring:
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", docstring)
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _build_symbol_evidence(self, symbol_name: str) -> str:
        detail = self.idx.symbol_details[symbol_name]
        path = detail["file"]
        line = detail["line"]
        kind = detail["kind"]
        record = detail["record"]

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Symbol: " + symbol_name)
        lines.append("Kind: " + kind)
        lines.append("Location: " + path + ":" + str(line))

        if record.get("docstring"):
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(record.get("docstring", "")).strip())
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        if kind in ("function", "method"):
            calls = [c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])[:20]]
            if calls:
                lines.append("Calls: " + " | ".join(calls))

        return "\n".join(lines)

    if any(term in normalized_path for term in ["help", "tooltip", "popup", "modal", "dialog"]):
        score -= 20
        reasons.append("startup-auxiliary-penalty")

Conclusão

Para essa pergunta, a resposta do AI não foi adequada.
Ela está recuperando evidência real, mas do lugar errado.
O próximo passo certo é ajustar o ranking do retriever para privilegiar a cadeia principal de startup.

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from typing import Any

from v10_index_loader import JsonProjectIndex
from v10_models import EvidenceItem, RetrievalBundle, SymbolEvidenceItem


def norm_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value).strip().lower() if value is not None else ""


def tokenize_query(text: str) -> list[str]:
    tokens = re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+", text.lower())
    stop_words = {
        "the",
        "is",
        "are",
        "a",
        "an",
        "of",
        "to",
        "me",
        "show",
        "which",
        "what",
        "where",
        "who",
        "does",
        "do",
        "in",
        "on",
        "for",
        "and",
        "or",
        "with",
        "code",
        "module",
        "file",
        "implementing",
        "implements",
        "created",
        "creates",
        "create",
        "that",
        "this",
        "app",
        "about",
        "how",
        "from",
        "explain",
        "based",
        "using",
        "only",
        "current",
        "project",
    }
    return [token for token in tokens if token not in stop_words]


def safe_read_text(path: str) -> str:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        return handle.read()


def file_name_from_path(path: str) -> str:
    return os.path.basename(path.replace("\\", "/")).lower()


def is_allowed_project_path(path: str) -> bool:
    low = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()

    blocked_parts = [
        "/developer_tools/",
        "/.git/",
        "/.idea/",
        "/.venv/",
        "/venv/",
        "/env/",
        "/site-packages/",
        "/__pycache__/",
        "/build/",
        "/dist/",
        "/scratches/",
        "/consoles/",
        "/external libraries/",
        "/logic_main_app/chats/",
    ]

    return not any(part in low for part in blocked_parts)


class ProjectRetriever:
    def __init__(self, project_index: JsonProjectIndex) -> None:
        self.idx = project_index

    def retrieve(
        self,
        question: str,
        *,
        file_limit: int = 10,
        symbol_limit: int = 10,
        snippet_limit: int = 6,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_evidence = self._retrieve_files(question, file_limit)
        symbol_evidence = self._retrieve_symbols(question, symbol_limit)
        snippet_evidence = self._retrieve_snippets(file_evidence, symbol_evidence, snippet_limit)
        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=file_evidence,
            symbol_evidence=symbol_evidence,
            snippet_evidence=snippet_evidence,
        )

    def merge_with_previous(
        self,
        current_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        previous_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        *,
        max_files: int = 14,
        max_symbols: int = 14,
        max_snippets: int = 10,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_map: dict[str, EvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.file_evidence + previous_bundle.file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.path
            old = file_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                file_map[key] = item

        symbol_map: dict[str, SymbolEvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.symbol_evidence + previous_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.symbol_name + "|" + item.path
            old = symbol_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                symbol_map[key] = item

        snippet_map: dict[tuple[str, int, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.snippet_evidence + previous_bundle.snippet_evidence:
            path = str(item.get("path", ""))
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue
            key = (path, int(item.get("line", 0)), str(item.get("anchor", "")))
            snippet_map[key] = item

        merged_files = sorted(file_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.path))[:max_files]
        merged_symbols = sorted(symbol_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.symbol_name, x.path))[:max_symbols]
        merged_snippets = list(snippet_map.values())[:max_snippets]

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_files, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "F" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_symbols, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "S" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_snippets, start=1):
            item["snippet_id"] = "SN" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=merged_files,
            symbol_evidence=merged_symbols,
            snippet_evidence=merged_snippets,
        )

    def _retrieve_files(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[EvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        entry_files = {
            path for path in (self.idx.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])
            if is_allowed_project_path(path)
        }
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[EvidenceItem] = []

        for path, file_record in self.idx.files_by_path.items():
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue

            module_name = file_record.get("module_name", "")
            docstring = file_record.get("docstring", "")
            strings = " ".join(file_record.get("strings", []))
            comments = " ".join(file_record.get("comments", []))
            entry_markers = " ".join(file_record.get("entry_markers", []))
            ui_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("ui_keyword_hits", []))
            eeg_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("eeg_keyword_hits", []))
            semantic_hints = " ".join(file_record.get("semantic_hints", []))
            roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

            function_names: list[str] = []
            class_names: list[str] = []
            called_symbols: list[str] = []

            for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
                function_names.append(fn.get("qualname", ""))
                function_names.append(fn.get("name", ""))
                for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                    called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
                class_names.append(cls.get("name", ""))
                for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                    function_names.append(method.get("qualname", ""))
                    function_names.append(method.get("name", ""))
                    for call in method.get("calls", []):
                        called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            haystack = " ".join(
                [
                    norm_text(path),
                    norm_text(module_name),
                    norm_text(docstring),
                    norm_text(strings),
                    norm_text(comments),
                    norm_text(entry_markers),
                    norm_text(ui_hits),
                    norm_text(eeg_hits),
                    norm_text(semantic_hints),
                    norm_text(" ".join(function_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(class_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(called_symbols)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(roles)),
                ]
            )

            normalized_path = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if normalized_path in q:
                score += 120
                reasons.append("exact-path-match")

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 80
                reasons.append("exact-filename-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 80
                    reasons.append("question-filename-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 3
                    reasons.append("token:" + token)

            if path in entry_files and any(key in q for key in ["start", "startup", "main", "launch", "open", "show"]):
                score += 14
                reasons.append("entry-file")

            if "topomap" in q and ("topomap" in haystack or "amplitude_map" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("topomap-related")

            if "timeline" in q and "timeline" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("timeline-related")

            if "splash" in q and "splash" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("splash-related")

            if "tab" in q and ("tab" in haystack or "notebook" in haystack or "addtab" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("tab-related")

            if ("reset" in q or "snapshot" in q or "cleanup" in q or "close" in q) and (
                "reset" in haystack or "snapshot" in haystack or "cleanup" in haystack or "close" in haystack
            ):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("reset-related")

            if "responsibility" in q and ("manager" in haystack or "builder" in haystack or "controller" in haystack):
                score += 10
                reasons.append("responsibility-related")

            if "uncertainty" in q and ("warning" in haystack or "try" in haystack or "exception" in haystack):
                score += 8
                reasons.append("uncertainty-related")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            detail = self._build_compact_file_evidence(path, reasons)
            scored.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    path=path,
                    module_name=module_name,
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=detail,
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[EvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="F" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    path=item.path,
                    module_name=item.module_name,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_symbols(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[SymbolEvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []

        for symbol_name, detail in self.idx.symbol_details.items():
            path = detail["file"]
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue

            record = detail["record"]
            blob = norm_text(symbol_name)
            docstring = norm_text(record.get("docstring", ""))
            calls_blob = ""

            if detail["kind"] in ("function", "method"):
                calls_blob = norm_text(" ".join([c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])]))

            haystack = " ".join([blob, docstring, calls_blob])

            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 30
                reasons.append("symbol-file-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 30
                    reasons.append("symbol-question-file-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 4
                    reasons.append("symbol-token:" + token)

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            scored.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    symbol_name=symbol_name,
                    kind=detail["kind"],
                    path=path,
                    line=detail["line"],
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=self._build_symbol_evidence(symbol_name),
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.symbol_name, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="S" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    symbol_name=item.symbol_name,
                    kind=item.kind,
                    path=item.path,
                    line=item.line,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_snippets(
        self,
        file_evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
        symbol_evidence: list[SymbolEvidenceItem],
        limit: int,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        snippets: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()

        for item in symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, item.line)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, item.line, radius=20)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": item.line,
                    "anchor": item.symbol_name,
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        for item in file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, 1)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, 1, radius=40)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": 1,
                    "anchor": "file-start",
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        return snippets

    def _read_snippet(self, abs_path: str, line: int, radius: int) -> str:
        text = safe_read_text(abs_path)
        lines = text.splitlines()
        if not lines:
            return ""

        start = max(1, line - radius)
        end = min(len(lines), line + radius)
        out: list[str] = []

        for idx in range(start, end + 1):
            out.append(str(idx).rjust(5) + " | " + lines[idx - 1])

        return "\n".join(out)

    def _build_compact_file_evidence(self, path: str, reasons: list[str]) -> str:
        file_record = self.idx.files_by_path[path]
        roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Path: " + path)
        lines.append("Module: " + str(file_record.get("module_name", "")))
        lines.append("Reasons: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))))

        if roles:
            lines.append("Roles: " + ", ".join(roles))

        entry_markers = file_record.get("entry_markers", [])
        if entry_markers:
            lines.append("Entry markers: " + "; ".join(entry_markers[:6]))

        top_functions: list[str] = []
        for fn in file_record.get("functions", [])[:8]:
            top_functions.append(fn.get("qualname", "") + "@" + str(fn.get("lineno", "")))
        if top_functions:
            lines.append("Functions: " + " | ".join(top_functions))

        top_classes: list[str] = []
        for cls in file_record.get("classes", [])[:6]:
            class_text = cls.get("name", "") + "@" + str(cls.get("lineno", ""))
            methods = cls.get("methods", [])[:4]
            if methods:
                class_text += " methods=" + ",".join([m.get("name", "") for m in methods])
            top_classes.append(class_text)
        if top_classes:
            lines.append("Classes: " + " | ".join(top_classes))

        imports_out = sorted(self.idx.import_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if imports_out:
            lines.append("Imports out: " + " | ".join(imports_out[:8]))

        calls_out = sorted(self.idx.call_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if calls_out:
            lines.append("Calls out: " + " | ".join(calls_out[:10]))

        docstring = str(file_record.get("docstring", "")).strip()
        if docstring:
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", docstring)
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _build_symbol_evidence(self, symbol_name: str) -> str:
        detail = self.idx.symbol_details[symbol_name]
        path = detail["file"]
        line = detail["line"]
        kind = detail["kind"]
        record = detail["record"]

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Symbol: " + symbol_name)
        lines.append("Kind: " + kind)
        lines.append("Location: " + path + ":" + str(line))

        if record.get("docstring"):
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(record.get("docstring", "")).strip())
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        if kind in ("function", "method"):
            calls = [c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])[:20]]
            if calls:
                lines.append("Calls: " + " | ".join(calls))

        return "\n".join(lines)

def is_allowed_project_path(path: str) -> bool:

def is_auxiliary_ui_path(path: str) -> bool:

class ProjectRetriever:
    def __init__(self, project_index: JsonProjectIndex) -> None:
        self.idx = project_index

    def retrieve(
        self,
        question: str,
        *,
        file_limit: int = 10,
        symbol_limit: int = 10,
        snippet_limit: int = 6,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_evidence = self._retrieve_files(question, file_limit)
        symbol_evidence = self._retrieve_symbols(question, symbol_limit)
        snippet_evidence = self._retrieve_snippets(file_evidence, symbol_evidence, snippet_limit)
        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=file_evidence,
            symbol_evidence=symbol_evidence,
            snippet_evidence=snippet_evidence,
        )

    def merge_with_previous(
        self,
        current_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        previous_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        *,
        max_files: int = 14,
        max_symbols: int = 14,
        max_snippets: int = 10,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_map: dict[str, EvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.file_evidence + previous_bundle.file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.path
            old = file_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                file_map[key] = item

        symbol_map: dict[str, SymbolEvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.symbol_evidence + previous_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.symbol_name + "|" + item.path
            old = symbol_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                symbol_map[key] = item

        snippet_map: dict[tuple[str, int, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.snippet_evidence + previous_bundle.snippet_evidence:
            path = str(item.get("path", ""))
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue
            key = (path, int(item.get("line", 0)), str(item.get("anchor", "")))
            snippet_map[key] = item

        merged_files = sorted(file_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.path))[:max_files]
        merged_symbols = sorted(symbol_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.symbol_name, x.path))[:max_symbols]
        merged_snippets = list(snippet_map.values())[:max_snippets]

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_files, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "F" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_symbols, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "S" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_snippets, start=1):
            item["snippet_id"] = "SN" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=merged_files,
            symbol_evidence=merged_symbols,
            snippet_evidence=merged_snippets,
        )

    def _retrieve_files(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[EvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        startup_query = is_startup_question(q)

        entry_files = {
            path for path in (self.idx.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])
            if is_allowed_project_path(path)
        }
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[EvidenceItem] = []

        for path, file_record in self.idx.files_by_path.items():
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue

            module_name = file_record.get("module_name", "")
            docstring = file_record.get("docstring", "")
            strings = " ".join(file_record.get("strings", []))
            comments = " ".join(file_record.get("comments", []))
            entry_markers = " ".join(file_record.get("entry_markers", []))
            ui_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("ui_keyword_hits", []))
            eeg_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("eeg_keyword_hits", []))
            semantic_hints = " ".join(file_record.get("semantic_hints", []))
            roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

            function_names: list[str] = []
            class_names: list[str] = []
            called_symbols: list[str] = []

            for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
                function_names.append(fn.get("qualname", ""))
                function_names.append(fn.get("name", ""))
                for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                    called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
                class_names.append(cls.get("name", ""))
                for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                    function_names.append(method.get("qualname", ""))
                    function_names.append(method.get("name", ""))
                    for call in method.get("calls", []):
                        called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            haystack = " ".join(
                [
                    norm_text(path),
                    norm_text(module_name),
                    norm_text(docstring),
                    norm_text(strings),
                    norm_text(comments),
                    norm_text(entry_markers),
                    norm_text(ui_hits),
                    norm_text(eeg_hits),
                    norm_text(semantic_hints),
                    norm_text(" ".join(function_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(class_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(called_symbols)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(roles)),
                ]
            )

            normalized_path = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if normalized_path in q:
                score += 120
                reasons.append("exact-path-match")

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 80
                reasons.append("exact-filename-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 80
                    reasons.append("question-filename-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 3
                    reasons.append("token:" + token)

            if path in entry_files and any(key in q for key in ["start", "startup", "main", "launch", "open", "show"]):
                score += 14
                reasons.append("entry-file")

            if "topomap" in q and ("topomap" in haystack or "amplitude_map" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("topomap-related")

            if "timeline" in q and "timeline" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("timeline-related")

            if "splash" in q and "splash" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("splash-related")

            if "tab" in q and ("tab" in haystack or "notebook" in haystack or "addtab" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("tab-related")

            if ("reset" in q or "snapshot" in q or "cleanup" in q or "close" in q) and (
                "reset" in haystack or "snapshot" in haystack or "cleanup" in haystack or "close" in haystack
            ):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("reset-related")

            if "responsibility" in q and ("manager" in haystack or "builder" in haystack or "controller" in haystack):
                score += 10
                reasons.append("responsibility-related")

            if "uncertainty" in q and ("warning" in haystack or "try" in haystack or "exception" in haystack):
                score += 8
                reasons.append("uncertainty-related")

            if startup_query:
                startup_markers = [
                    "qapplication",
                    "def main",
                    "main(",
                    "show(",
                    "showmaximized",
                    "mainwindow",
                    "main_window",
                    "windowbuilder",
                    "builder",
                    "interface_manager",
                    "entry_candidate",
                    "if __name__ == \"__main__\"",
                    "if __name__ == '__main__'",
                ]
                if any(marker in haystack for marker in startup_markers):
                    score += 50
                    reasons.append("startup-chain-boost")

                if path in entry_files:
                    score += 30
                    reasons.append("startup-entry-boost")

                if any(term in normalized_path for term in ["main_window", "interface_manager", "builder", "launcher", "main"]):
                    score += 20
                    reasons.append("startup-path-boost")

                if is_auxiliary_ui_path(path):
                    score -= 20
                    reasons.append("startup-auxiliary-penalty")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            detail = self._build_compact_file_evidence(path, reasons)
            scored.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    path=path,
                    module_name=module_name,
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=detail,
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[EvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="F" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    path=item.path,
                    module_name=item.module_name,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_symbols(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[SymbolEvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        startup_query = is_startup_question(q)
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []

        for symbol_name, detail in self.idx.symbol_details.items():
            path = detail["file"]
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue

            record = detail["record"]
            blob = norm_text(symbol_name)
            docstring = norm_text(record.get("docstring", ""))
            calls_blob = ""

            if detail["kind"] in ("function", "method"):
                calls_blob = norm_text(" ".join([c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])]))

            haystack = " ".join([blob, docstring, calls_blob])
            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)
            normalized_path = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 30
                reasons.append("symbol-file-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 30
                    reasons.append("symbol-question-file-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 4
                    reasons.append("symbol-token:" + token)

            if startup_query:
                startup_symbol_markers = [
                    "main",
                    "show",
                    "showmaximized",
                    "qapplication",
                    "exec",
                    "run",
                    "build",
                    "window",
                    "mainwindow",
                ]
                if any(marker in haystack for marker in startup_symbol_markers):
                    score += 15
                    reasons.append("symbol-startup-boost")

                if is_auxiliary_ui_path(path):
                    score -= 10
                    reasons.append("symbol-startup-auxiliary-penalty")

                if any(term in normalized_path for term in ["main_window", "interface_manager", "builder", "launcher", "main"]):
                    score += 10
                    reasons.append("symbol-startup-path-boost")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            scored.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    symbol_name=symbol_name,
                    kind=detail["kind"],
                    path=path,
                    line=detail["line"],
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=self._build_symbol_evidence(symbol_name),
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.symbol_name, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="S" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    symbol_name=item.symbol_name,
                    kind=item.kind,
                    path=item.path,
                    line=item.line,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_snippets(
        self,
        file_evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
        symbol_evidence: list[SymbolEvidenceItem],
        limit: int,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        snippets: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()

        for item in symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, item.line)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, item.line, radius=20)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": item.line,
                    "anchor": item.symbol_name,
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        for item in file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, 1)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, 1, radius=40)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": 1,
                    "anchor": "file-start",
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        return snippets

    def _read_snippet(self, abs_path: str, line: int, radius: int) -> str:
        text = safe_read_text(abs_path)
        lines = text.splitlines()
        if not lines:
            return ""

        start = max(1, line - radius)
        end = min(len(lines), line + radius)
        out: list[str] = []

        for idx in range(start, end + 1):
            out.append(str(idx).rjust(5) + " | " + lines[idx - 1])

        return "\n".join(out)

    def _build_compact_file_evidence(self, path: str, reasons: list[str]) -> str:
        file_record = self.idx.files_by_path[path]
        roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Path: " + path)
        lines.append("Module: " + str(file_record.get("module_name", "")))
        lines.append("Reasons: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))))

        if roles:
            lines.append("Roles: " + ", ".join(roles))

        entry_markers = file_record.get("entry_markers", [])
        if entry_markers:
            lines.append("Entry markers: " + "; ".join(entry_markers[:6]))

        top_functions: list[str] = []
        for fn in file_record.get("functions", [])[:8]:
            top_functions.append(fn.get("qualname", "") + "@" + str(fn.get("lineno", "")))
        if top_functions:
            lines.append("Functions: " + " | ".join(top_functions))

        top_classes: list[str] = []
        for cls in file_record.get("classes", [])[:6]:
            class_text = cls.get("name", "") + "@" + str(cls.get("lineno", ""))
            methods = cls.get("methods", [])[:4]
            if methods:
                class_text += " methods=" + ",".join([m.get("name", "") for m in methods])
            top_classes.append(class_text)
        if top_classes:
            lines.append("Classes: " + " | ".join(top_classes))

        imports_out = sorted(self.idx.import_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if imports_out:
            lines.append("Imports out: " + " | ".join(imports_out[:8]))

        calls_out = sorted(self.idx.call_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if calls_out:
            lines.append("Calls out: " + " | ".join(calls_out[:10]))

        docstring = str(file_record.get("docstring", "")).strip()
        if docstring:
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", docstring)
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _build_symbol_evidence(self, symbol_name: str) -> str:
        detail = self.idx.symbol_details[symbol_name]
        path = detail["file"]
        line = detail["line"]
        kind = detail["kind"]
        record = detail["record"]

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Symbol: " + symbol_name)
        lines.append("Kind: " + kind)
        lines.append("Location: " + path + ":" + str(line))

        if record.get("docstring"):
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(record.get("docstring", "")).strip())
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        if kind in ("function", "method"):
            calls = [c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])[:20]]
            if calls:
                lines.append("Calls: " + " | ".join(calls))

        return "\n".join(lines)

Esse é o próximo passo mais importante.

is the proble the AI model ?

Possibly partly, but not mainly.

Most likely the problem is a combination of:

the retrieval pack
the prompt/guardrails
the cache
and only then the model

Why I say that

When a model answers with things like:
shell.txt
test_snippet_1.py
UNKNOWN COMMAND OR REQUEST

that usually means one of these happened:

it did not receive the right evidence pack
it reused cached output from a previous unrelated prompt
it was allowed to improvise instead of being forced to stay inside evidence
the retrieved evidence was too weak or too off-target
the model is weaker at strict grounded answering than we want

So yes, the model can contribute, but the pipeline is the bigger suspect.

How I would rank the likely causes

    Cache contamination
    Very likely

    Wrong or weak retrieved evidence
    Also very likely

    Prompt not strict enough
    Likely

    Model quality / instruction-following limitations
    Possible, but usually secondary

Practical interpretation

If the same model can sometimes return real project files and sometimes weird fake snippet names, that suggests pipeline inconsistency more than pure model incapacity.

How to tell whether it is the model

A good test is:

disable cache
ask a very exact lookup question
inspect the prompt preview
inspect the evidence list

If:
the evidence list is correct
the prompt preview is correct
and the model still outputs fake files

then yes, the model is a major problem.

But if:
the evidence list is weak, off-target, or missing
then the model is reacting to bad input, not causing the core issue.

Best next diagnostic

Ask this exact question after turning cache off:

Based on eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis, in which file is EEGMainWindowBuilder defined? Answer with file path and evidence ids only.

Then check:

does the evidence list show the real file?
does the prompt preview contain the real file and snippet?
does the answer still invent junk?

Interpretation:
good evidence + bad answer = model issue
bad evidence + bad answer = retrieval/prompt issue
old weird answer repeating = cache issue

So my answer

The model may be part of the problem.
But the main problem is more likely the retrieval-and-prompt pipeline, especially cache and grounding control.

Ótimo. Isso fecha o diagnóstico:

v10_index_loader.py está funcionando.
EEGMainWindowBuilder está corretamente em idx.symbol_details.

Então o problema agora está no v10_retriever.py, no ranking/seleção.

O que isso prova

O símbolo existe:
EEGMainWindowBuilder

O arquivo existe:
shell/viewer/eeg_main_window_builder.py

A classe existe dentro do arquivo.

Logo, se isso não aparece em Symbol Evidence, o retriever não está dando peso suficiente para match exato de classe.

Onde corrigir

No método:

_retrieve_symbols(...)

Você já tem:

for token in tokens:
    if token in haystack:
        score += 4
        reasons.append("symbol-token:" + token)

Isso é fraco para uma consulta exata como:
where EEGMainWindowBuilder is defined

Você precisa adicionar boost explícito para:
match exato do nome do símbolo
match exato case-insensitive
match de símbolo completo na pergunta

Atualização objetiva

Dentro de _retrieve_symbols(...), logo depois de:

blob = norm_text(symbol_name)
docstring = norm_text(record.get("docstring", ""))

adicione:

symbol_name_norm = norm_text(symbol_name)

Depois, na parte do score, antes do loop for token in tokens:, adicione:

if symbol_name_norm and symbol_name_norm in q:
    score += 120
    reasons.append("exact-symbol-match")

last_symbol_part = symbol_name_norm.split(".")[-1]
if last_symbol_part and last_symbol_part in q:
    score += 80
    reasons.append("exact-symbol-tail-match")

Então esse bloco ficará assim:

score = 0
reasons: list[str] = []

if base_name and base_name in q:
    score += 30
    reasons.append("symbol-file-match")

for file_name in question_file_names:
    if base_name == file_name.lower():
        score += 30
        reasons.append("symbol-question-file-match")

if symbol_name_norm and symbol_name_norm in q:
    score += 120
    reasons.append("exact-symbol-match")

last_symbol_part = symbol_name_norm.split(".")[-1]
if last_symbol_part and last_symbol_part in q:
    score += 80
    reasons.append("exact-symbol-tail-match")

for token in tokens:
    if token in haystack:
        score += 4
        reasons.append("symbol-token:" + token)

Melhoria complementar em _retrieve_files(...)

Para o arquivo subir junto quando a pergunta é sobre um símbolo exato, adicione após:

for token in tokens:
    if token in haystack:
        score += 3
        reasons.append("token:" + token)

este bloco:

for class_name in class_names:
    class_name_norm = norm_text(class_name)
    if class_name_norm and class_name_norm in q:
        score += 90
        reasons.append("exact-class-match")

for function_name in function_names:
    function_name_norm = norm_text(function_name)
    if function_name_norm and function_name_norm in q:
        score += 70
        reasons.append("exact-function-match")

Resultado esperado

Depois disso, a pergunta:

Based on eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis, in which file is EEGMainWindowBuilder defined?

deve trazer em Symbol Evidence:
EEGMainWindowBuilder

e em File Evidence:
shell/viewer/eeg_main_window_builder.py

Validação

Depois de editar:

python -m py_compile "developer_tools\project_reasoner\project_reasoner_v10\v10_retriever.py"

Depois teste no terminal sem GUI:

Isso não é erro do retriever em si. É erro de import por como o módulo foi executado.

O arquivo v10_retriever.py usa imports assim:

from v10_index_loader import JsonProjectIndex
from v10_models import EvidenceItem, RetrievalBundle, SymbolEvidenceItem

Esses imports só funcionam quando o diretório
developer_tools\project_reasoner\project_reasoner_v10
está no sys.path.

Como você rodou a partir da raiz do projeto com python -c, o Python não encontrou v10_index_loader.

Use um destes dois jeitos.

Perfeito. Agora ficou claro.

O retriever já encontra o símbolo corretamente.
O problema restante é o ranking de arquivos.

O que esse teste provou

SYMBOLS está certo:
EEGMainWindowBuilder aparece em
shell/viewer/eeg_main_window_builder.py

Mas FILES está errado:
o arquivo correto nem entrou no topo
porque o score de arquivo ficou fraco demais

Diagnóstico exato

_retrieve_symbols(...) está funcionando
_retrieve_files(...) não está promovendo o arquivo que contém a classe pedida

Por isso na GUI você pode até ter símbolo certo, mas o pack final ainda fica fraco ou desbalanceado.

O que corrigir

No v10_retriever.py, dentro de _retrieve_files(...), você precisa dar boost explícito quando a pergunta contém o nome exato de uma classe ou função presente no arquivo.

Adicione isso logo depois de:

for token in tokens:
    if token in haystack:
        score += 3
        reasons.append("token:" + token)

Use este bloco:

for class_name in class_names:
    class_name_norm = norm_text(class_name)
    if class_name_norm and class_name_norm in q:
        score += 100
        reasons.append("exact-class-match")

for function_name in function_names:
    function_name_norm = norm_text(function_name)
    if function_name_norm and function_name_norm in q:
        score += 80
        reasons.append("exact-function-match")

for called_symbol in called_symbols:
    called_symbol_norm = norm_text(called_symbol)
    if called_symbol_norm and called_symbol_norm in q:
        score += 20
        reasons.append("exact-called-symbol-match")

Melhoria extra para startup

Como você quer cadeias arquiteturais, aumente também este bloco:

if startup_query:

e dentro dele mantenha:

if any(marker in haystack for marker in startup_markers):
    score += 50
    reasons.append("startup-chain-boost")

mas também acrescente:

if "eegmainwindowbuilder" in q and "eegmainwindowbuilder" in haystack:
    score += 120
    reasons.append("startup-main-window-builder-boost")

Resultado esperado

Depois disso, para a pergunta:

Based on eeg_kernel_ai_neural_data_analysis, in which file is EEGMainWindowBuilder defined?

o FILES deve trazer no topo:
shell/viewer/eeg_main_window_builder.py

Próxima validação
