python -m py_compile "developer_tools\project_reasoner\project_reasoner_v10\v10_retriever.py"

E rode de novo o mesmo teste de terminal.

Hoje o símbolo certo já aparece.
Falta só fazer o arquivo correto subir no ranking.

Se você quiser, eu posso agora te devolver o v10_retriever.py já com esse patch integrado para copiar e colar.

update module 

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from typing import Any

from v10_index_loader import JsonProjectIndex
from v10_models import EvidenceItem, RetrievalBundle, SymbolEvidenceItem


def norm_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value).strip().lower() if value is not None else ""


def tokenize_query(text: str) -> list[str]:
    tokens = re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+", text.lower())
    stop_words = {
        "the",
        "is",
        "are",
        "a",
        "an",
        "of",
        "to",
        "me",
        "show",
        "which",
        "what",
        "where",
        "who",
        "does",
        "do",
        "in",
        "on",
        "for",
        "and",
        "or",
        "with",
        "code",
        "module",
        "file",
        "implementing",
        "implements",
        "created",
        "creates",
        "create",
        "that",
        "this",
        "app",
        "about",
        "how",
        "from",
        "explain",
        "based",
        "using",
        "only",
        "current",
        "project",
    }
    return [token for token in tokens if token not in stop_words]


def safe_read_text(path: str) -> str:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        return handle.read()


def file_name_from_path(path: str) -> str:
    return os.path.basename(path.replace("\\", "/")).lower()


def is_allowed_project_path(path: str) -> bool:
    low = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()

    blocked_parts = [
        "/developer_tools/",
        "/.git/",
        "/.idea/",
        "/.venv/",
        "/venv/",
        "/env/",
        "/site-packages/",
        "/__pycache__/",
        "/build/",
        "/dist/",
        "/scratches/",
        "/consoles/",
        "/external libraries/",
        "/logic_main_app/chats/",
    ]

    return not any(part in low for part in blocked_parts)


def is_startup_question(q: str) -> bool:
    startup_terms = [
        "startup",
        "start up",
        "main entry",
        "entry point",
        "main window",
        "launch",
        "open app",
        "application start",
        "app start",
        "until the main window is shown",
        "until main window is shown",
        "qapplication",
        "showmaximized",
        "show(",
    ]
    return any(term in q for term in startup_terms)


def is_auxiliary_ui_path(path: str) -> bool:
    low = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
    auxiliary_terms = [
        "help",
        "tooltip",
        "popup",
        "modal",
        "dialog",
        "warning",
    ]
    return any(term in low for term in auxiliary_terms)


class ProjectRetriever:
    def __init__(self, project_index: JsonProjectIndex) -> None:
        self.idx = project_index

    def retrieve(
        self,
        question: str,
        *,
        file_limit: int = 10,
        symbol_limit: int = 10,
        snippet_limit: int = 6,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_evidence = self._retrieve_files(question, file_limit)
        symbol_evidence = self._retrieve_symbols(question, symbol_limit)
        snippet_evidence = self._retrieve_snippets(file_evidence, symbol_evidence, snippet_limit)
        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=file_evidence,
            symbol_evidence=symbol_evidence,
            snippet_evidence=snippet_evidence,
        )

    def merge_with_previous(
        self,
        current_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        previous_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        *,
        max_files: int = 14,
        max_symbols: int = 14,
        max_snippets: int = 10,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_map: dict[str, EvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.file_evidence + previous_bundle.file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.path
            old = file_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                file_map[key] = item

        symbol_map: dict[str, SymbolEvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.symbol_evidence + previous_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.symbol_name + "|" + item.path
            old = symbol_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                symbol_map[key] = item

        snippet_map: dict[tuple[str, int, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.snippet_evidence + previous_bundle.snippet_evidence:
            path = str(item.get("path", ""))
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue
            key = (path, int(item.get("line", 0)), str(item.get("anchor", "")))
            snippet_map[key] = item

        merged_files = sorted(file_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.path))[:max_files]
        merged_symbols = sorted(symbol_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.symbol_name, x.path))[:max_symbols]
        merged_snippets = list(snippet_map.values())[:max_snippets]

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_files, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "F" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_symbols, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "S" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_snippets, start=1):
            item["snippet_id"] = "SN" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=merged_files,
            symbol_evidence=merged_symbols,
            snippet_evidence=merged_snippets,
        )

    def _retrieve_files(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[EvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        startup_query = is_startup_question(q)

        entry_files = {
            path for path in (self.idx.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])
            if is_allowed_project_path(path)
        }
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[EvidenceItem] = []

        for path, file_record in self.idx.files_by_path.items():
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue

            module_name = file_record.get("module_name", "")
            docstring = file_record.get("docstring", "")
            strings = " ".join(file_record.get("strings", []))
            comments = " ".join(file_record.get("comments", []))
            entry_markers = " ".join(file_record.get("entry_markers", []))
            ui_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("ui_keyword_hits", []))
            eeg_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("eeg_keyword_hits", []))
            semantic_hints = " ".join(file_record.get("semantic_hints", []))
            roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

            function_names: list[str] = []
            class_names: list[str] = []
            called_symbols: list[str] = []

            for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
                function_names.append(fn.get("qualname", ""))
                function_names.append(fn.get("name", ""))
                for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                    called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
                class_names.append(cls.get("name", ""))
                for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                    function_names.append(method.get("qualname", ""))
                    function_names.append(method.get("name", ""))
                    for call in method.get("calls", []):
                        called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            haystack = " ".join(
                [
                    norm_text(path),
                    norm_text(module_name),
                    norm_text(docstring),
                    norm_text(strings),
                    norm_text(comments),
                    norm_text(entry_markers),
                    norm_text(ui_hits),
                    norm_text(eeg_hits),
                    norm_text(semantic_hints),
                    norm_text(" ".join(function_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(class_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(called_symbols)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(roles)),
                ]
            )

            normalized_path = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if normalized_path in q:
                score += 120
                reasons.append("exact-path-match")

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 80
                reasons.append("exact-filename-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 80
                    reasons.append("question-filename-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 3
                    reasons.append("token:" + token)

            for class_name in class_names:
                class_name_norm = norm_text(class_name)
                if class_name_norm and class_name_norm in q:
                    score += 100
                    reasons.append("exact-class-match")

            for function_name in function_names:
                function_name_norm = norm_text(function_name)
                if function_name_norm and function_name_norm in q:
                    score += 80
                    reasons.append("exact-function-match")

            for called_symbol in called_symbols:
                called_symbol_norm = norm_text(called_symbol)
                if called_symbol_norm and called_symbol_norm in q:
                    score += 20
                    reasons.append("exact-called-symbol-match")

            if path in entry_files and any(key in q for key in ["start", "startup", "main", "launch", "open", "show"]):
                score += 14
                reasons.append("entry-file")

            if "topomap" in q and ("topomap" in haystack or "amplitude_map" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("topomap-related")

            if "timeline" in q and "timeline" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("timeline-related")

            if "splash" in q and "splash" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("splash-related")

            if "tab" in q and ("tab" in haystack or "notebook" in haystack or "addtab" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("tab-related")

            if ("reset" in q or "snapshot" in q or "cleanup" in q or "close" in q) and (
                "reset" in haystack or "snapshot" in haystack or "cleanup" in haystack or "close" in haystack
            ):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("reset-related")

            if "responsibility" in q and ("manager" in haystack or "builder" in haystack or "controller" in haystack):
                score += 10
                reasons.append("responsibility-related")

            if "uncertainty" in q and ("warning" in haystack or "try" in haystack or "exception" in haystack):
                score += 8
                reasons.append("uncertainty-related")

            if startup_query:
                startup_markers = [
                    "qapplication",
                    "def main",
                    "main(",
                    "show(",
                    "showmaximized",
                    "mainwindow",
                    "main_window",
                    "windowbuilder",
                    "builder",
                    "interface_manager",
                    "entry_candidate",
                    "if __name__ == \"__main__\"",
                    "if __name__ == '__main__'",
                ]
                if any(marker in haystack for marker in startup_markers):
                    score += 50
                    reasons.append("startup-chain-boost")

                if path in entry_files:
                    score += 30
                    reasons.append("startup-entry-boost")

                if any(term in normalized_path for term in ["main_window", "interface_manager", "builder", "launcher", "main"]):
                    score += 20
                    reasons.append("startup-path-boost")

                if is_auxiliary_ui_path(path):
                    score -= 20
                    reasons.append("startup-auxiliary-penalty")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            detail = self._build_compact_file_evidence(path, reasons)
            scored.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    path=path,
                    module_name=module_name,
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=detail,
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[EvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="F" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    path=item.path,
                    module_name=item.module_name,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_symbols(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[SymbolEvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        startup_query = is_startup_question(q)
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []

        for symbol_name, detail in self.idx.symbol_details.items():
            path = detail["file"]
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue

            record = detail["record"]
            blob = norm_text(symbol_name)
            docstring = norm_text(record.get("docstring", ""))
            calls_blob = ""

            if detail["kind"] in ("function", "method"):
                calls_blob = norm_text(" ".join([c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])]))

            haystack = " ".join([blob, docstring, calls_blob])
            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)
            normalized_path = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 30
                reasons.append("symbol-file-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 30
                    reasons.append("symbol-question-file-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 4
                    reasons.append("symbol-token:" + token)

            if startup_query:
                startup_symbol_markers = [
                    "main",
                    "show",
                    "showmaximized",
                    "qapplication",
                    "exec",
                    "run",
                    "build",
                    "window",
                    "mainwindow",
                ]
                if any(marker in haystack for marker in startup_symbol_markers):
                    score += 15
                    reasons.append("symbol-startup-boost")

                if is_auxiliary_ui_path(path):
                    score -= 10
                    reasons.append("symbol-startup-auxiliary-penalty")

                if any(term in normalized_path for term in ["main_window", "interface_manager", "builder", "launcher", "main"]):
                    score += 10
                    reasons.append("symbol-startup-path-boost")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            scored.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    symbol_name=symbol_name,
                    kind=detail["kind"],
                    path=path,
                    line=detail["line"],
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=self._build_symbol_evidence(symbol_name),
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.symbol_name, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="S" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    symbol_name=item.symbol_name,
                    kind=item.kind,
                    path=item.path,
                    line=item.line,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_snippets(
        self,
        file_evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
        symbol_evidence: list[SymbolEvidenceItem],
        limit: int,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        snippets: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()

        for item in symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, item.line)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, item.line, radius=20)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": item.line,
                    "anchor": item.symbol_name,
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        for item in file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, 1)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, 1, radius=40)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": 1,
                    "anchor": "file-start",
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        return snippets

    def _read_snippet(self, abs_path: str, line: int, radius: int) -> str:
        text = safe_read_text(abs_path)
        lines = text.splitlines()
        if not lines:
            return ""

        start = max(1, line - radius)
        end = min(len(lines), line + radius)
        out: list[str] = []

        for idx in range(start, end + 1):
            out.append(str(idx).rjust(5) + " | " + lines[idx - 1])

        return "\n".join(out)

    def _build_compact_file_evidence(self, path: str, reasons: list[str]) -> str:
        file_record = self.idx.files_by_path[path]
        roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Path: " + path)
        lines.append("Module: " + str(file_record.get("module_name", "")))
        lines.append("Reasons: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))))

        if roles:
            lines.append("Roles: " + ", ".join(roles))

        entry_markers = file_record.get("entry_markers", [])
        if entry_markers:
            lines.append("Entry markers: " + "; ".join(entry_markers[:6]))

        top_functions: list[str] = []
        for fn in file_record.get("functions", [])[:8]:
            top_functions.append(fn.get("qualname", "") + "@" + str(fn.get("lineno", "")))
        if top_functions:
            lines.append("Functions: " + " | ".join(top_functions))

        top_classes: list[str] = []
        for cls in file_record.get("classes", [])[:6]:
            class_text = cls.get("name", "") + "@" + str(cls.get("lineno", ""))
            methods = cls.get("methods", [])[:4]
            if methods:
                class_text += " methods=" + ",".join([m.get("name", "") for m in methods])
            top_classes.append(class_text)
        if top_classes:
            lines.append("Classes: " + " | ".join(top_classes))

        imports_out = sorted(self.idx.import_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if imports_out:
            lines.append("Imports out: " + " | ".join(imports_out[:8]))

        calls_out = sorted(self.idx.call_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if calls_out:
            lines.append("Calls out: " + " | ".join(calls_out[:10]))

        docstring = str(file_record.get("docstring", "")).strip()
        if docstring:
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", docstring)
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _build_symbol_evidence(self, symbol_name: str) -> str:
        detail = self.idx.symbol_details[symbol_name]
        path = detail["file"]
        line = detail["line"]
        kind = detail["kind"]
        record = detail["record"]

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Symbol: " + symbol_name)
        lines.append("Kind: " + kind)
        lines.append("Location: " + path + ":" + str(line))

        if record.get("docstring"):
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(record.get("docstring", "")).strip())
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        if kind in ("function", "method"):
            calls = [c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])[:20]]
            if calls:
                lines.append("Calls: " + " | ".join(calls))

        return "\n".join(lines)

Use this updated version. It keeps your current structure, boosts exact class and symbol lookup harder, and makes file ranking stronger for precise questions like EEGMainWindowBuilder.

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import re
from typing import Any

from v10_index_loader import JsonProjectIndex
from v10_models import EvidenceItem, RetrievalBundle, SymbolEvidenceItem


def norm_text(value: Any) -> str:
    return str(value).strip().lower() if value is not None else ""


def tokenize_query(text: str) -> list[str]:
    tokens = re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\.]+", text.lower())
    stop_words = {
        "the",
        "is",
        "are",
        "a",
        "an",
        "of",
        "to",
        "me",
        "show",
        "which",
        "what",
        "where",
        "who",
        "does",
        "do",
        "in",
        "on",
        "for",
        "and",
        "or",
        "with",
        "code",
        "module",
        "file",
        "implementing",
        "implements",
        "created",
        "creates",
        "create",
        "that",
        "this",
        "app",
        "about",
        "how",
        "from",
        "explain",
        "based",
        "using",
        "only",
        "current",
        "project",
    }
    return [token for token in tokens if token not in stop_words]


def safe_read_text(path: str) -> str:
    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        return handle.read()


def file_name_from_path(path: str) -> str:
    return os.path.basename(path.replace("\\", "/")).lower()


def is_allowed_project_path(path: str) -> bool:
    low = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()

    blocked_parts = [
        "/developer_tools/",
        "/.git/",
        "/.idea/",
        "/.venv/",
        "/venv/",
        "/env/",
        "/site-packages/",
        "/__pycache__/",
        "/build/",
        "/dist/",
        "/scratches/",
        "/consoles/",
        "/external libraries/",
        "/logic_main_app/chats/",
    ]

    return not any(part in low for part in blocked_parts)


def is_startup_question(q: str) -> bool:
    startup_terms = [
        "startup",
        "start up",
        "main entry",
        "entry point",
        "main window",
        "launch",
        "open app",
        "application start",
        "app start",
        "until the main window is shown",
        "until main window is shown",
        "qapplication",
        "showmaximized",
        "show(",
    ]
    return any(term in q for term in startup_terms)


def is_auxiliary_ui_path(path: str) -> bool:
    low = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
    auxiliary_terms = [
        "help",
        "tooltip",
        "popup",
        "modal",
        "dialog",
        "warning",
    ]
    return any(term in low for term in auxiliary_terms)


class ProjectRetriever:
    def __init__(self, project_index: JsonProjectIndex) -> None:
        self.idx = project_index

    def retrieve(
        self,
        question: str,
        *,
        file_limit: int = 10,
        symbol_limit: int = 10,
        snippet_limit: int = 6,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_evidence = self._retrieve_files(question, file_limit)
        symbol_evidence = self._retrieve_symbols(question, symbol_limit)
        snippet_evidence = self._retrieve_snippets(file_evidence, symbol_evidence, snippet_limit)
        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=file_evidence,
            symbol_evidence=symbol_evidence,
            snippet_evidence=snippet_evidence,
        )

    def merge_with_previous(
        self,
        current_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        previous_bundle: RetrievalBundle,
        *,
        max_files: int = 14,
        max_symbols: int = 14,
        max_snippets: int = 10,
    ) -> RetrievalBundle:
        file_map: dict[str, EvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.file_evidence + previous_bundle.file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.path
            old = file_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                file_map[key] = item

        symbol_map: dict[str, SymbolEvidenceItem] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.symbol_evidence + previous_bundle.symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            key = item.symbol_name + "|" + item.path
            old = symbol_map.get(key)
            if old is None or item.score > old.score:
                symbol_map[key] = item

        snippet_map: dict[tuple[str, int, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for item in current_bundle.snippet_evidence + previous_bundle.snippet_evidence:
            path = str(item.get("path", ""))
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue
            key = (path, int(item.get("line", 0)), str(item.get("anchor", "")))
            snippet_map[key] = item

        merged_files = sorted(file_map.values(), key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.path))[:max_files]
        merged_symbols = sorted(
            symbol_map.values(),
            key=lambda x: (-x.score, x.symbol_name, x.path),
        )[:max_symbols]
        merged_snippets = list(snippet_map.values())[:max_snippets]

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_files, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "F" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_symbols, start=1):
            item.evidence_id = "S" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        for idx, item in enumerate(merged_snippets, start=1):
            item["snippet_id"] = "SN" + str(idx).zfill(2)

        return RetrievalBundle(
            file_evidence=merged_files,
            symbol_evidence=merged_symbols,
            snippet_evidence=merged_snippets,
        )

    def _retrieve_files(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[EvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        startup_query = is_startup_question(q)

        entry_files = {
            path for path in (self.idx.index_data or {}).get("entry_files", [])
            if is_allowed_project_path(path)
        }
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[EvidenceItem] = []

        for path, file_record in self.idx.files_by_path.items():
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue

            module_name = file_record.get("module_name", "")
            docstring = file_record.get("docstring", "")
            strings = " ".join(file_record.get("strings", []))
            comments = " ".join(file_record.get("comments", []))
            entry_markers = " ".join(file_record.get("entry_markers", []))
            ui_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("ui_keyword_hits", []))
            eeg_hits = " ".join(file_record.get("eeg_keyword_hits", []))
            semantic_hints = " ".join(file_record.get("semantic_hints", []))
            roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

            function_names: list[str] = []
            class_names: list[str] = []
            called_symbols: list[str] = []

            for fn in file_record.get("functions", []):
                function_names.append(fn.get("qualname", ""))
                function_names.append(fn.get("name", ""))
                for call in fn.get("calls", []):
                    called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            for cls in file_record.get("classes", []):
                class_names.append(cls.get("name", ""))
                for method in cls.get("methods", []):
                    function_names.append(method.get("qualname", ""))
                    function_names.append(method.get("name", ""))
                    for call in method.get("calls", []):
                        called_symbols.append(call.get("call_name", ""))

            haystack = " ".join(
                [
                    norm_text(path),
                    norm_text(module_name),
                    norm_text(docstring),
                    norm_text(strings),
                    norm_text(comments),
                    norm_text(entry_markers),
                    norm_text(ui_hits),
                    norm_text(eeg_hits),
                    norm_text(semantic_hints),
                    norm_text(" ".join(function_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(class_names)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(called_symbols)),
                    norm_text(" ".join(roles)),
                ]
            )

            normalized_path = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()
            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if normalized_path in q:
                score += 120
                reasons.append("exact-path-match")

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 80
                reasons.append("exact-filename-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 80
                    reasons.append("question-filename-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 3
                    reasons.append("token:" + token)

            for class_name in class_names:
                class_name_norm = norm_text(class_name)
                if class_name_norm and class_name_norm in q:
                    score += 100
                    reasons.append("exact-class-match")

                class_tail = class_name_norm.split(".")[-1]
                if class_tail and class_tail in q:
                    score += 60
                    reasons.append("exact-class-tail-match")

            for function_name in function_names:
                function_name_norm = norm_text(function_name)
                if function_name_norm and function_name_norm in q:
                    score += 80
                    reasons.append("exact-function-match")

                function_tail = function_name_norm.split(".")[-1]
                if function_tail and function_tail in q:
                    score += 40
                    reasons.append("exact-function-tail-match")

            for called_symbol in called_symbols:
                called_symbol_norm = norm_text(called_symbol)
                if called_symbol_norm and called_symbol_norm in q:
                    score += 20
                    reasons.append("exact-called-symbol-match")

            if path in entry_files and any(
                key in q for key in ["start", "startup", "main", "launch", "open", "show"]
            ):
                score += 14
                reasons.append("entry-file")

            if "topomap" in q and ("topomap" in haystack or "amplitude_map" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("topomap-related")

            if "timeline" in q and "timeline" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("timeline-related")

            if "splash" in q and "splash" in haystack:
                score += 12
                reasons.append("splash-related")

            if "tab" in q and ("tab" in haystack or "notebook" in haystack or "addtab" in haystack):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("tab-related")

            if ("reset" in q or "snapshot" in q or "cleanup" in q or "close" in q) and (
                "reset" in haystack
                or "snapshot" in haystack
                or "cleanup" in haystack
                or "close" in haystack
            ):
                score += 12
                reasons.append("reset-related")

            if "responsibility" in q and (
                "manager" in haystack or "builder" in haystack or "controller" in haystack
            ):
                score += 10
                reasons.append("responsibility-related")

            if "uncertainty" in q and ("warning" in haystack or "try" in haystack or "exception" in haystack):
                score += 8
                reasons.append("uncertainty-related")

            if startup_query:
                startup_markers = [
                    "qapplication",
                    "def main",
                    "main(",
                    "show(",
                    "showmaximized",
                    "mainwindow",
                    "main_window",
                    "windowbuilder",
                    "builder",
                    "interface_manager",
                    "entry_candidate",
                    "if __name__ == \"__main__\"",
                    "if __name__ == '__main__'",
                ]
                if any(marker in haystack for marker in startup_markers):
                    score += 50
                    reasons.append("startup-chain-boost")

                if path in entry_files:
                    score += 30
                    reasons.append("startup-entry-boost")

                if any(
                    term in normalized_path
                    for term in ["main_window", "interface_manager", "builder", "launcher", "main"]
                ):
                    score += 20
                    reasons.append("startup-path-boost")

                if "eegmainwindowbuilder" in q and "eegmainwindowbuilder" in haystack:
                    score += 120
                    reasons.append("startup-main-window-builder-boost")

                if is_auxiliary_ui_path(path):
                    score -= 20
                    reasons.append("startup-auxiliary-penalty")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            detail = self._build_compact_file_evidence(path, reasons)
            scored.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    path=path,
                    module_name=module_name,
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=detail,
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[EvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                EvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="F" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    path=item.path,
                    module_name=item.module_name,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_symbols(self, question: str, limit: int) -> list[SymbolEvidenceItem]:
        q = norm_text(question)
        tokens = tokenize_query(q)
        startup_query = is_startup_question(q)
        question_file_names = set(re.findall(r"[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+\.py", q))
        scored: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []

        for symbol_name, detail in self.idx.symbol_details.items():
            path = detail["file"]
            if not is_allowed_project_path(path):
                continue

            record = detail["record"]
            symbol_name_norm = norm_text(symbol_name)
            blob = symbol_name_norm
            docstring = norm_text(record.get("docstring", ""))
            calls_blob = ""

            if detail["kind"] in ("function", "method"):
                calls_blob = norm_text(" ".join([c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])]))

            haystack = " ".join([blob, docstring, calls_blob])
            base_name = file_name_from_path(path)
            normalized_path = path.replace("\\", "/").lower()

            score = 0
            reasons: list[str] = []

            if base_name and base_name in q:
                score += 30
                reasons.append("symbol-file-match")

            for file_name in question_file_names:
                if base_name == file_name.lower():
                    score += 30
                    reasons.append("symbol-question-file-match")

            if symbol_name_norm and symbol_name_norm in q:
                score += 120
                reasons.append("exact-symbol-match")

            last_symbol_part = symbol_name_norm.split(".")[-1]
            if last_symbol_part and last_symbol_part in q:
                score += 80
                reasons.append("exact-symbol-tail-match")

            for token in tokens:
                if token in haystack:
                    score += 4
                    reasons.append("symbol-token:" + token)

            if startup_query:
                startup_symbol_markers = [
                    "main",
                    "show",
                    "showmaximized",
                    "qapplication",
                    "exec",
                    "run",
                    "build",
                    "window",
                    "mainwindow",
                ]
                if any(marker in haystack for marker in startup_symbol_markers):
                    score += 15
                    reasons.append("symbol-startup-boost")

                if is_auxiliary_ui_path(path):
                    score -= 10
                    reasons.append("symbol-startup-auxiliary-penalty")

                if any(
                    term in normalized_path
                    for term in ["main_window", "interface_manager", "builder", "launcher", "main"]
                ):
                    score += 10
                    reasons.append("symbol-startup-path-boost")

            if score <= 0:
                continue

            scored.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="",
                    score=score,
                    symbol_name=symbol_name,
                    kind=detail["kind"],
                    path=path,
                    line=detail["line"],
                    reason=", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))),
                    detail=self._build_symbol_evidence(symbol_name),
                )
            )

        scored.sort(key=lambda item: (-item.score, item.symbol_name, item.path))
        scored = scored[:limit]

        reindexed: list[SymbolEvidenceItem] = []
        for idx, item in enumerate(scored, start=1):
            reindexed.append(
                SymbolEvidenceItem(
                    evidence_id="S" + str(idx).zfill(2),
                    score=item.score,
                    symbol_name=item.symbol_name,
                    kind=item.kind,
                    path=item.path,
                    line=item.line,
                    reason=item.reason,
                    detail=item.detail,
                )
            )
        return reindexed

    def _retrieve_snippets(
        self,
        file_evidence: list[EvidenceItem],
        symbol_evidence: list[SymbolEvidenceItem],
        limit: int,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        snippets: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        seen: set[tuple[str, int]] = set()

        for item in symbol_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, item.line)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, item.line, radius=20)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": item.line,
                    "anchor": item.symbol_name,
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        for item in file_evidence:
            if not is_allowed_project_path(item.path):
                continue
            abs_path = os.path.join(self.idx.project_root, item.path)
            if not os.path.exists(abs_path):
                continue
            key = (item.path, 1)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            snippet_text = self._read_snippet(abs_path, 1, radius=40)
            snippets.append(
                {
                    "snippet_id": "SN" + str(len(snippets) + 1).zfill(2),
                    "path": item.path,
                    "line": 1,
                    "anchor": "file-start",
                    "text": snippet_text,
                }
            )
            if len(snippets) >= limit:
                return snippets

        return snippets

    def _read_snippet(self, abs_path: str, line: int, radius: int) -> str:
        text = safe_read_text(abs_path)
        lines = text.splitlines()
        if not lines:
            return ""

        start = max(1, line - radius)
        end = min(len(lines), line + radius)
        out: list[str] = []

        for idx in range(start, end + 1):
            out.append(str(idx).rjust(5) + " | " + lines[idx - 1])

        return "\n".join(out)

    def _build_compact_file_evidence(self, path: str, reasons: list[str]) -> str:
        file_record = self.idx.files_by_path[path]
        roles = self.idx.semantic_roles.get(path, {}).get("roles", [])

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Path: " + path)
        lines.append("Module: " + str(file_record.get("module_name", "")))
        lines.append("Reasons: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(reasons))))

        if roles:
            lines.append("Roles: " + ", ".join(roles))

        entry_markers = file_record.get("entry_markers", [])
        if entry_markers:
            lines.append("Entry markers: " + "; ".join(entry_markers[:6]))

        top_functions: list[str] = []
        for fn in file_record.get("functions", [])[:8]:
            top_functions.append(fn.get("qualname", "") + "@" + str(fn.get("lineno", "")))
        if top_functions:
            lines.append("Functions: " + " | ".join(top_functions))

        top_classes: list[str] = []
        for cls in file_record.get("classes", [])[:6]:
            class_text = cls.get("name", "") + "@" + str(cls.get("lineno", ""))
            methods = cls.get("methods", [])[:4]
            if methods:
                class_text += " methods=" + ",".join([m.get("name", "") for m in methods])
            top_classes.append(class_text)
        if top_classes:
            lines.append("Classes: " + " | ".join(top_classes))

        imports_out = sorted(self.idx.import_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if imports_out:
            lines.append("Imports out: " + " | ".join(imports_out[:8]))

        calls_out = sorted(self.idx.call_graph_out.get(path, []))
        if calls_out:
            lines.append("Calls out: " + " | ".join(calls_out[:10]))

        docstring = str(file_record.get("docstring", "")).strip()
        if docstring:
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", docstring)
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        return "\n".join(lines)

    def _build_symbol_evidence(self, symbol_name: str) -> str:
        detail = self.idx.symbol_details[symbol_name]
        path = detail["file"]
        line = detail["line"]
        kind = detail["kind"]
        record = detail["record"]

        lines: list[str] = []
        lines.append("Symbol: " + symbol_name)
        lines.append("Kind: " + kind)
        lines.append("Location: " + path + ":" + str(line))

        if record.get("docstring"):
            docstring = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(record.get("docstring", "")).strip())
            lines.append("Docstring: " + docstring[:500])

        if kind in ("function", "method"):
            calls = [c.get("call_name", "") for c in record.get("calls", [])[:20]]
            if calls:
                lines.append("Calls: " + " | ".join(calls))

        return "\n".join(lines)

Sim. O correto é padronizar todos os imports internos do pacote V10 para import absoluto de pacote.

Base correta

Use este prefixo para módulos dentro de:

developer_tools/project_reasoner/project_reasoner_v10/

Formato correto:

from developer_tools.project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10.<modulo> import ...

Exemplos corretos

from v10_index_loader import JsonProjectIndex

use:

from developer_tools.project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10.v10_index_loader import JsonProjectIndex
from developer_tools.project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10.v10_models import EvidenceItem, RetrievalBundle, SymbolEvidenceItem

developer_tools/project_reasoner/project_reasoner_v10/

sempre que houver imports assim:

ou

Regra prática

Dentro de project_reasoner_v10, qualquer import interno deve virar:

from developer_tools.project_reasoner.project_reasoner_v10...

e não mais:

from v10_...

Por que isso é melhor

Funciona ao rodar da raiz do projeto.
Evita precisar fazer sys.path.insert(...).
Deixa o pacote consistente.
